uploadExp.title: How to Upload Screenshots for parsing
uploadExp.alert: NOTE: Artifact Scanning currently only works for ENGLISH artifacts.
uploadExp.section1: <0>Using screenshots can dramatically decrease the amount of time you manually input in stats on the Genshin Optimizer.</0><1>Where to snip the screenshot.</1><2>In game, Open your bag, and navigate to the artifacts tab. Select the artifact you want to scan with Genshin Optimizer. <2>Only artifact from this screen can be scanned.</2></2><3>Single artifact</3><4>To take a screenshot, in Windows, the shortcut is <2>Alt + Print Screen</2>. Once you selected the region, the image is automatically included in your clipboard.</4><5>Multiple artifacts</5><6>To take advantage of batch uploads, you can use a tool like <2>PicPick</2> to create a macro to easily to screenshot multiple artifacts at once.</6><7>What to include in the screenshot.</7><8>The full genshin window, or at least a region that covers the artifact card.</8>
uploadExp.section2: <0>Adding Screenshot to Genshin Optimizer</0><1>At this point, you should have the artifact screenshot either saved to your harddrive, or in your clipboard.</1><2>You can click on the box next to "Browse" to browse the files in your harddrive for multiple screenshots.</2><3>For single screenshots from the snippets, just press <2>Ctrl + V</2> to paste from your clipboard.</3><4>You should be able to see a Preview of your artifact snippet, and after waiting a few seconds, the artifact set and the substats will be filled in in the <1>Artifact Editor</1>.</4><5>Finishing the Artifact</5><6>Unfortunately, computer vision is not 100%. There will always be cases where something is not scanned properly. You should always double check the scanned artifact values! Once the artifact has been filled, Click on <2>Add Artifact</2> to finish editing the artifact.</6>

info.title: Artifact Editing/Management Guide
info.section1: <0>Substat rolls</0><1>The <1>number of rolls</1> a substat has is shown to the right of the substat, indicated by the number of bars. Also, as the number of rolls increases, the substat becomes brighter. Additionaly, each individual bar becomes more colorful as that roll value increases:<3></3>.</1><2>Substat Roll Value</2><3>The Roll Value (RV) of a substat is a percentage of the current value over the highest potential 5<1></1> value. From the Image, the maximum roll value of HP% is 5.8%. In RV: <3>5.3/5.8 ~ 90%.</3></3><4>Current Roll Value vs. Maximum Roll Value</4><5>When a 5<1></1> has 9 (4 base + 5 additional) total rolls, with each of the rolls having the highest value, that is defined as a 900% RV artifact. However, most of the artifacts are not this lucky. The <3>Current RV</3> of an artifact is a percentage over that max value artifact. The <5>Maximum RV</5> is the maximum possible RV an artifact can achieve, if the remaining artifact rolls from upgrades are the hightest possible value.</5>
info.section2: <0>Artifact Editor</0><1>A fully featured artifact editor, that can accept any 3<1></1> to 5<3></3> Artifact. When a substat is entered, the exact roll values will be calculated. It will also make sure that you have the correct number of rolls in the artifact according to the level, along with validating other metrics.</1><2>Scan screenshots</2><3>Manual input is not your cup of tea? You can scan in your artifacts with screenshots! On the Artifact Editor, click the <1>Show Me How!</1> button to learn more.</3><4>Automatic Artifact Scanner</4><5>If you are playing Genshin on PC, you can download a tool that automatically scans all of your artifacts for you, and you can then import that data in <1></1> Settings. <3>Click here</3> for a list of scanners that are compatible with GO.</5><6>Duplicate/Upgrade artifact detection</6><7>Did you know GO can detect if you are adding a <1>duplicate</1> artifact that exists in the system? It can also detect if the current artifact in editor is an <3>upgrade</3> of an existing artifact as well. Once a duplicate/upgrade is detected, a preview will allow you to compare the two artifacts in question(See Image).</7>
info.section3: <0>Artifact Inventory</0><1>All your artifacts that you've added to GO are displayed here. The filters here allow you to further refine your view of your artifacts. </1><2>Example: Finding Fodder Artifacts</2><3>By utilizing the artifact filter, and the artifact RV, you can quickly find artifacts to feed as food.</3><4>In this example, the filters are set thusly: </4><5><0><0>Limit level to 0-8.</0><1>Unlocked artifacts in Inventory.</1><2>Removing the contribution of flat HP, flat DEF and Energy Recharge to RV calculations.</2><3>Sorted by Ascending Max Roll Value.</3></0></5><6>This will filter the artifact Inventory by the lowest RV artifacts, for desired substats.</6>

tipsOfTheDay: The maximum RV of a 4-star artifact is around 540%.
The maximum RV of an artifact will usually decrease as you upgrade. It's perfectly normal!
Substats with "1"s are the hardest to scan in screenshots.
If all your rolls(6) went into a single substat, it will be purple!
Click on "Details" when you are upgrading your artifacts in game to scan as you upgrade.
You can now upload multiple artifact screenshots to scan!

char_Somnia.name: Somnia
char_Somnia.title: Creation of Simulated Cognition
char_Somnia.description: A combination of an array of concepts. She exists in a variety of states and phases. Is she even real?

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, launching beads that deal <electro>Electro DMG</electro> from her Astral Abacus.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to charge and unleash a continuous stream of Electro beads, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro> to up to 4 targets every 0.3s.
charged.2: Somnia gains resistance to interruption and is free to move while using her Charged Attack.

plunging.1: Fires Electro beads at the ground, dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> upon impact.

description.0: Somnia condenses immense energy from her Astral Abacus to create an explosion that deals <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> and create a Self-Containing Sigil with undefinable contents above her head.
description.1: The Self-Containing Sigil grants her the Schrödinger Superposition effect.
description.3: Schrödinger Superposition
description.4: DMG dealt by Somnia's Normal and Charged Attacks is increased based on her Elemental Mastery.
description.5: Schrödinger Superposition expires after Self-Containing Sigil's duration ends or when Somnia leaves the field.

description.0: Somnia summons a star-shaped Celestial Cyclone around her, unleashing a burst of <electro>Electro DMG</electro> as it expands. The field will linger and deal continuous <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> to enemies within every 1s.
description.1: While Celestial Cyclone is active, Somnia's Elemental Mastery will be increased multiplicatively.
description.2: Additionally, while Celestial Cyclone is active, Somnia gains Stellar Statistics. While in this state, Somnia can set her Astral Abacus to the Multiplication, Addition or Subtraction modes, each granting her attacks and Celestial Cyclone different buffs. Only one Abacus mode from Stellar Statistics may be active simultaneously.
description.4: Abacus Modes
5: Multiplication: Within Somnia's Celestial Cyclone, all Sword-, Claymore- and Polearm-wielding characters' weapons will be infused with Electro. Normal or Charged Attack hits within the field will trigger Star Sunder, a coordinated Electro blast that deals AoE Electro DMG based on Somnia's Elemental Mastery. Star Sunder can be triggered once every 1.5s.

Addition: Celestial Cyclone's AoE and DMG are increased. Upon hitting an enemy, Somnia's Normal and Charged attacks will trigger a Supernova that deals AoE Electro DMG based on her Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 0.75s.

Subtraction: Celestial Cyclone has its AoE and DMG reduced, but applies the "Less Than Three" effect to enemies within it. "Less Than Three" reduces enemy Elemental and Physical RES based on Somnia's Elemental Mastery. Additionally, Somnia's Normal and Charged Attacks deal increased DMG based on her Elemental Mastery.

description.0: Somnia's Charged Attacks consume 20% less Stamina and charge up 20% faster.
For the duration of Celestial Cyclone, Somnia's Elemental Mastery increases by 5% for every hit dealt by Celestial Cyclone, Star Sunder and Supernova, up to a maximum of 25%.
At night (18:00 - 6:00), speeds up Genshin Optimizer build speed by 10%.
Somnia's Normal and Charged Attacks have a 25% chance to deal twice the DMG.

When Somnia is under the Schrödinger Superposition effect, each Normal or Charged Attack hit will give Somnia a stack of Natural Number. When the amount of Natural Number stacks is prime, Somnia's next Normal or Charged Attack will receive twice the DMG increase from Schrödinger Superposition.
Increases the Level of Parallax Paws by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When Somnia triggers an Electro reaction, 4 Elemental Energy is restored to herself and all nearby party members of Elements involved in the reaction.
description.1: This effect can trigger once every 4s.

description.0: Increases the Level of Cosmic Calculator by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When Somnia's Charged Attack deals damage, her CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG are increased by 3% and 5%, respectively. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s and stack up to 8 times. All Golden Ratio stacks are cleared 13s after the first stack was obtained.

page_error.p1.1: GO has experienced an unexpected error. This is probably our fault, so please help us help you!
page_error.p1.2: Here are some things you can try to resolve the issue:

fixes.2: Disable any browser extensions and refresh again
fixes.3: Download your DB(s) from below and keep it somewhere safe. Click the 'Delete ALL GO Data' button and reupload your DB(s)

page_error.p2: If you did the above and still managed to get back here, please submit a report to our GitHub Issues page, or to the Bug Reports channel in our Discord

report.2: Copy the report text from the box below
report.3: Click <1>here</1> to report on GitHub. Paste the text in the description, fill in the reproduction steps, and include your JSON files (you might need to rename them to end with '.txt')
report.4: Or click <1>here</1> to report on Discord. Open the #🐛bug-reports channel, create a new thread and paste the text in the message box. Fill in the reproduction steps and upload your JSON files.

page_error.caption: Live footage of our engineers investigating the problem

page_scanner.intro: <0>Scanners<1>Scanners are Genshin tools that can automatically scan game data from screenshots or directly from the game.<2>Below are several scanners that have been tested with GO.<3>To upload the exported file, go to the <1>Settings page and upload your file in the Database Upload section.

setEffects.4: When a character attacks an opponent affected by Cryo, their CRIT Rate is increased by 20%. If the opponent is Frozen, CRIT Rate is increased by an additional 20%.

flower.name: Snowswept Memory
flower.desc: A long-extinct flower, covered in beads of frost, that once grew on the glaciers. There was a time when even the proudest and most arrogant warriors bowed before it.

plume.name: Icebreaker's Resolve
plume.desc: A feather that exudes a chilly aura. One can almost feel the turbulent winds that brought it here, wailing over snow-covered plains and between frosty peaks.

sands.name: Frozen Homeland's Demise
sands.desc: A timepiece from a nation of old that waited for their warriors' return. What flows inside is not sand, but bits of ice that never melt.

goblet.name: Frost-Weaved Dignity
goblet.desc: A cup carved out of ice that is as chilly and biting as winter. Its former master would drink an unfreezable liquor from it.

circlet.name: Broken Rime's Echo
circlet.desc: The crown of an ancient hero who dreamt of conquering the cold. It is proof of its former master's bravery in facing the bone-chilling cold of winter.

setEffects.4: After defeating an opponent, increases Charged Attack DMG by 50%, and reduces its Stamina cost to 0 for 10s.

flower.name: Bloodstained Flower of Iron
flower.desc: A dried flower stained black with blood and now as hard as steel. Probably some sort of a memento for its former master.

plume.name: Bloodstained Black Plume
plume.desc: A raven feather pinned to a knight's cape. Countless bloodstains have dyed it pitch black.

sands.name: Bloodstained Final Hour
sands.desc: A timepiece once used by a knight. The liquid inside has dried up, rendering it useless.

goblet.name: Bloodstained Chevalier's Goblet
goblet.desc: The dark metallic vessel owned by the Bloodstained Knight. Its exterior has been stained as black as the night by smoke and coagulated blood.

circlet.name: Bloodstained Iron Mask
circlet.desc: The iron mask the knight used to conceal their identity. Many have speculated about the face behind the mask.

setEffects.4: Increases DMG by 30% against opponents with more than 50% HP.

flower.name: Medal of the Brave
flower.desc: A simple flower brooch that is a keepsake from someone's first adventure.

plume.name: Prospect of the Brave
plume.desc: A shimmering feather from a songbird that brings a nudge of courage to its wearer.

sands.name: Fortitude of the Brave
sands.desc: A dated miniature hourglass that serves no practical purpose. It seems as elusive as time itself.

goblet.name: Outset of the Brave
goblet.desc: A crude wooden vessel filled only with memories.

circlet.name: Crown of the Brave
circlet.desc: A rough-and-ready laurel wreath that seems as precious as a king's golden crown.

setEffects.4: If the equipping character has completed Witch's Homework, after they use an Elemental Skill, they gain "Light's Guidance" for 20s: All nearby party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus corresponding to the equipping character's Elemental Type. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field. DMG Bonuses provided by Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.\n· When your party has the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, Light's Guidance is upgraded to "Mortal Hymn": All nearby party members gain a 40% Elemental DMG Bonus corresponding to both the equipping character and the current active party member's Elemental Type instead. If both characters have the same Elemental Type, these bonuses will not stack.

flower.name: Heavensent Fragrance
flower.desc: The high heavens bestowed an everlasting flower on their envoy, and greed was born of a life without end.

plume.name: Heavensent Demise
plume.desc: The high heavens bestowed a feather of rebirth on their envoy, with all sin to be forgiven where even fate meets its very end.

sands.name: Heavensent Decree
sands.desc: The high heavens bestowed a sundial of counter-time on their envoy, and an inviolable interdiction became a wellspring of rage.

goblet.name: Heavensent Reward
goblet.desc: The high heavens bestowed sweet nectar on their envoy, and the unending feast opened wide the doors to desire.

circlet.name: Heavensent Crown
circlet.desc: The high heavens bestowed a splendid crown on their envoy, and arrogance was born out of power unchecked.

setEffects.4: Increases Overloaded, Burning, and Burgeon DMG by 40%. Increases Vaporize and Melt DMG by 15%. Using Elemental Skill increases the 2-Piece Set Bonus by 50% of its starting value for 10s. Max 3 stacks.

flower.name: Witch's Flower of Blaze
flower.desc: A flower touched by the witch who once dreamt of burning away all the demons in the world. The anonymous flames affectionately caress the hands of those who touch it.

plume.name: Witch's Ever-Burning Plume
plume.desc: A bird feather touched by the witch who once dreamt of burning away all the demons in the world. Its eternal flame burns hot.

sands.name: Witch's End Time
sands.desc: A timepiece worn by the witch who dreamt of burning away all the demons in the world. The years the witch dedicated to the flames flow within.

goblet.name: Witch's Heart Flames
goblet.desc: A flame-spitting urn left behind by the Crimson Witch of Flames, who once dreamt of burning away all the demons in the world. The fire in the urn burns eternally, as did its former master.

circlet.name: Witch's Scorching Hat
circlet.desc: A hat once worn by the witch who dreamt of burning away all of the demons in the world. The large brim blocked her sight.

setEffects.4: After Elemental Skills or Bursts hit opponents, the targets' Dendro RES will be decreased by 30% for 8s. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is not on the field.

flower.name: Labyrinth Wayfarer
flower.desc: This lovely gold-plated flower was plucked from the crown of the ruler of the forest.

plume.name: Scholar of Vines
plume.desc: An emerald leaf as fluffy as a feather. Plucked from the raiment of a forest scholar.

sands.name: A Time of Insight
sands.desc: Such timepieces are used by those who dedicate themselves to the way of the wise. These timepieces do not contain lifeless sand, but instead play host to tiny mustard seeds.

goblet.name: Lamp of the Lost
goblet.desc: This was originally an oil lamp in the style of the desert realm, but has since sprouted fluorescent green leaves.

circlet.name: Laurel Coronet
circlet.desc: This crown was bestowed by the deity with dominion over plants and trees. It was an heirloom of the royal house of the labyrinth. It was, at last, made the inheritance of the king's attendant.

setEffects.4: For each different element present in your own party, the wearer's Elemental RES to that corresponding element is increased by 30%.

flower.name: Guardian's Flower
flower.desc: An iris that was cherished by the guardian. Unfortunately, the chance never came for it to be given to whom the guardian loved.

plume.name: Guardian's Sigil
plume.desc: A feather-shaped brooch that symbolizes someone's yearning to defend others like a shield.

sands.name: Guardian's Clock
sands.desc: A small timekeeping gadget. On moonless nights, it was the only way its former owner could know the time.

goblet.name: Guardian's Vessel
goblet.desc: A metal vessel that can be filled with a drink to dispel the loneliness of the long watch.

circlet.name: Guardian's Band
circlet.desc: A fabric band dyed indigo by the darkness of night. Can also double as a bandage in the event of an emergency.

setEffects.4: When Charged Attacks hit opponents, the equipping character's Normal Attack SPD will increase by 10% while Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG will increase by 40% for 15s.

flower.name: The First Days of the City of Kings
flower.desc: An artificial flower that shimmers with a strange light. If you incline your ear to it, you can vaguely hear charming laughter issuing from within.

plume.name: End of the Golden Realm
plume.desc: A crystal-clear artificial feather that is one of the legacies of an ancient human realm. The cries of soaring eagles are also sealed within.

sands.name: Timepiece of the Lost Path
sands.desc: An ancient mechanical clock. The Jinni fragments continue to emit light at its center and vibrate ever so slightly, as if to say something...

goblet.name: Defender of the Enchanting Dream
goblet.desc: An ancient golden cup that is both marvelously and luxuriously wrought. Murmurings can be heard within its empty innards.

circlet.name: Legacy of the Desert High-Born
circlet.desc: Earrings made from amber gold that shines with a strange light.

setEffects.4: Increases Superconduct Reaction DMG by 80% and Stellar-Conduct Reaction DMG by 40%. When the wielder attacks opponents affected by Superconduct or Stellar-Conduct, this attack's CRIT Rate is increased by 16%.

flower.name: Iridescence That Ceased Amidst Glory
flower.desc: It was a flower made of silk, gifted to her by a friend whose hands were as cold as ice.

plume.name: Sharpness That Ceased Upon Wondrous Creation
plume.desc: It was a feathered quill given to her followers, once used to pen the most absurd of dreams.

sands.name: Moment That Ceased Upon Waking From Grand Dreams
sands.desc: It was a fleeting moment she gave a certain silent alchemist to remind him of every item on his schedule.

goblet.name: Ovations That Ceased Upon Festivity
goblet.desc: It was a goblet of wine she had accepted in celebration from the hands of a colleague.

circlet.name: Pendulum That Ceased Amidst a Great Fall
circlet.desc: It was a delicate trinket awarded to her in praise by the hand of her only master.

setEffects.4: When Normal Attacks hit opponents, there is a 36% chance that it will trigger Valley Rite, which will increase Normal Attack DMG by 70% of ATK. This effect will be dispelled 0.05s after a Normal Attack deals DMG. If a Normal Attack fails to trigger Valley Rite, the odds of it triggering the next time will increase by 20%. This trigger can occur once every 0.2s.

flower.name: Soulscent Bloom
flower.desc: A jade carved into the shape of a flower. A phantom scent, here one instant and gone the next, swirls around it.

plume.name: Jade Leaf
plume.desc: A jade ornament shaped like a leaf. It seems to have once had deep meaning between specific friends.

sands.name: Symbol of Felicitation
sands.desc: A circular jade ornament. Legend has it that it was once used somewhere as a symbol for rituals to begin.

goblet.name: Chalice of the Font
goblet.desc: This teacup forever overflows with fresh water. Perhaps it was a gift from an adeptus, one of their relics, or just something they left behind.

circlet.name: Flowing Rings
circlet.desc: A pair of earrings made from a single piece of jade. It has a most gentle texture.

setEffects.4: Increases Elemental Burst DMG by 25% of Energy Recharge. A maximum of 75% bonus DMG can be obtained in this way.

flower.name: Magnificent Tsuba
flower.desc: Legends hold that this ornate hand guard was once fitted upon a sword gifted to the oni who betrayed the Shogun.

plume.name: Sundered Feather
plume.desc: This was once the black feather of a certain tengu warrior, and was the treasured souvenir of an ancient swordsman.

sands.name: Storm Cage
sands.desc: An exquisite seal cage patterned with pansies painted upon a black backdrop, decorated with shining inlaid seashells and intricate gold-work.

goblet.name: Scarlet Vessel
goblet.desc: An intricately-designed wine vessel that a world-famous martial artist once drank from.

circlet.name: Ornate Kabuto
circlet.desc: A sturdy and hard helmet worn as armor by a noble samurai.

setEffects.4: When the equipping character has 0 Elemental Energy, Normal Attack DMG is increased by 60% and Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 60%. After the equipping character deals Normal Attack DMG, the aforementioned Elemental Burst effect will stop applying for 6s. After the equipping character deals Elemental Burst DMG, the aforementioned Normal Attack effect will stop applying for 6s. This effect can trigger even if the equipping character is off the field.

flower.name: Deep Gallery's Echoing Song
flower.desc: An icy flower fashioned from northland jade. Over the course of its long life, its petals have crumbled to dust.

plume.name: Deep Gallery's Distant Pact
plume.desc: A feathered accessory fashioned from northland jade that shimmers with an otherworldly glow.

sands.name: Deep Gallery's Moment of Oblivion
sands.desc: A pocket watch fashioned from northland jade. Its hands are forever frozen in the moment of its destruction.

goblet.name: Deep Gallery's Bestowed Banquet
goblet.desc: A cup fashioned from northland jade. They say that the people of an ancient civilization once used it as a ceremonial vessel to make offerings to the heavens.

circlet.name: Deep Gallery's Lost Crown
circlet.desc: A helmet steeped in obsession, just like the mind of its previous owner. Its jade ornamentation seems to come from an age more ancient still.

setEffects.4: The equipping character's Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon reaction DMG are increased by 40%, and their Lunar-Bloom reaction DMG is increased by 10%. Additionally, after the equipping character triggers Bloom, Hyperbloom, Lunar-Bloom, or Burgeon, they will gain another 25% bonus to the effects mentioned prior. Each stack of this lasts 10s. Max 4 stacks simultaneously. This effect can only be triggered once per second. The character who equips this can still trigger its effects when not on the field.

flower.name: Ay-Khanoum's Myriad
flower.desc: An amethyst bloom that has been beautifully sculpted in the image of an ancient, extinct flower.

plume.name: Wilting Feast
plume.desc: A feather left behind by a long-extinct bird species. It was inlaid with gold and gems by the ancient adherents of the Goddess of Flowers.

sands.name: A Moment Congealed
sands.desc: These sands no longer move no matter how you tilt the hourglass, now and forever defying the drift of time itself.

goblet.name: Secret-Keeper's Magic Bottle
goblet.desc: A small bottle made of purple crystal. An emerald cap keeps it tightly sealed.

circlet.name: Amethyst Crown
circlet.desc: A crown inlaid with amethyst and emerald. It seems to have been the headgear worn by ancient priests of the Goddess of Flowers.

setEffects.4: When the value of a Bond of Life increases or decreases, this character deals 18% increased DMG for 6s. Max 3 stacks.

flower.name: Harmonious Symphony Prelude
flower.desc: An honorary medal in the shape of a blooming flower. Adorned with blue stone and gold, it was once bestowed upon immortals.

plume.name: Ancient Sea's Nocturnal Musing
plume.desc: A feather accessory carved in the shape of the wings of the golden bees of legend. They seem to flutter with the slightest breeze.

sands.name: The Grand Jape of the Turning of Fate
sands.desc: A timepiece made in imitation of the wheel of fate. It ceased turning long ago.

goblet.name: Ichor Shower Rhapsody
goblet.desc: A rhyton fired with copper as the base, that was once filled with fine wine from paradise.

circlet.name: Whimsical Dance of the Withered
circlet.desc: A mask once covered in gold leaf. Perhaps it is a relic from some ancient officer of the legions.

setEffects.4: Defeating an opponent has a 100% chance to remove Elemental Skill CD. Can only occur once every 15s.

flower.name: Gambler's Brooch
flower.desc: A big, luxurious flower that can hide loaded dice.

plume.name: Gambler's Feather Accessory
plume.desc: The tail feather of a large bird. Perfect for discretely concealing a trump card.

sands.name: Gambler's Pocket Watch
sands.desc: A shattered pocket watch that once took a lethal hit for its owner.

goblet.name: Gambler's Dice Cup
goblet.desc: This vessel was specially made for a single purpose. It has absolutely no secret compartments built into it.

circlet.name: Gambler's Earrings
circlet.desc: A pair of blue earrings that, when worn, calm the mind and encourage a rational assessment of risks.

setEffects.4: Within 8s of triggering an Elemental Reaction, the character equipping this will obtain buffs based on the Elemental Type of the other party members. ATK is increased by 14% for each party member whose Elemental Type is the same as the equipping character, and Elemental Mastery is increased by 50 for every party member with a different Elemental Type. Each of the aforementioned buffs will count up to 3 characters. This effect can be triggered once every 8s. The character who equips this can still trigger its effects when not on the field.

flower.name: Dreaming Steelbloom
flower.desc: A flower bud made of hammered dark gold. Its crimson core is wrapped by petals that shall never open.

plume.name: Feather of Judgment
plume.desc: This special feather was once used to weigh the hearts of the guilty, but it has since lost its original function.

sands.name: The Sunken Years
sands.desc: This dark-golden sundial seems to tell the ancient tale of the desert.

goblet.name: Honeyed Final Feast
goblet.desc: A wine cup that was once used at a grand and ancient feast. It has now lost much of that luster.

circlet.name: Shadow of the Sand King
circlet.desc: This gold-inlaid headband was once used by desert priests in the days of old. They were made in imitation of one worn by a legendary ruler of the desert peoples.

setEffects.4: If the wielder of this artifact set uses a Sword, Claymore or Polearm, increases their Normal Attack DMG by 35%.

flower.name: Gladiator's Nostalgia
flower.desc: No one knows why the legendary gladiator wore this flower on his chest. It was the brutal warrior's only weakness.

plume.name: Gladiator's Destiny
plume.desc: A feather of dreams that soars free like an eagle. At the end of the gladiator's legendary life, this parting gift was left upon his chest by a bird that knew true freedom.

sands.name: Gladiator's Longing
sands.desc: A timepiece that recorded the gladiator's days in the bloodstained Colosseum. To him, it counted down the days on his long road to freedom.

goblet.name: Gladiator's Intoxication
goblet.desc: The golden cup a champion gladiator drank from in ancient times. It brimmed with his glory for years until the fateful day of his fall.

circlet.name: Gladiator's Triumphus
circlet.desc: The helmet of a legendary gladiator from ancient times, who would proudly stretch out his bloodied arms to welcome the thunderous applause of his audience.

setEffects.4: Increases Elemental Skill DMG by 25%. Additionally, when not on the field, Elemental Skill DMG will be further increased by 25%. This effect will be cleared 2s after taking the field.

flower.name: Golden Song's Variation
flower.desc: A flower constructed out of clam, mother-of-pearl, and gold leaf. It blooms proudly.

plume.name: Golden Bird's Shedding
plume.desc: A gold feather made using silver and gold filigree. A crystal-clear sapphire is mounted atop it.

sands.name: Golden Era's Prelude
sands.desc: This lovely sundial is inlaid with silver and gold. It seems that time has stopped flowing atop its dial plate.

goblet.name: Golden Night's Bustle
goblet.desc: An ancient silver urn that was once filled with fine wine as red as rubies. Now, it contains nothing but bitter seawater.

circlet.name: Golden Troupe's Reward
circlet.desc: An ancient crown that resembles a stage prop more than it does some suzerain's headgear.

setEffects.4: After using Elemental Skill, increases Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG by 30% for 15s.

flower.name: Gilded Corsage
flower.desc: A mantle brooch that has lost its luster. The gold plating that once adorned it was ground away by the wind and the waves long ago.

plume.name: Gust of Nostalgia
plume.desc: A feather carried over by whimpering sea winds and crimson waves. The passage of time has changed its shape and color.

sands.name: Copper Compass
sands.desc: An ancient bronze compass. Its needle points towards some ever-distant shore, to a non-existent harbor.

goblet.name: Goblet of Thundering Deep
goblet.desc: A faded wine cup that was unintentionally dredged up from the sea. Its dull exterior tells of the days it has spent beneath the waves.

circlet.name: Wine-Stained Tricorne
circlet.desc: An ancient, wine-stained sea hat that still reeks of alcohol even now.

setEffects.4: Increases the equipping character's ATK by 12% for 12s when they trigger a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deal Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Also increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members by 50%. The above effects can trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field, and the DMG bonus from multiple Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.

flower.name: Foundryman's Conjecture
flower.desc: He knew that, unlike the temperature at the heart of the furnace, just how warm or cold a human heart is towards another cannot be clearly measured in degrees.

plume.name: Foundryman's Observation
plume.desc: He knew that, unlike the colors at the heart of the furnace, the outcome of various worldly affairs could not be predicted simply through close observation.

sands.name: Foundryman's Calculus
sands.desc: He knew that, unlike the heat at the heart of the furnace, the workings of power could not be controlled by the simple pull of a lever or the press of a button.

goblet.name: Foundryman's Magnanimity
goblet.desc: He knew that, unlike the flame at the heart of the furnace, which would continue burning indefinitely so long as it is supplied with fuel, friendship was far more fleeting.

circlet.name: Foundryman's Legacy
circlet.desc: He knew that, unlike the flame at the heart of the furnace, the resolve to pursue a dream could never be simply passed on to those to come after.

setEffects.4: A character equipped with this Artifact set will obtain the Curiosity effect in the following conditions: When on the field, the character gains 1 stack after hitting an opponent with a Geo attack, triggering a maximum of once every 0.3s. When off the field, the character gains 1 stack every 3s. Curiosity can stack up to 4 times, each providing 6% DEF and a 6% Geo DMG Bonus. When 6 seconds pass without gaining a Curiosity stack, 1 stack is lost.

flower.name: Bloom Times
flower.desc: A small golden ornament with six petals that shall never wilt. It symbolizes the transience of mortal glories.

plume.name: Plume of Luxury
plume.desc: A feather-shaped token that was brought forth from a secluded hall. The compassion of its creator led to it being left within that mansion along with a certain slumbering form.

sands.name: Song of Life
sands.desc: As far as Inazuma is concerned, this is some small object from overseas. The heart of this mechanism has been removed, and its hands no longer turn.

goblet.name: Calabash of Awakening
goblet.desc: A gourd that has been adorned with powdered gold and black paint. Its original color can no longer be discerned, but its main use seems to be as a performance prop.

circlet.name: Skeletal Hat
circlet.desc: A hat that once shielded a wanderer from sun and rain. It eventually became a convenient tool with which faces might be hidden and expressions obscured.

setEffects.4: Upon triggering an Elemental Reaction, increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 120 for 8s.

flower.name: Instructor's Brooch
flower.desc: Whenever the instructor wore this brooch, it meant there would be no training sessions that day.

plume.name: Instructor's Feather Accessory
plume.desc: Any instructor who has mastered the art of de-escalation knows to keep this accessory firmly in their grasp at all times.

sands.name: Instructor's Pocket Watch
sands.desc: A stopwatch used not for general timekeeping but to measure the duration of a training session.

goblet.name: Instructor's Tea Cup
goblet.desc: It may seem like an ordinary tea cup to most. But to students, it is the symbol of the instructor's authority.

circlet.name: Instructor's Cap
circlet.desc: A standard-issue honorary instructor's cap, only granted to those who turn down a promotion.

setEffects.4: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Pyro by 35%.

flower.name: Lavawalker's Resolution
flower.desc: A flower that blooms amidst burning flames. It is said that long ago, a sage once wore it as he walked into a sea of fire.

plume.name: Lavawalker's Salvation
plume.desc: The feather of a proud phoenix. You can almost hear the sound of its wings flapping in the scorching flames.

sands.name: Lavawalker's Torment
sands.desc: Burning sand flows within this hourglass. Despite the intense heat, the sand leave no mark upon the vessel that houses it.

goblet.name: Lavawalker's Epiphany
goblet.desc: A legendary goblet that can withstand extremely high temperatures. It still retains a degree of warmth even though it is now empty.

circlet.name: Lavawalker's Wisdom
circlet.desc: The circlet of a sage who traversed a sea of fire. It once shone brightly from their ancient silhouette as they stood strong amidst the flames.

setEffects.4: After the equipping character's Plunging Attack/Charged Attack/Elemental Skill hits an opponent, they will gain 1/2/2 stack(s) of "Radiance Everlasting." Plunging Attacks, Charged Attacks, or Elemental Skills can each trigger this effect once every 1s. Radiance Everlasting: Plunging Attacks deal 15% increased DMG for 6s. Max 5 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.

flower.name: Lightkeeper's Pledge
flower.desc: A metal flower that was worn by the Ratniki. It symbolizes the oath of eternal vigilance taken by its original owner.

plume.name: Nightingale's Tail Feather
plume.desc: A hat ornament intricately crafted from the feathers of a nightingale. They say that its form was first conceived by the original Torchforger.

sands.name: Undying One's Mourning Bell
sands.desc: A bronze bell that was carried by a warrior who walked through the dark abyss. Its peal can be heard on pitch-black nights.

goblet.name: A Horn Unwinded
goblet.desc: A horn that was once used to summon those who had sworn oaths. It has long since lost its purpose.

circlet.name: Dyed Tassel
circlet.desc: An ancient heavy helmet. It is an heirloom that bears the mark of a venerable lineage of northern warriors.

setEffects.4: Picking up Mora restores 300 HP.

flower.name: Lucky Dog's Clover
flower.desc: A four-leaf clover that grows in the wild. It was picked because it is said to bring good luck.

plume.name: Lucky Dog's Eagle Feather
plume.desc: A monster once cornered an adventurer, but was then picked off by a hunting eagle... That eagle dropped this feather, which now carries some of the adventurer's good luck.

sands.name: Lucky Dog's Hourglass
sands.desc: A broken hourglass from which all the sand has escaped. But it's fine, because the passage of time means nothing to someone without a single worry in the whole world.

goblet.name: Lucky Dog's Goblet
goblet.desc: An exquisite metallic vessel that was once used to knock out a thief.

circlet.name: Lucky Dog's Silver Circlet
circlet.desc: Its former owner once fell into a cave and found the treasure trove of an exiled royal. This is a souvenir from that incident.

setEffects.4: Using an Elemental Skill or Burst increases healing received by all party members by 20% for 10s.

flower.name: Maiden's Distant Love
flower.desc: A fragrant flower that will bloom for all eternity and never wither.

plume.name: Maiden's Heart-stricken Infatuation
plume.desc: A feathered accessory that carries the longing for a certain someone, like a migratory bird on the wind.

sands.name: Maiden's Passing Youth
sands.desc: The hands of time will never come to an end, but the same cannot not be said for those cherished years of the young maiden's life when she was doted upon.

goblet.name: Maiden's Fleeting Leisure
goblet.desc: A vessel made with sweet black tea in mind rather than bitter liquor.

circlet.name: Maiden's Fading Beauty
circlet.desc: A meticulously well-maintained woman's hat that keeps wrinkles safely out of sight.

setEffects.4: When current HP increases or decreases, CRIT Rate will be increased by 12% for 5s. Max 3 stacks.

flower.name: Hunter's Brooch
flower.desc: An ancient emblem that was once awarded to those who had made exceptional contributions in battle.

plume.name: Masterpiece's Overture
plume.desc: A portable tool used to adjust the torque on some old-school clockwork machine. It has since lost its practical value.

sands.name: Moment of Judgment
sands.desc: A standard pocket watch. Its accuracy is not particularly high.

goblet.name: Forgotten Vessel
goblet.desc: A portable metal vessel containing strong wine. Can be stuffed into the pocket of an outer coat for ease of access and use.

circlet.name: Veteran's Visage
circlet.desc: An old mask that can, to some extent, stand in for a face marred by wounds. Its design can vary based on the wounded areas and the user's gender.

setEffects.4: After using Elemental Skill, increases Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG by 25% for 8s.

flower.name: Martial Artist's Red Flower
flower.desc: This particular kind of red flower was the only thing that could alleviate the Martial Artist's pain.

plume.name: Martial Artist's Feather Accessory
plume.desc: A common bird feather. Experts use it to practice strength control, while rookies use it to make fans.

sands.name: Martial Artist's Water Hourglass
sands.desc: A tool to keep track of time in endurance training. It is more accurate and reliable than a regular hourglass.

goblet.name: Martial Artist's Wine Cup
goblet.desc: A rather exquisite wine cup used in pre-combat rituals.

circlet.name: Martial Artist's Bandana
circlet.desc: The first lesson as an apprentice: Vigor, Strength, Will. These words are written on the bandana so you'll never forget them.

setEffects.4: When nearby party members trigger Lunar Reactions, if the equipping character is on the field, gain the Gleaming Moon: Intent effect for 4s: Increases CRIT Rate by 15%/30% when the party's Moonsign is Nascent Gleam/Ascendant Gleam. All party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is increased by 10% for each different Gleaming Moon effect that party members have. Effects from Gleaming Moon cannot stack.

flower.name: Bloom of the Mind's Desire
flower.desc: A sacred relic carved in the shape of a flower. It seems to represent a terrifying presence that unfurls like a bloom.

plume.name: Feather of Indelible Sin
plume.desc: A feathered accessory once worn on a felt hat. It feels out of place among the nobles of Snezhnaya and their taste for splendor.

sands.name: Revelation's Toll
sands.desc: An exquisite chiming clock driven by a mysterious power. It does not seem that timekeeping is its purpose.

goblet.name: Vessel of Plenty
goblet.desc: A specially crafted goblet used for palace banquets. It was once employed to perform some kind of magic.

circlet.name: Crown of the Befallen
circlet.desc: A crown modeled on the circlet worn by a sinner. Perhaps in someone's heart, love and sin flow from the same source.

artifact_NighttimeWhispersInTheEchoingWo.setName: Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods

setEffects.4: After using an Elemental Skill, gain a 20% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s. When under a shield granted by the Crystallize reaction, or when Moondrifts formed by Lunar-Crystallize reactions are nearby, the above effect is increased by 150%. When these conditions are no longer met, this additional increase disappears after 1s.

flower.name: Selfless Floral Accessory
flower.desc: A brooch that the witch in the tale wore. As with the other ornaments she loved, this was characterized by butterfly-like shapes.

plume.name: Honest Quill
plume.desc: The witch in the tale used this dip pen. Among its various advantages, its silky-smooth writing is the least worthy of mention.

sands.name: Faithful Hourglass
sands.desc: A sand timepiece that the witch relied on in the story. Legend has it that if you recite the wrong incantation over it, time will suddenly flow exceptionally quickly.

goblet.name: Magnanimous Ink Bottle
goblet.desc: An ink bottle utilized by the witch in the story. It possesses a strange enchantment no less powerful than the one cast upon the dip pen.

circlet.name: Compassionate Ladies' Hat
circlet.desc: The lady's hat favored by the witch in the story. She loved this piece of headwear for how it weaves together solemnity and playfulness.

setEffects.4: Using an Elemental Burst increases all party members' ATK by 20% for 12s. This effect cannot stack.

flower.name: Royal Flora
flower.desc: A satin flower with a glossy finish, fit for an elegant gathering. It still looks as distinguished as it did on the day it was cast aside.

plume.name: Royal Plume
plume.desc: A feathered hat accessory worn by the old aristocrats of Mondstadt on hunts. It still stands proudly as if no time has passed.

sands.name: Royal Pocket Watch
sands.desc: A pocket watch that once belonged to the old aristocrats of Mondstadt. Passed down from generation to generation, it has witnessed many years of history.

goblet.name: Royal Silver Urn
goblet.desc: An ornamental urn that once belonged to the old aristocrats of Mondstadt. Mournful winds seem to echo within its empty interior.

circlet.name: Royal Masque
circlet.desc: A masquerade mask worn by the old aristocrats of Mondstadt. Its hollow eyes are fixated on the golden days of the past.

setEffects.4: After Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts hit opponents, 1 stack of Mirrored Nymph will be triggered, lasting 8s. When under the effect of 1, 2, or 3 or more Mirrored Nymph stacks, ATK will be increased by 7%/16%/25%, and Hydro DMG Bonus will be increased by 4%/9%/15%. Mirrored Nymph stacks created by Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts exist independently.

flower.name: Odyssean Flower
flower.desc: The story must end, and even fresh flowers will wither. But the flower within one's dreams will always remain in full and fragrant bloom.

plume.name: Wicked Mage's Plumule
plume.desc: This was once a decorative feather in someone's hat. Being dark green, it is quite eye-catching indeed.

sands.name: Nymph's Constancy
sands.desc: A pocket watch that has long stopped working. It seems to have borne witness to many a passing year as its hands spun in vain.

goblet.name: Heroes' Tea Party
goblet.desc: A lovely teacup. Perhaps it was once used by people enjoying a leisurely afternoon together.

circlet.name: Fell Dragon's Monocle
circlet.desc: An exquisitely-made monocle. Ancient anecdotes say that one might be able to see the future through it.

setEffects.2: While the equipping character is in Nightsoul's Blessing and is on the field, their DMG dealt is increased by 15%.
setEffects.4: After the equipping character consumes 1 Nightsoul point while on the field, CRIT Rate increases by 40% for 6s. This effect can trigger once every second.

flower.name: Reckoning of the Xenogenic
flower.desc: A flower meticulously carved from black crystal. It emits a mysterious light at night.

plume.name: Root of the Spirit-Marrow
plume.desc: A feathered accessory made in imitation of an ancient dragon's wing. Perhaps it was once a memento of some forgotten history.

sands.name: Myths of the Night Realm
sands.desc: A mysterious ritual element that is neither a timepiece nor a compass. Nowadays, no one has any idea what it is used for.

goblet.name: Pre-Banquet of the Contenders
goblet.desc: A vessel that seems to have been made by twisting and forming stone in a seemingly whimsical fashion. But it is an open question as to who possesses such strength...

circlet.name: Crown of the Saints
circlet.desc: A crown made of obsidian that in ancient times was used in coronation ceremonies by noble tribal kings.

setEffects.4: When the character equipping this artifact set heals a character in the party, a Sea-Dyed Foam will appear for 3 seconds, accumulating the amount of HP recovered from healing (including overflow healing). At the end of the duration, the Sea-Dyed Foam will explode, dealing DMG to nearby opponents based on 90% of the accumulated healing. (This DMG is calculated similarly to Reactions such as Electro-Charged, and Superconduct, but is not affected by Elemental Mastery, Character Levels, or Reaction DMG Bonuses). Only one Sea-Dyed Foam can be produced every 3.5 seconds. Each Sea-Dyed Foam can accumulate up to 30,000 HP (including overflow healing). There can be no more than one Sea-Dyed Foam active at any given time. This effect can still be triggered even when the character who is using this artifact set is not on the field.

flower.name: Sea-Dyed Blossom
flower.desc: A soft flower that has taken on the many shades of the capricious ocean. It shines with wondrous colors under the moon's silver light.

plume.name: Deep Palace's Plume
plume.desc: A down feather with the same hue as coral, said to come from a shrine maiden's ceremonial garment.

sands.name: Cowry of Parting
sands.desc: A clean, flawless seashell that comes from the bottomless ocean.

goblet.name: Pearl Cage
goblet.desc: The shining pearls that the shrine maidens of Watatsumi Island offer up shine eternally and never dim.

circlet.name: Crown of Watatsumi
circlet.desc: An ancient, intricate crown that was once used by a forgotten clergy member. Today, this relic has been enshrined with great ceremony by the people of Watatsumi.

setEffects.4: When an Elemental Skill hits an opponent, ATK is increased by 9% for 7s. This effect stacks up to 2 times and can be triggered once every 0.3s. Once 2 stacks are reached, the 2-set effect is increased by 100%.

flower.name: Stainless Bloom
flower.desc: A hard, blue artificial flower. Its petals shall never wither, nor shall its colors fade.

plume.name: Wise Doctor's Pinion
plume.desc: An ominous pinion with edges of unsurpassed keenness. Perhaps it represents an unnaturally uninhibited nature.

sands.name: Moment of Cessation
sands.desc: A pocket watch with a cover that cannot be opened. Yet it ticks and tocks away, following the inexorable flow of time.

goblet.name: Surpassing Cup
goblet.desc: An intricately-made cup. Its appearance betrays nothing of its age to an observer.

circlet.name: Mocking Mask
circlet.desc: A mask that covers the face, hiding one's expression from others.

setEffects.1: Affected by Hydro for 40% less time.

circlet.name: Tiara of Torrents
circlet.desc: A tiara worn by those tasked with offering sacrifices in ancient times. Because it was submerged in water year in and year out, it possesses remarkable resistance.

setEffects.1: Affected by Pyro for 40% less time.

circlet.name: Tiara of Flame
circlet.desc: A tiara worn by those tasked with offering sacrifices in ancient times. After being subjected to the dancing sacrificial flames year in and year out, it possesses remarkable resistance.

setEffects.1: Affected by Electro for 40% less time.

circlet.name: Tiara of Thunder
circlet.desc: A tiara worn by those tasked with offering sacrifices in ancient times. Because it harkened to the call of thunder year in and year out, it possesses remarkable resistance.

setEffects.1: Affected by Cryo for 40% less time.

circlet.name: Tiara of Frost
circlet.desc: A tiara worn by those tasked with offering sacrifices in ancient times. Because it once weathered years of the icy cold, it possesses remarkable resistance.

setEffects.4: Increases Charged Attack CRIT Rate by 30%.

flower.name: Heart of Comradeship
flower.desc: A small cerulean flower with somebody's ribbon pinned to the stem.

plume.name: Feather of Homecoming
plume.desc: A blue arrow fletching imbued with the sentiment of travelers that had once faded into the horizon.

sands.name: Sundial of the Sojourner
sands.desc: A sundial that has survived the ages, always silently recording the cycles of the sun and moon as they pass through the sky.

goblet.name: Goblet of the Sojourner
goblet.desc: A plain porcelain goblet that was once brimming with joyous brews.

circlet.name: Crown of Parting
circlet.desc: A reed coronet that emanates the spring breeze.

setEffects.4: While protected by a shield, gain an additional 40% Normal and Charged Attack DMG.

flower.name: Summer Night's Bloom
flower.desc: A man-made flower in eternal bloom. Who knows if there truly is life in there?

plume.name: Summer Night's Finale
plume.desc: A well-crafted wooden dart. It will only stop once it has reached its destination.

sands.name: Summer Night's Moment
sands.desc: A pocketwatch that has stopped at a certain point in time.

goblet.name: Summer Night's Waterballoon
goblet.desc: Water balloons can be seen everywhere during the summer festival, but none are as finely-wrought as this one.

circlet.name: Summer Night's Mask
circlet.desc: A popular mask cast in the image of a deity, as described in the legends.

setEffects.4: Increases the equipping character's CRIT Rate by 16%, and their Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by 40%, for 10s after they trigger a Stellar Swirl reaction.

flower.name: Honor to Your Devotion
flower.desc: A bright red flower ornament that symbolizes blazing glory.

plume.name: Glory to Your Legacy
plume.desc: A bright red quill pen, granted to the youngest blood.

sands.name: Time Gifted Unto You
sands.desc: A bright red pocket watch marking the time allotted for a conversation.

goblet.name: Chalice of Your Blood and Sorrow
goblet.desc: A bright red wine bottle. May you never learn what's been in it.

circlet.name: Testament to Your Faith
circlet.desc: A bright red helmet. Hopefully it has, once upon a time, protected someone.

setEffects.4: Gaining Elemental Particles or Orbs gives 3 Energy to all party members who have a bow or a catalyst equipped. Can only occur once every 3s.

flower.name: Scholar's Bookmark
flower.desc: A dried flower used as a bookmark. It has absorbed the scent from the pages.

plume.name: Scholar's Quill Pen
plume.desc: A bird's feather that serves as a quill pen. The tip has long been stained black.

sands.name: Scholar's Clock
sands.desc: A small desktop clock, whose former owner was a scholar sat in a windowless room buried in books. This was probably the only reference they had to the time of day.

goblet.name: Scholar's Ink Cup
goblet.desc: Originally designed to hold drinking water, this cup was stained black after a scholar used it to wash their paint brushes.

circlet.name: Scholar's Lens
circlet.desc: This corrective lens helped restore the vision of one whose eyes were damaged from intensive studying.

artifact_ScrollOfTheHeroOfCinderCity_gen.setName: Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City

setEffects.2: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, the equipping character regenerates 6 Elemental Energy.
setEffects.4: After the equipping character triggers a reaction related to their Elemental Type, all nearby party members gain a 12% Elemental DMG Bonus for the Elemental Types involved in the elemental reaction for 15s. If the equipping character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state when triggering this effect, all nearby party members gain an additional 28% Elemental DMG Bonus for the Elemental Types involved in the elemental reaction for 20s. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field, and the DMG bonus from Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.

flower.name: Beast Tamer's Talisman
flower.desc: A flower carved from flint and Drakite, signifying that its bearer is qualified to become a beast tamer.

plume.name: Mountain Ranger's Marker
plume.desc: A signal used by mountain rangers to mark out paths. Their bird-feather shapes make them very eye-catching indeed.

sands.name: Mystic's Gold Dial
sands.desc: A golden disc shaped like a sun. The draconic patterns on it seem to symbolize the cycle of life and death.

goblet.name: Wandering Scholar's Claw Cup
goblet.desc: A strange goblet strikingly similar in shape to a dragon's claw. Its maker must have made it with something special in mind.

circlet.name: Demon-Warrior's Feather Mask
circlet.desc: A feather mask with falcon-esque plumage. Many legends surround this object.

setEffects.4: When casting an Elemental Skill, if the character has 15 or more Energy, they lose 15 Energy and Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 50% for 10s. This effect will not trigger again during that duration.

flower.name: Entangling Bloom
flower.desc: A lovely amulet made from twisted paper cord. It is said to hold the power to make wishes come true.

plume.name: Shaft of Remembrance
plume.desc: A demon-slaying arrow of a rather ancient make. It seems to have been preserved with great care by someone, even until the present day.

sands.name: Morning Dew's Moment
sands.desc: A bronze pocket watch adorned with twisted paper cord and a bell. Its hands are forever frozen at the dawn of a certain autumn day.

goblet.name: Hopeful Heart
goblet.desc: A special fortune-telling cylindrical object. The mechanism at the bottom allows one to easily remove all unwanted wish sticks.

circlet.name: Capricious Visage
circlet.desc: A well-preserved ceremonial fox mask. A small, enigmatic smile ever graces its lips.

setEffects.4: When dealing Elemental DMG, gain the Gleaming Moon: Devotion effect for 8s: Increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 60/120 when the party's Moonsign is Nascent Gleam/Ascendant Gleam. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field. All party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is increased by 10% for each different Gleaming Moon effect that party members have. Effects from Gleaming Moon cannot stack.

flower.name: Crystal Tear of the Wanderer
flower.desc: An immaculate flower whose beauty is said to have been preserved for eternity by the icy wind.

plume.name: Pristine Plume of the Blessed
plume.desc: An immaculate feathered accessory said to have been forged by the first Moonchanter herself.

sands.name: Frost Devotee's Delirium
sands.desc: An immaculate timepiece that long ago ceased turning, along with the delusions of its former owner.

goblet.name: Joyous Glory of the Pure
goblet.desc: An immaculate silver cup said to have been used in the bygone rituals of the Frostmoon Scions. Their modern rites have no need for such a vessel.

circlet.name: Holy Crown of the Believer
circlet.desc: An immaculate adornment created in imitation of the envoy of the grove's antlers.

setEffects.4: When the equipping character heals a party member, the Yearning effect will be created for 6s, which records the total amount of healing provided (including overflow healing). When the duration expires, the Yearning effect will be transformed into the "Waves of Days Past" effect: When your active party member hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, the DMG dealt will be increased by 8% of the total healing amount recorded by the Yearning effect. The "Waves of Days Past" effect is removed after it has taken effect 5 times or after 10s. A single instance of the Yearning effect can record up to 15,000 healing, and only a single instance can exist at once, but it can record the healing from multiple equipping characters. Equipping characters on standby can still trigger this effect.

flower.name: Forgotten Oath of Days Past
flower.desc: An ever-blooming flower shaped from larimar and shimmering silver. They say that this is still viewed as a symbol of resistance.

plume.name: Recollection of Days Past
plume.desc: A butterfly-shaped feather accessory made from silver and azure crystals. It is said to, in the distant past, have symbolized an oath to never be parted.

sands.name: Echoing Sound From Days Past
sands.desc: An oddly shaped hourglass made from lazurite and aqua jade. It was reportedly inspired by the bell tower in Petrichor.

goblet.name: Promised Dream of Days Past
goblet.desc: An opulent vessel made based on the form of the legendary "Pure Grail." It is said to be able to fulfill the wishes of the purest of people.

circlet.name: Poetry of Days Past
circlet.desc: A formal hat that was once in vogue amongst creators of opera in Fontaine. Word has it that its feathered adornment was based on the legendary helms of the Lochknights.

setEffects.4: When an Elemental Skill hits an opponent, the ATK of all nearby party members is increased by 20% and their Shield Strength is increased by 30% for 3s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This effect can still be triggered even when the character who is using this artifact set is not on the field.

flower.name: Flower of Accolades
flower.desc: A flower made from gold leaf. It represents the glories and honors attained by its wearer.

plume.name: Ceremonial War-Plume
plume.desc: A falcon feather worn on ceremonial occasions. It displays the dignity and resolve of Liyue Harbor to the outside world.

sands.name: Orichalceous Time-Dial
sands.desc: A simple device for telling time. This was once standard-issue for the Millelith during times of war.

goblet.name: Noble's Pledging Vessel
goblet.desc: A golden cup used by the Millelith to take their oaths. Still bears the lovely scent of wine.

circlet.name: General's Ancient Helm
circlet.desc: A splendorous helmet from ages past. Clean the dust away and it will look brand-new once more.

setEffects.4: Using an Elemental Burst regenerates 2 Energy for all party members (excluding the wearer) every 2s for 6s. This effect cannot stack.

flower.name: Exile's Flower
flower.desc: A withered flower worn on the shirt. Its former owner insisted on wearing it even in exile, so it must mean something.

plume.name: Exile's Feather
plume.desc: Not an actual accessory per se. Just a random bird feather that was found somewhere in the wilderness by the exile.

sands.name: Exile's Pocket Watch
sands.desc: Even after the crystal watch face was shattered and the hands lost, its former owner kept it until the end.

goblet.name: Exile's Goblet
goblet.desc: A dull goblet made of a heavy metal. It was once inlaid with gemstones, but they have since been stripped off.

circlet.name: Exile's Circlet
circlet.desc: A prestigious circlet. However, the royal insignia has been scratched out, and it is no longer the symbol of distinguished status that it once was.

setEffects.4: Increases the DMG caused by Overloaded, Electro-Charged, Superconduct, and Hyperbloom by 40%, the DMG Bonus conferred by Aggravate by 20%, and the DMG caused by Lunar-Charged and Stellar-Conduct by 20%. When Quicken or the aforementioned Elemental Reactions are triggered, Elemental Skill CD is decreased by 1s. Can only occur once every 0.8s.

flower.name: Thunderbird's Mercy
flower.desc: A lightning-infused flower, somehow spared the fate of being trodden underfoot or reduced to ash by the furious purple fire, making it the sole survivor on the day of disaster.

plume.name: Survivor of Catastrophe
plume.desc: A lightning-charged feather that still flickers with the wrath of the Thunderbird's cruel retribution.

sands.name: Hourglass of Thunder
sands.desc: The hourglass used to foretell the coming of the Thunderbird by the tribe that worshiped it. It has fallen into eternal silence now that the tribe is no more.

goblet.name: Omen of Thunderstorm
goblet.desc: A ceremonial cup that holds the blood of the innocent. It is brimming with the thundering fury of the prayers that echo within.

circlet.name: Thunder Summoner's Crown
circlet.desc: A crown once worn by an ancient shaman who worshiped the Thunderbird. The capricious beast remained unmoved by the shaman's devotion.

setEffects.4: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Electro by 35%.

flower.name: Thundersoother's Heart
flower.desc: A flower that blooms even amidst ferocious thunder and lightning. To this day, it still grants courage to travelers in thunderstorms.

plume.name: Thundersoother's Plume
plume.desc: The feather of a predatory bird that soars through lightning storms. It was said to have been adopted as an insignia by the legendary hero who pacified thunder and lightning.

sands.name: Hour of Soothing Thunder
sands.desc: A timepiece kept by the hero who conquered thunder and lightning. The tiny shards of Electro crystal within flow back and forth with the passing of time.

goblet.name: Thundersoother's Goblet
goblet.desc: The wine goblet from which the Thundersoother, who defeated the Beast of Thunder, once drank violet lightning.

circlet.name: Thundersoother's Diadem
circlet.desc: The crown given to the Thundersoother for defeating the Beast of Thunder that had been wreaking havoc upon the land.

setEffects.4: Incoming elemental DMG increases corresponding Elemental RES by 30% for 10s. Can only occur once every 10s.

flower.name: Tiny Miracle's Flower
flower.desc: A flower that grew from a rock, breaking through the stone as it strove to reach the light.

plume.name: Tiny Miracle's Feather
plume.desc: A feather from a bird of prey that flies almost too fast for the human eye to detect.

sands.name: Tiny Miracle's Hourglass
sands.desc: Just an ordinary, everyday hourglass. Turn it upside down and sure enough, the dry sand starts trickling down like water.

goblet.name: Tiny Miracle's Goblet
goblet.desc: A cup commonly used for fortune-telling. It can also hold water, of course.

circlet.name: Tiny Miracle's Earrings
circlet.desc: A cheap accessory that is actually made from ancient meteoric ore.

setEffects.4: Using Elemental Burst restores 20% HP.

flower.name: Traveling Doctor's Silver Lotus
flower.desc: A precious medicinal ingredient that has lost all medicinal value after years in storage.

plume.name: Traveling Doctor's Owl Feather
plume.desc: The durable feather of an owl. Emblematic of nocturnal supremacy, it gave some encouragement to the Traveling Doctor when venturing out to visit patients late at night.

sands.name: Traveling Doctor's Pocket Watch
sands.desc: A precise instrument used for keeping time. For a doctor, every second counts.

goblet.name: Traveling Doctor's Medicine Pot
goblet.desc: This pot used to carry concentrated and extremely potent concoctions. It is now empty, but still gives off a strong smell of medicine.

circlet.name: Traveling Doctor's Handkerchief
circlet.desc: Used to tie back the doctor's hair when treating patients. Can also be used as a sling for sprains and broken arms in emergencies.

setEffects.4: After leaving combat for 3s, DMG dealt increased by 50%. In combat, if no Burning opponents are nearby for more than 6s, this DMG Bonus will decrease by 10% per second until it reaches 0%. When a Burning opponent exists, it will increase by 10% instead until it reaches 50%. This effect still triggers if the equipping character is off-field.

flower.name: Dark Fruit of Bright Flowers
flower.desc: A flower carved from grey stone covered with gold foil. Legends say that during a war, it was used to differentiate friend from foe.

plume.name: Faded Emerald Tail
plume.desc: A tail feather ornament whose luster has long faded. The patterns on it are said to have been etched by the hand of a skilled artisan from long ago.

sands.name: Moment of Attainment
sands.desc: A sundial used by an ancient kingdom to tell time. Tiny marks have been left at a certain scale that can only be seen through careful observation.

goblet.name: The Wine-Flask Over Which the Plan Was Hatched
goblet.desc: A three-legged cup. Once, many heroes were gathered around the bonfire, raising their cups high in toast and drinking their fill while discussing their wishes and ambitions.

circlet.name: Crownless Crown
circlet.desc: A golden crown decorated with turquoise and emerald feathers, it has never been used in a coronation, living alone atop a velvet cushion.

setEffects.4: After using an Elemental Burst, this character will gain the Nascent Light effect, increasing their ATK by 8% for 16s. When the character's HP decreases, their ATK will further increase by 10%. This further increase can occur this way a maximum of 4 times. This effect can be triggered once every 0.8s. Nascent Light will be dispelled when the character leaves the field. If an Elemental Burst is used again during the duration of Nascent Light, the original Nascent Light will be dispelled.

flower.name: Flowering Life
flower.desc: An ancient memento. It still looks as alive as the being that preserved it several centuries ago.

plume.name: Feather of Nascent Light
plume.desc: A dimly lustrous pinion steeped in strong memories.

sands.name: Solar Relic
sands.desc: An ancient timepiece with a mighty solid look. Its luster is produced by sand crystal.

goblet.name: Moment of the Pact
goblet.desc: An old cup made of sand crystal. Its luster is somehow undimmed by age.

circlet.name: Thundering Poise
circlet.desc: This mask is said to have been made by the mountain people for a Yaksha. It is of simple make, but its surface still shines brightly nonetheless.

setEffects.4: Increases Swirl reaction DMG dealt by 60%, and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by 20%. Decreases opponent's Elemental RES to the element infused in the Swirl by 40% for 10s. Upon triggering a Stellar Swirl in the opponent, will also decrease their Cryo RES by 40%. RES debuffs of the same elemental type do not stack.

flower.name: In Remembrance of Viridescent Fields
flower.desc: A wild flower that was once a ubiquitous sight in its homeland. It was picked by a hunter who wore it on their chest.

plume.name: Viridescent Arrow Feather
plume.desc: The fletching of an arrow that once pierced right through its prey, but somehow still remains spotless.

sands.name: Viridescent Venerer's Determination
sands.desc: A wondrous instrument that a hunter once wore. It forever points towards their prey.

goblet.name: Viridescent Venerer's Vessel
goblet.desc: A water pouch used by the Viridescent Venerer. Its capacity is much greater than one would expect.

circlet.name: Viridescent Venerer's Diadem
circlet.desc: A proud crown that once belonged to the Viridescent Venerer. It is as lush and green as the breezes of the wild.

setEffects.4: Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG will be increased by 10%. After the equipping character takes DMG, the aforementioned DMG Bonus is increased by 80% for 5s. This effect increase can have 5 stacks. The duration of each stack is counted independently. These effects can be triggered even when the equipping character is not on the field.

flower.name: Stamen of Khvarena's Origin
flower.desc: An insignia in the shape of a lovely little flower that was once worn by pilgrims in times long bygone.

plume.name: Vibrant Pinion
plume.desc: An exquisite feather-shaped decoration on which the vivid hues of verdant leaves and fragrant flowers shimmer.

sands.name: Ancient Abscission
sands.desc: An ancient timepiece upon which the light of Khvarena gleams. It is filled with a pure liquid that appears alive.

goblet.name: Feast of Boundless Joy
goblet.desc: An opulent wine goblet that was once filled with nectar and honeydew, but is empty today.

circlet.name: Heart of Khvarena's Brilliance
circlet.desc: Intricate and vibrant earrings upon which the luster of a hundred flowers seems to flow.

setEffects.4: Increases Charged Attack DMG by 35% if the character uses a Catalyst or a Bow.

flower.name: Troupe's Dawnlight
flower.desc: A small flower-shaped insignia. If you listen carefully, you can almost hear a flute playing and voices singing.

plume.name: Bard's Arrow Feather
plume.desc: An azure arrow fletching that has neither faded nor splintered with the passage of time. The sound of running water seems to linger around it.

sands.name: Concert's Final Hour
sands.desc: An hourglass used to keep time during a band performance. It once made a crisp sound, but their performance has since ended.

goblet.name: Wanderer's String-Kettle

char_Albedo_gen.name: Albedo
char_Albedo_gen.title: Kreideprinz
char_Albedo_gen.description: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.3: has the following properties:
4: When opponents within the Solar Isotoma field take DMG, the Solar Isotoma will generate Transient Blossoms which deal <geo>AoE Geo DMG</geo>. DMG dealt scales off Albedo's DEF.
Transient Blossoms can only be generated once every 2s.

description.6: Hold to designate the location of the skill.
description.8: This Geo bloom has an unusual property mirrored in the aim of alchemy. To rise from the earth, soar into the sky, and become the sun.

description.3: Tectonic Tide DMG and Fatal Blossom DMG will not generate Transient Blossoms.
description.5: Under the Kreideprinz's command, the tectonic tide of creation seethes into life.

char_Alhaitham_gen.name: Alhaitham
char_Alhaitham_gen.title: Admonishing Instruction

description.4: "If a researcher makes wisdom their goal, then they should be prepared to make an enemy of every word they read. Only then can they avoid bias."

char_Alyosha_gen.title: Swift-Striding Hound
char_Alyosha_gen.description: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes and applies the Hunter's Mark to the opponent hit by the final strike.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents in his path.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.6: Enters aiming mode, then targets opponents within a certain area in front of him. Alyosha's Interruption RES is enhanced when in this mode.
description.7: At the end of the button hold, he deals <electro>Electro DMG</electro> to the targeted opponents.
description.9: The reckless hunter once reached for the spear's edge, and it was only after they survived a lesson paid in blood that they came to understand the harsh truths of survival on the frozen plains.

description.0: Summons his trusted companion Tugarin to fight alongside him on the field. This also turns an area in front of him into a Fulgurite Hunting Field for a short time.
3: Continuously taunts nearby opponents to incite them to attack.

If an opponent affected by the Hunter's Mark effect is hit, the Hunter's Mark will also be activated.
Where there are multiple opponents, Tugarin will attack those affected by the Hunter's Mark effect first.
description.8: Wait. Keep waiting until the impatience fades. That's when the red-bellied plover shall sweep across the birch grove and present itself before one's arrow.

When using Normal or Charged Attacks, Tap or Hold to switch between using "Multitarget Fire" in different ways.

description.8: Tap

description.10: Hold

14: Deal Nightsoul-aligned <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>, which is considered Charged Attack DMG.

The 4th, 5th, and 6th Shells loaded into the cylinder will undergo Elemental Conversion based on the Elemental Types of the other characters in the party: For each <pyro>Pyro</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro</hydro>, <cryo>Cryo</cryo>, or <electro>Electro</electro> character in the party, one Shadowhunt Shell will randomly be Converted into a "Shining Shadowhunt Shell" of one of these corresponding Elemental Types, dealing Nightsoul-aligned DMG corresponding to that Elemental Type. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
The Shells loaded into the cylinder are fired starting from the last Shadowhunt Shell to be loaded, in a "last in, first out" order.

Release the Elemental Skill to interrupt this Plunging Attack and maintain her airborne state. Should Chasca hit the ground with her Plunging Attack, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.
description.18: In theory, as long as she's willing, those reins can bridle anything... But what could possibly be as cool as a giant hand cannon?

description.0: Chasca concentrates her will, firing a single "Galesplitting Soulseeker Shell" that deals Nightsoul-aligned <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo>. Afterward, the Galesplitting Soulseeker Shell will split into 6 Soulseeker Shells, which attack nearby opponents.
3: Deal Nightsoul-aligned <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

For each <pyro>Pyro</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro</hydro>, <cryo>Cryo</cryo>, or <electro>Electro</electro> character in the party, two Soulseeker Shells will undergo corresponding Elemental Conversions to become "Radiant Soulseeker Shells," which deal Nightsoul-aligned Elemental DMG from a randomly selected one of the corresponding Elemental Types.
description.5: None can escape from the moonlight or the whispers of the night, just as no foe can flee her attentive eyes once she's got them in her sights.

Each Elemental Type will grant Chasca 1 stack of Spirit of the Radiant Shadow, increasing the DMG of Shining Shadowhunt Shell by 15%/35%/65%. This effect lasts until the current Multitarget Fire ends. Max 3 stacks.
