char_Chevreuse_gen.name: Chevreuse
char_Chevreuse_gen.title: Executor of Justice
char_Chevreuse_gen.description: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Chevreuse quickly shoulders her musket and fires at her opponent(s), dealing <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro>.
description.1: For a short duration after Chevreuse fires a shot, she will continuously restore HP to your active character on the field. The amount healed is based on her Max HP.
description.2: Hold to fire in a different fashion.
description.4: Hold
description.5: Enter Aiming Mode, locking a target in her sights to fire a precise interdiction shot. If Chevreuse has an Overcharged Ball, then she will fire the Overcharged Ball instead, dealing greater <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> in a larger area.
description.6: Chevreuse gains 1 Overcharged Ball every time a nearby character in the party triggers an Overloaded reaction, and can have up to 1 Overcharged Ball at a time.
description.8: Arkhe: Ousia
description.9: Periodically, after Chevreuse's Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire hits, a Surging Blade will be called forth that deals Ousia-aligned <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro>.
description.11: "Actually, training regulations only had the phrase "interdiction fire," but the protagonist of this novel believes that even how stylish your terminology is can affect how motivated your troops are, which can put your opponents on the back foot right from the get-go... I think that's a good point, so I changed the regulations!"

description.0: Chevreuse fires an explosive grenade at opponents with her musket, dealing <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG.</pyro> After the projectile hits, it will split into many secondary explosive shells.
description.1: The secondary explosive shells will burst after a short interval, dealing <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> to nearby opponents.
description.3: "Theoretically, a rectangular blast would be most efficient at destroying enemy formations. Unfortunately, the cross-section of an explosive shock wave is round, like most cakes. So, the secondary explosive shells can only be arranged like the fruit on a cake, forming a ring around the edge."

description.0: When all party members are <pyro>Pyro</pyro> and <electro>Electro</electro> characters and there is at least one Pyro and one Electro character each in the party:
description.1: Chevreuse grants "Coordinated Tactics" to nearby party members: After a character triggers the Overloaded reaction, the <pyro>Pyro</pyro> and <electro>Electro</electro> RES of the opponent(s) affected by this Overloaded reaction will be decreased by 40% for 6s.
description.2: The "Coordinated Tactics" effect will be removed when the Elemental Types of the characters in the party do not meet the basic requirements for the Ascension Talent.

description.0: After Chevreuse fires an Overcharged Ball using Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, nearby Pyro and Electro characters in the party gain 1% increased ATK for every 1,000 Max HP Chevreuse has for 30s. ATK can be increased by up to 40% in this way.
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
description.1: Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

description.0: When the active character with the "Coordinated Tactics" status (not including Chevreuse herself) triggers the Overloaded reaction, they will recover 6 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.
description.1: You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Vanguard's Coordinated Tactics."

description.0: After Holding Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire and hitting a target, 2 chain explosions will be triggered near the location where said target is hit. Each explosion deals Pyro DMG equal to 120% of Chevreuse's ATK. This effect can be triggered up to once every 10s, and DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
Increases the Level of Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: After using Ring of Bursting Grenades, the Hold mode of Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire will not go on cooldown when Chevreuse uses it. This effect is removed after Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire has been fired twice using Hold or after 6s.
Increases the Level of Ring of Bursting Grenades by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: After 12s of the healing effect from Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, all nearby party members recover HP equivalent to 10% of Chevreuse's Max HP once.
description.1: After a party member is healed by Short-Range Rapid Interdiction Fire, they gain a 20% <pyro>Pyro DMG Bonus</pyro> and <electro>Electro DMG Bonus</electro> for 8s. Max 3 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.

char_Chiori_gen.name: Chiori
char_Chiori_gen.title: The Thundering Seamstress
char_Chiori_gen.description: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

"Seize the Moment" lasts 8s, and 1 of "Tamoto"'s coordinated attack can be unleashed every 2s. 2 such coordinated attacks can occur per "Seize the Moment" effect duration.

char_Chongyun_gen.name: Chongyun
char_Chongyun_gen.title: Frozen Ardor
char_Chongyun_gen.description: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

charged.1: Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
charged.2: At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Chongyun strikes the ground with his greatsword, causing a Cryo explosion in a circular AoE in front of him that deals <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.1: After a short delay, the cold air created by the Cryo explosion will coalesce into a Chonghua Frost Field, within which all Sword, Claymore and Polearm-wielding characters' weapons will be infused with <cryo>Cryo</cryo>.
description.3: "A crystal-clear ring, and all is silent. The rivers move not, and the clouds are heavy with frost. The altar gates open, and evil is banished."

description.0: Performing the secret hand seals, Chongyun summons 3 giant spirit blades in mid-air that fall to the earth one by one after a short delay, exploding as they hit the ground.
description.1: When the spirit blades explode, they will deal <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo> and launch opponents.
description.3: "As ice doth give the biting frost birth, My transcendent blade shakes heaven and earth. Heed my summons and come hence!"

description.0: Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters within the field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost have their Normal ATK SPD increased by 8%.

When the field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost disappears, another spirit blade will be summoned to strike nearby opponents, dealing 100% of Chonghua's Layered Frost's Skill DMG as AoE Cryo DMG. Opponents hit by this blade will have their Cryo RES decreased by 10% for 8s.
When dispatched on an expedition in Liyue, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
The last attack of Chongyun's Normal Attack combo releases 3 ice blades. Each blade deals 50% of Chongyun's ATK as <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> to all opponents in its path.
Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts cast within the Frost Field created by Spirit Blade: Chonghua's Layered Frost have their CD time decreased by 15%.
Increases the Level of Spirit Blade: Cloud-Parting Star by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Chongyun regenerates 1 Energy every time he hits an opponent affected by <cryo>Cryo</cryo>.
description.1: This effect can only occur once every 2s.

description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

char_Citlali_gen.name: Citlali
char_Citlali_gen.title: Obsidian Opalstar
char_Citlali_gen.description: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

normal.1: Calls upon secret arts passed down through the Masters of the Night-Wind from generation to generation, performing up to three strikes that deal <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.

charged.1: Enters Aiming Mode, and after Holding, consumes a certain amount of Stamina to call forth a Frost Star that deals <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> to opponents in its path.

plunging.1: Gathers the power of Cryo and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <cryo>Aoe Cryo DMG</cryo> upon impact with the ground.

description.0: Invoking secret pacts passed down by her tribe over the millennia, Citlali deploys an Opal Shield and calls forth "Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Itzpapa," a creature that is (reputedly) terrifying beyond compare, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.1: The Opal Shield's DMG absorption scales based on Citlali's Elemental Mastery, and absorbs <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> with 250% efficiency. When it is deployed, it will cause Citlali to briefly be <cryo>affected by Cryo</cryo>.
description.2: After using this skill, Citlali gains 24 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
description.4: Nightsoul's Blessing: Citlali
description.5: When Itzpapa leaves the field, Citlali exits the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
description.7: Itzpapa
8: If Citlali has at least 50 Nightsoul points, Itzpapa enters the Opal Fire state and continuously consumes Nightsoul points to whip up a Frostfall Storm that follows the character and attacks opponents within its AoE, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.
When Citlali's Nightsoul points are fully depleted, Itzpapa's Opal Fire state also ends.
description.10: <i>Usually, the wills that symbolize different stars cannot coexist, for how can purest black be reflected in purest white?
description.11: Be that as it may, Citlali has never harbored a particular preference for colors themselves, and that is just how things played out.

skillParams.4: Itzpapa: Opal Fire Nightsoul Point Consumption

description.0: Summons "allies" from the starry skies and the vast earth, hurling forth an ice storm to bombard the area in front and deal Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG. This restores a set amount of Nightsoul points for Citlali, and also summons a Spiritvessel Skull near a maximum of 3 opponents within the AoE, with 1 Skull for each opponent. Spiritvessel Skulls explode after some time, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG and restoring a set amount of Nightsoul points for Citlali.
description.2: "Ugh, enough of this 'dark star, opal star' stuff! Citlalin, Itzpapa, get 'em!"

description.0: While Itzpapa is on the field, after nearby party members trigger the Frozen or Melt reactions, the <pyro>Pyro</pyro> and <hydro>Hydro</hydro> RES of opponents affected by that reaction decreases by 20% for 12s. Additionally, Citlali will regain 16 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul points can be restored this way once every 8s.

During the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar, Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm DMG is increased by 90% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery. During the Elemental Burst Edict of Entwined Splendor, Ice Storm DMG is increased by 1200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.
description.1: In addition, when nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Citlali regains 4 Nightsoul points.

passive3.name: Night Realm's Gift: Smoke, Mirrors, and the Flowing Winds

When the active character is currently high enough in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Citlali: Citlali will leap up high, and will deploy "White Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Citlalin" to float in the air. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your party.
description.2: Holding Aiming Mode will cause Citlali to enter the "Spiritspeaker" state, which will allow her to interact with "Nightspirit Graffiti" and "Nightspirit Sigils," extracting information and power from them. The rules for interacting with these objects follow the same rules as those governing Iktomisaurus interactions.
description.4: Additionally, holding the jump button will cause Citlali to consume 75 Stamina and leap. In areas within Natlan where Phlogiston mechanics are present, Citlali will prioritize consuming 5 Phlogiston to leap to a height higher still.
description.5: When in the air, Citlali can Hold her Normal Attack to consume Phlogiston or Stamina and enter Aiming Mode and trigger Charged Attacks. When initiating Charged Attacks in mid-air, Citlali will prioritize consuming 20 Phlogiston.

description.0: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, triggering "Nightsoul Burst" restores 20 Phlogiston.
description.1: This cannot take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

During this time, she will obtain 10 stacks of Stellar Blade. When a nearby active character other than Citlali deals DMG using Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts, 1 stack of Stellar Blade will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.

description.3: Also, the Ascension Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" has its effects enhanced:

char_Clorinde_gen.name: Clorinde
char_Clorinde_gen.title: Candlebearer, Shadowhunter
char_Clorinde_gen.description: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and fires Suppressing Shots in a fan pattern with her pistolet.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Preparing her pistolet, she enters the "Night Vigil" state, using steel and shot together. Using her Elemental Skill will transform it into "Impale the Night": Perform a lunging attack, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro>. The DMG done through the aforementioned method is considered Normal Attack DMG.
3: When her Bond of Life is equal to or greater than 100% of her max HP: Performs a pistolet shot.

When her Bond of Life is less than 100%, firing her pistolet will grant her Bond of Life, with the amount gained based on her max HP. The shots she fires can pierce opponents, and DMG dealt to opponents in their path is increased.
description.6: The current percentage value of Clorinde's Bond of Life determines its effect:
7: When the Bond of Life value is 0%, perform a normal lunging strike;

When the value of the Bond of Life is equal to or greater than 100% of her max HP, use Impale the Night: Pact. The healing multiplier is increased, and the AoE and DMG dealt by the lunge is increased even further.
description.9: In addition, when Clorinde is in the Night Vigil state, healing effects other than Impale the Night will not take effect and will instead be converted into a Bond of Life that is a percentage of the healing that would have been received.
description.11: Clorinde will exit the "Night Vigil" state when she leaves the field.
description.14: Periodically, when Clorinde's Swift Hunt shots strike opponents, she will summon a Surging Blade at the position hit that deals Ousia-aligned <electro>Electro DMG</electro>.
description.16: <i>Though the evil that lurked in the shadows of the night had been purged across thousands of years, a shadow that the light could not reach clouded human hearts.
description.17: Even now, the warning left by the Golden Hunter is etched into her memory: Those of the Night Vigil, carrying aloft lit candles against the blackness, have greater need still to remain vigilant. Be not corrupted by the cold dark.

char_Dehya_gen.description: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes using her Claymore and her martial arts.

charged.1: Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
charged.2: At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: This art of Dehya's own invention changes its method of use depending on the combat situation.
description.3: This skill will be unleashed should there be no Fiery Sanctum field created by Dehya herself present at the time.
description.4: Deals <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro>, and creates a field known as Fiery Sanctum.
description.6: Ranging Flame
description.7: This skill will be unleashed should a Fiery Sanctum field created by Dehya herself already exist.
description.8: Dehya will perform a leaping attack, dealing <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> before recreating a Fiery Sanctum field at her new position.
description.9: A Fiery Sanctum field created this way will inherit the remaining duration of the previous field.
description.11: Ranging Flame can be used only once throughout a single Fiery Sanctum field's duration.
description.14: When an opponent within a Fiery Sanctum field takes DMG, the field will unleash a coordinated attack, dealing <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> to them based on Dehya's ATK and Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every 2.5s.
description.15: Active characters within this field have their resistance to interruption increased, and when such characters take DMG, a portion of that damage will be mitigated and flow into Redmane's Blood. Dehya will then take this DMG over 10s. When the mitigated DMG stored by Redmane's Blood reaches or goes over a certain percentage of Dehya's Max HP, she will stop mitigating DMG in this way.
description.17: Only 1 Fiery Sanctum created by Dehya herself can exist at the same time.
description.19: Walk this fiery ordeal with me and purge all impurity, just as a beast of flames that must descend from the blaze.

description.0: Unleashing her burning anger and casting her inconvenient blade aside, Dehya enters the Blazing Lioness state and increases her resistance to interruption.
description.1: In this state, Dehya will automatically and continuously unleash the Flame-Mane's Fists, dealing <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> based on her ATK and Max HP, and when its duration ends, she will unleash an Incineration Drive, dealing <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> based on her ATK and Max HP.
description.2: If a Fiery Sanctum field created by Dehya's own Elemental Skill "Molten Inferno" exists when this ability is unleashed, Dehya will retrieve it, and then create another field once Blazing Lioness's duration expires. This field will take on the retrieved field's duration at the moment of its retrieval.
description.3: In this state, Dehya will be unable to cast her Elemental Skill, or perform Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks. "Normal Attack: Sandstorm Assault" and Elemental Skill "Molten Inferno" will be replaced by "Roaring Barrage."
description.6: Unleashing Roaring Barrage within 0.4s after each Flame-Mane's Fist strike will increase the speed at which the next Flame-Mane's Fist strike will be triggered.
description.8: Even the flowing flames must obey her rage and at her command become her fangs and claws.

description.0: Within 6 seconds after Dehya retrieves the Fiery Sanctum field through Molten Inferno: Ranging Flame or Leonine Bite, she will take 60% less DMG when receiving DMG from Redmane's Blood. This effect can be triggered once every 2s.
description.1: Additionally, within 9s after Dehya unleashes Molten Inferno: Indomitable Flame, she will grant all party members the Gold-Forged Form state. This state will further increase a character's resistance to interruption when they are within the Fiery Sanctum field. Gold-Forged Form can be activated once every 18s.

description.0: When her HP is less than 40%, Dehya will recover 20% of her Max HP and will restore 6% of her Max HP every 2s for the next 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
During the day (06:00 – 18:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
description.1: Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.

description.0: Dehya's Max HP is increased by 20%, and she deals bonus DMG based on her Max HP when using the following attacks:
1: Molten Inferno's DMG will be increased by 3.6% of her Max HP.
Leonine Bite's DMG will be increased by 6% of her Max HP.

description.0: When Dehya uses Molten Inferno: Ranging Flame, the duration of the recreated Fiery Sanctum field will be increased by 6s.
description.1: Additionally, when a Fiery Sanctum exists on the field, DMG dealt by its next coordinated attack will be increased by 50% when active character(s) within the Fiery Sanctum field are attacked.

description.0: Increases the Level of Leonine Bite by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When Flame-Mane's Fist and Incineration Drive attacks unleashed during Leonine Bite hit opponents, they will restore 1.5 Energy for Dehya and 2.5% of her Max HP. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s.
Increases the Level of Molten Inferno by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: The CRIT Rate of Leonine Bite is increased by 10%.
description.1: Additionally, after a Flame-Mane's Fist attack hits an opponent and deals CRIT Hits during a single Blazing Lioness state, it will cause the CRIT DMG of Leonine Bite to increase by 15% for the rest of Blazing Lioness's duration and extend that duration by 0.5s. This effect can be triggered every 0.2s. The duration can be extended for a maximum of 2s and CRIT DMG can be increased by a maximum of 60% this way.

char_Diluc_gen.name: Diluc
char_Diluc_gen.title: Dark Side of Dawn
char_Diluc_gen.description: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

charged.1: Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
charged.2: At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Performs a forward slash that deals <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro>.
description.2: This skill can be consecutively used 3 times.
description.3: Enters CD if not cast again within a short period.
description.5: The slashes represent the values that Diluc holds dear: one for justice, one for courage, and one for duty.

description.0: Releases intense flames to knock back nearby opponents, dealing <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro>. The flames then converge into the weapon, summoning a Phoenix that flies forward and deals massive <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> to all opponents in its path. The Phoenix explodes upon reaching its destination, causing a large amount of <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro>.
description.1: The searing flames that run down his blade cause it to be infused with <pyro>Pyro</pyro>.
description.3: The only reason to walk in the darkness is to light it up. Behold, that fleeing light in the dead of night is the herald of the coming dawn.

description.0: Diluc's Charged Attack Stamina Cost is decreased by 50%, and its duration is increased by 3s.
The Pyro Infusion provided by Dawn lasts for 4s longer. Additionally, Diluc gains 20% Pyro DMG Bonus during the duration of this effect.
Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Claymore-type weapons.
Diluc deals 15% more DMG to opponents whose HP is above 50%.
When Diluc takes DMG, his ATK increases by 10% and his ATK SPD increases by 5%. Lasts for 10s.
description.1: This effect can stack up to 3 times and can only occur once every 1.5s.

description.0: Increases the Level of Searing Onslaught by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Casting Searing Onslaught in rhythm greatly increases damage dealt.
description.1: 2s after casting Searing Onslaught, casting the next Searing Onslaught in the combo deals 40% additional DMG. This effect lasts for 2s.

description.0: Increases the Level of Dawn by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellation6.name: Flaming Sword, Nemesis of the Dark

description.0: After casting Searing Onslaught, the next 2 Normal Attacks within the next 6s will have their DMG and ATK SPD increased by 30%.
description.1: Additionally, Searing Onslaught will not interrupt the Normal Attack combo.

char_Diona_gen.name: Diona
char_Diona_gen.title: Kätzlein Cocktail
char_Diona_gen.description: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

charged.1: Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
charged.2: While aiming, biting frost will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged frost arrow will deal <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Fires an Icy Paw that deals <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> to opponents and forms a shield on hit.
description.1: The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Diona's Max HP, and its duration scales off the number of Icy Paws that hit their target.
description.3: Press
description.4: Rapidly fires off 2 Icy Paws.
description.6: Hold
description.7: Dashes back quickly before firing 5 Icy Paws.
description.8: The shield created by a Hold attack will gain a 75% DMG Absorption Bonus.
description.10: The shield has a 250% <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> Absorption Bonus, and will cause your active character to become affected by <cryo>Cryo</cryo> at the point of formation for a short duration.
description.12: When she first started bartending, Diona found that no matter how much ice she put in her cocktails, it would never do a drunkard any harm. That all changed when she received her Vision — now she can form ice cold enough to cause severe brainfreeze. Five out of five stars!

description.0: Tosses out a special cold brew that deals <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo> and creates a Drunken Mist in an AoE.
3: Deals continuous <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> to opponents within the AoE.
Continuously regenerates the HP of characters within the AoE.
description.5: A horrific mix that even Diona considers inhumane. The horrifying foretaste should be left for one's opponents. It has a crisp aftertaste, but unfortunately, one can only feel it on one's nose and skin.

description.0: Characters shielded by Icy Paws have their Movement SPD increased by 10% and their Stamina Consumption decreased by 10%.
Opponents who enter the AoE of Signature Mix have 10% decreased ATK for 15s.
When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

Within 20s after using the Elemental Skill Icy Paws, Diona will also fire off three Icy Paws when party members trigger Stellar-Conduct, Superconduct, Cryo Swirl, or Stellar Swirl reactions. Icy Paws fired this way cannot generate Elemental Particles, nor will they generate a shield upon hitting opponents. This effect can occur once every 3.5s.
description.1: Additionally, Diona will also enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when she is inside a Polestar Field, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.

description.0: Regenerates 15 Energy for Diona after the effects of Signature Mix end.
Increases Icy Paws' DMG by 15%, and increases its shield's DMG Absorption by 15%.
description.1: Additionally, when paws hit their targets, creates a shield for other nearby characters on the field with 50% of the Icy Paws shield's DMG Absorption for 5s.

description.0: Increases the Level of Signature Mix by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Within the radius of Signature Mix, Diona's charge time for aimed shots is reduced by 60%
Increases the Level of Icy Paws by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Characters within Signature Mix's radius will gain the following effects based on their HP amounts:
1: Increases Incoming Healing Bonus by 30% when HP falls below or is equal to 50%.
Elemental Mastery increased by 200 when HP is above 50%.

upgradedDescription.0: Characters within Signature Mix's radius gain the following effects based on their HP levels:
1: The Incoming Healing Bonus is increased by 30% when HP is at, or lower than, 50%.
Elemental Mastery is increased by 200 when HP is above 50%.
upgradedDescription.3: Additionally, Diona's Max HP is increased by 25%.
upgradedDescription.4: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: Characters within the Signature Mix field deal increased DMG for the following reactions:
upgradedDescription.5: Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG increased by 40%.
upgradedDescription.6: Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Cryo Swirl, Stellar Swirl reaction DMG increased by 40%.

char_Dori_gen.name: Dori
char_Dori_gen.title: Treasure of Dream Garden
char_Dori_gen.description: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 consecutive strikes.

charged.1: Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
charged.2: At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Directs a Spirit-Warding Lamp to fire off a Troubleshooter Shot at opponents, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro>.
description.1: After the Troubleshooter Shot hits, it will create 2 After-Sales Service Rounds that will automatically track nearby opponents and deal <electro>Electro DMG</electro>.
description.3: It is said that Dori can fix any problem for you... for the right price.

description.0: Summons forth the Jinni within the lamp to give the client various kinds of aid.
description.3: Connects to a nearby character. The connected character will:
4: Continuously restore HP based on Dori's Max HP.
Continuously regenerate Energy.
Be affected by <electro>Electro</electro>.
description.5: When the connector between the Jinni and the character touches opponents, it will deal one instance of <electro>Electro DMG</electro> to them every 0.4s.
description.7: Only one Jinni can exist at one time.
description.9: "Hmm? You'll pick this lamp, will you? Oh my, you've got good taste! Unfortunately, there's no price on this treasure — comparable, I'd say, to how you will not sell that mascot by your side for any price in the world."

description.0: After a character connected to the Jinni triggers an Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, Electro Swirl, or Electro Crystallize reaction, the CD of Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon is decreased by 1s.
description.1: This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

description.0: When the Troubleshooter Shots or After-Sales Service Rounds from Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon hit opponents, Dori will restore 5 Elemental Energy for every 100% Energy Recharge possessed.
description.1: Per Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon, only one instance of Energy restoration can be triggered and a maximum of 15 Energy can be restored this way.

description.0: Has a 25% chance to recover some of the materials used when crafting Character and Weapon Materials.
The number of After-Sales Service Rounds created by Troubleshooter Shots is increased by 1.
When you are in combat and the Jinni heals the character it is connected to, it will fire a Jinni Toop from that character's position that deals 50% of Dori's ATK DMG.
Increases the Level of Alcazarzaray's Exactitude by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: The character connected to the Jinni will obtain the following buffs based on their current HP and Energy:
1: When their HP is lower than 50%, they gain 50% Incoming Healing Bonus.
When their Energy is less than 50%, they gain 30% Energy Recharge.

description.0: Increases the Level of Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Dori gains the following effects for 3s after using Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon:
1: <electro>Electro Infusion</electro>.
When Normal Attacks hit opponents, all nearby party members will heal HP equivalent to 4% of Dori's Max HP. This type of healing can occur once every 0.1s.

char_Durin_gen.name: Durin
char_Durin_gen.title: "The Undying Fire"
char_Durin_gen.description: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive sword strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a slash toward the front.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Purify the substance of souls and wishes to undergo Essential Transmutation. While transmuted, Durin's Elemental Skill Binary Form: Convergence and Division will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill Transmutation: Confirmation of Purity, and the Normal Attack Radiant Wingslash will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill Transmutation: Denial of Darkness.
description.3: Deal 1 instance of AoE Pyro DMG to nearby opponents, reverse Essential Transmutation, and enter the Confirmation of Purity state for 30s.
description.6: Deal 3 consecutive instances of Pyro DMG to opponents in front, reverse Essential Transmutation, and enter the Denial of Darkness state for 30s.
description.8: When Durin enters the Confirmation of Purity or Denial of Darkness state while in battle, he will restore a certain amount of Elemental Energy. Elemental Energy can be restored this way once every 6s.

burst.name: Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts

description.0: Unleash the power of the "Beast" in different ways. Durin can use different Elemental Bursts based on his Essential Transmutation state.
description.2: Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts
description.3: When Durin is in the Confirmation of Purity state, he will use the Elemental Burst Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts, dealing 3 instances of AoE Pyro DMG to opponents in front, and manifesting his power in the Dragon of White Flame form. The Dragon of White Flame will follow the current active character and attack nearby opponents at intervals, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
description.5: Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder
description.6: When Durin is in the Denial of Darkness state, he will use the Elemental Burst Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder, dealing 3 instances of AoE Pyro DMG to opponents in front, and manifesting his power in the Dragon of Dark Decay form. The Dragon of Dark Decay will follow the current active character and periodically attack a single nearby opponent, dealing Pyro DMG. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
description.8: When Durin is not in a special state as a result of Essential Transmutation, he will use the Elemental Burst Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts.

skillParams.0: Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts DMG
skillParams.1: Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder DMG

passive1.name: Light Manifest of the Divine Calculus

description.6: Durin's Vaporize DMG is increased by 40% and his Melt DMG is increased by 40%.

When a periodic attack from Dragon of White Flame or Dragon of Dark Decay deals DMG, 1 stack of Primordial Fusion will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 3% of the original DMG for every 100 ATK. A maximum of 75% additional DMG can be dealt this way. When a single attack from Dragon of White Flame or Dragon of Dark Decay hits multiple opponents, only one stack of Primordial Fusion is consumed.

description.0: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Mondstadt Expedition for 20 hours.

description.3: Increases all effects of the Ascension Talent Light Manifest of the Divine Calculus (except for Duration) by 75%.

When nearby active characters deal Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst DMG, 1 stack of Cycle of Enlightenment will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 60% of Durin's ATK. Stack counts for characters in the party who have Cycle of Enlightenment are managed individually.

Increases the Level of Binary Form: Convergence and Division by 3.

char_Emilie_gen.name: Emilie
char_Emilie_gen.title: A Thousand Scents Traced
char_Emilie_gen.description: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an upward slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Creates a Lumidouce Case that deals <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro>.
3: Fires Puffs of Puredew at nearby opponents at intervals, dealing <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro>.

When nearby opponents are affected by Burning, they will give off Scents at intervals, and 1 Scent can be created this way every 2s. The Lumidouce Case collects nearby Scents. The Lumidouce Case will level up after gathering 2 of them, after which it will fire 1 extra Puff of Puredew when firing, while the DMG dealt by and DMG AoE of the above attack will also be increased.

1 Lumidouce Case created by Emilie herself can exist at any one time. The Case starts at Level 1 and can go up to Level 2. If the Case does not collect any Scents for 8s while it is on the field, it will go back to Level 1.
description.6: At intervals, after Emilie creates a Lumidouce Case this way, a Spiritbreath Thorn will descend in front of her and pierce her opponent, dealing Pneuma-aligned <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro>.
description.8: "The world is an endless harmony of fragrance, color, and song."

description.0: Guiding the fragrances collected within the Case, Emilie converts them into pure Dendro energy, creating a Level 3 Lumidouce Case and stowing existing Cases away.
description.1: While it exists, the Level 3 Lumidouce Case will not gather nearby Scents, but it will continuously cause Scented Dew to descend, attacking opponents within range and dealing <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro>. During this time, 1 drop of Scented Dew will descend every 0.3 seconds, and 1 opponent can become the target every 0.7 seconds.
description.2: When the duration ends, a Level 1 Lumidouce Case will be recreated. If a Lumidouce Case was stowed away when using Aromatic Explication, then the Case that was stowed away will be deployed instead, and its duration will be reset.
description.3: While Aromatic Explication is active, the Elemental Skill "Fragrance Extraction" will not create a Lumidouce Case.
description.5: <i>No matter the perfume, it will begin to change the instant it comes into contact with the air, before finally dissipating amidst the whispers of wind, trees, and grass. In that sense, no two people will appreciate the exact same fragrance.
description.6: So it is for the paths taken by all who live. In that sense, you can consider perfumes an explication of human life.

description.0: Each time it collects 2 Scents, the Level 2 Lumidouce Case will consume Scents and release Cleardew Cologne that deals AoE Dendro DMG equal to 600% of Emilie's ATK to opponents. This DMG is not considered Elemental Skill DMG.
Emilie deals increased DMG to Burning opponents based on her ATK, with every 1,000 ATK increasing DMG dealt by 15%. The maximum DMG bonus that can be gained this way is 36%.
When the Lumidouce Case created by Emilie is on the field, all party members gain 85% <pyro>Pyro RES</pyro> against Burning DMG.
Increases the DMG dealt by Fragrance Extraction and her Ascension Talent's Cleardew Cologne "Lingering Fragrance" by 20%. The latter requires unlocking said Ascension Talent first.
description.1: Additionally, when nearby party members trigger the Burning reaction on opponents or deal Dendro DMG to Burning opponents, they will generate an additional Scent. This effect can be triggered once every 2.9s.

description.0: When Fragrance Extraction, Aromatic Explication, or Cleardew Cologne produced by the Ascension Talent "Lingering Fragrance" (the last of which requires Ascension Talent activation) hits opponents, those opponents' Dendro RES is decreased by 30% for 10s.
Increases the Level of Fragrance Extraction by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Aromatic Explication's duration is increased by 2s. The interval between opponents being selected as the target for Scented Dew is decreased by 0.3s.
Increases the Level of Aromatic Explication by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When using Fragrance Extraction or Aromatic Explication, Emilie will gain Abiding Fragrance for 5s.
description.1: While this is active, after Emilie uses Normal or Charged Attacks, she will generate 1 Scent, and her Normal and Charged Attack DMG will be converted into <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro> that cannot be overridden, and the DMG dealt will be increased by 300% of Emilie's ATK.
description.3: The Abiding Fragrance effect will be removed after 4 Scents are created this way or after its duration expires. Abiding Fragrance can be triggered once every 12s.

char_Escoffier_gen.name: Escoffier
char_Escoffier_gen.title: Tasteful Excellence
char_Escoffier_gen.description: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 consecutive spear strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an upward thrust.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Behold the true meaning of "cooking"! Escoffier will demonstrate different cooking techniques when you Tap or Hold this skill, but rest assured, each of them is Fontaine's pride and joy.
description.3: Activates her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek in its Cold Storage mode and deals <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo> to nearby opponents.
description.6: Follows the current active character and fires Frosty Parfaits at nearby opponents at intervals, dealing <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.8: Arkhe: Ousia

description.6: Grimheart
description.7: Increases Eula's resistance to interruption and DEF.
description.10: Wielding her sword, Eula consumes all the stacks of Grimheart and lashes forward, dealing <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo> to opponents in front of her.
description.11: If Grimheart stacks are consumed, surrounding opponents will have their Physical RES and <cryo>Cryo RES</cryo> decreased.

description.14: "So the waves roiled, swallowing the crown of the nobles. And ever after did each drop amidst the icy waves reflect a golden crown, each and every droplet of the spray shining with its light."

char_Eula_gen.name: Eula
char_Eula_gen.title: Dance of the Shimmering Wave
char_Eula_gen.description: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

charged.1: Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
charged.2: At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Brandishes her greatsword, dealing <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> to nearby opponents and creating a Lightfall Sword that follows her around for a duration of up to 7s.
description.1: While present, the Lightfall Sword increases Eula's resistance to interruption. When Eula's own Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst deal DMG to opponents, they will charge the Lightfall Sword, which can gain an energy stack once every 0.1s.
description.2: Once its duration ends, the Lightfall Sword will descend and explode violently, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
description.3: This DMG scales on the number of energy stacks the Lightfall Sword has accumulated.
description.4: If Eula leaves the field, the Lightfall Sword will explode immediately.
description.6: It is easy to sink. But even so, she desires to freeze this oncoming tide.

description.0: If 2 stacks of Grimheart are consumed upon unleashing the Holding Mode of Icetide Vortex, a Shattered Lightfall Sword will be created that will explode immediately, dealing 50% of the basic Physical DMG dealt by a Lightfall Sword created by Glacial Illumination.
When Glacial Illumination is cast, the CD of Icetide Vortex is reset and Eula gains 1 stack of Grimheart.
When Eula crafts Character Talent Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.
Every time Icetide Vortex's Grimheart stacks are consumed, Eula's Physical DMG is increased by 30% for 6s.
description.1: Each stack consumed will increase the duration of this effect by 6s up to a maximum of 18s.

Increases the Level of Icetide Vortex by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Lightfall Swords created by Glacial Illumination start with 5 stacks of energy. Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts have a 50% chance to grant the Lightfall Sword an additional stack of energy.

char_Faruzan_gen.name: Faruzan
char_Faruzan_gen.title: Enigmatic Machinist
char_Faruzan_gen.description: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

charged.1: Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
charged.2: While aiming, mighty winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Faruzan deploys a polyhedron that deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> to nearby opponents. She will also enter the Manifest Gale state.
description.1: While in the Manifest Gale state, Faruzan's next fully charged shot will consume this state and will become a Hurricane Arrow that contains high-pressure currents. This arrow deals <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo> based on the DMG of a fully charged Aimed Shot from "Normal Attack: Parthian Shot."
description.3: Pressurized Collapse
description.4: The Hurricane Arrow will apply a Pressurized Collapse effect to the opponent or character hit. This effect will be removed after a short delay, creating a vortex that deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> and pulls nearby objects and opponents in. If the Hurricane Arrow does not hit any opponent or character, it will create a Pressurized Collapse effect at its point of impact.
description.5: The vortex DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
description.7: The winds of truth buffet the spirits of those who seek truth, dispersing the miasma of preconception.

description.0: Faruzan deploys a Dazzling Polyhedron that unleashes a Whirlwind Pulse and deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.1: While the Dazzling Polyhedron persists, it will continuously move along a triangular path. Once it reaches each corner of that triangular path, it will unleash 1 more Whirlwind Pulse.
description.3: Whirlwind Pulse
4: When the Whirlwind Pulse is unleashed, it will apply Perfidious Wind's Bale to nearby opponents, decreasing their <anemo>Anemo RES</anemo>.
The Whirlwind Pulse will also apply Prayerful Wind's Benefit to all nearby party members when it is unleashed, granting them an <anemo>Anemo DMG Bonus</anemo>.
description.6: One must have respect for the unknown wisdom that one might find hidden in ancient ruins.

description.0: When Faruzan is in the Manifest Gale state created by Wind Realm of Nasamjnin, the amount of time taken to charge a shot is decreased by 60%, and she can apply The Wind's Secret Ways' Perfidious Wind's Bale to opponents who are hit by the vortex created by Pressurized Collapse.

passive2.name: Lost Wisdom of the Seven Caverns

description.0: When characters affected by The Wind's Secret Ways' Prayerful Wind's Benefit deal Anemo DMG using Normal, Charged, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts to opponents, they will gain the Hurricane Guard effect: This DMG will be increased based on 32% of Faruzan's Base ATK. 1 instance of Hurricane Guard can occur once every 0.8s. This DMG Bonus will be cleared after Prayerful Wind's Benefit expires or after the effect is triggered once.
Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Sumeru Expedition for 20 hours.
Faruzan can fire off a maximum of 2 Hurricane Arrows using fully charged Aimed Shots while under the effect of a single Manifest Gale created by Wind Realm of Nasamjnin.
The duration of the Dazzling Polyhedron created by The Wind's Secret Ways is increased by 6s.
Increases the Level of Wind Realm of Nasamjnin by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.1: A maximum of 4 Energy can be restored to her per vortex.

description.0: Increases the Level of The Wind's Secret Ways by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

When the active character deals DMG while affected by Prayerful Wind's Benefit, they will apply Pressurized Collapse to the opponent damaged. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. This CD is shared between all party members.

char_Fischl_gen.name: Fischl
char_Fischl_gen.title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
char_Fischl_gen.description: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

charged.1: Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
charged.2: While aiming, the dark lightning spirits of Immernachtreich shall heed the call of their Prinzessin and indwell the enchanted arrowhead. When fully indwelt, the Rachsüchtig Blitz shall deal immense <electro>Electro DMG</electro>.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Summons Oz. The night raven forged of darkness and lightning descends upon the land, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro> in a small AoE.
description.1: For the ability's duration, Oz will continuously attack nearby opponents with <electro>Freikugel</electro>.
description.3: Hold to adjust the location Oz will be summoned to.
description.4: Press again any time during the ability's duration to once again summon him to Fischl's side.
description.6: "My time is most precious, and I shall not waste it on the likes of you... Go, Oz, fall upon them, and bring down upon them your Rachsüchtig Blitz, that which tears open the long night."
description.7: —Flowers for Princess Fischl (IV): Farewell Frau Welt

description.0: Summons Oz to spread his twin wings of twilight and defend Fischl.
description.1: Has the following properties during the ability's duration:
2: Fischl takes on Oz's form, greatly increasing her Movement Speed.
Strikes nearby opponents with lightning, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro> to opponents she comes into contact with. Each opponent can only be struck once.
Once this ability's effects end, Oz will remain on the battlefield and attack his Prinzessin's foes. If Oz is already on the field, then this will reset the duration of his presence.
description.4: "...In the hordes of beasts that follow the cursed blood, only Prince Nachtraben, who bore witness to the extinction of a thousand worlds, knows her true greatness. Thus the night wings he spreads are his eternal promise to protect Her Royal Highness."
description.5: —Flowers for Princess Fischl (I): End Time Zersetzung

description.0: When Fischl hits Oz with a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Oz brings down Thundering Retribution, dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> equal to 152.7% of the arrow's DMG.

If your current active character triggers an <electro>Electro-related Elemental Reaction</electro> when Oz is on the field, the opponent shall be stricken with Thundering Retribution that deals <electro>Electro DMG</electro> equal to 80% of Fischl's ATK.
When dispatched on an expedition in Mondstadt, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

After completing Witch's Homework: Of the Unexpected, Fischl will become a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.
description.3: Hark, Prince Nachtraben, Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, he who has witnessed the fall of countless worlds. Sing now the starry septet for your sovereign, for this is the moment of deepest sin, when the gathered souls at the end of causality shatter the darkness of fate.
description.4: Additionally, when Oz is on the field, party members will gain additional buff effects:
5: After a nearby party member triggers an Overloaded reaction, Fischl and other nearby active party members have their ATK increased by 22.5% for 10s.
After a nearby party member triggers an Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reaction, Fischl and other nearby active party members have their Elemental Mastery increased by 90 for 10s.

description.0: Even when Oz is not present in combat, he can still watch over Fischl through his raven eyes. When Fischl performs a Normal Attack against an opponent, Oz fires a coordinated attack, dealing DMG equal to 22% of Fischl's ATK.
When Nightrider is used, it deals an additional 200% ATK as DMG, and its AoE is increased by 50%.
Increases the Level of Nightrider by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When Midnight Phantasmagoria is used, it deals 222% of ATK as Electro DMG to surrounding opponents.
description.1: When the skill duration ends, Fischl regenerates 20% of her HP.

description.0: Increases the Level of Midnight Phantasmagoria by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

upgradedDescription.1: After Oz performs a coordinated attack, the increased ATK and Elemental Mastery effects of Witch's Eve Rite: Phantasmal Nocturne are further increased by 100% for 10s.

char_Flins_gen.name: Flins
char_Flins_gen.title: Shadowy Lights, Stranger Wights
char_Flins_gen.description: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward spear throw.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

1: Flins's Normal and Charged Attacks deal <electro>Electro DMG</electro> that cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions, and he is unable to perform Plunging Attacks.
His interruption resistance is increased.
His Elemental Skill Ancient Rite: Arcane Light is replaced with the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm.
description.3: Northland Spearstorm
description.4: Flins summons a flurry of spears in front, dealing AoE Electro DMG and causing his Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night to be replaced with the special Elemental Burst Thunderous Symphony for the next 6s.
description.5: The base CD of Northland Spearstorm is 6s and will not be affected by other effects.

description.0: Flins unleashes the true power of his lamp, dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> and, after a short delay, dealing 2 instances of middle-phase and 1 instance of final-phase <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>, all of which are considered Lunar-Charged DMG.

description.3: After using the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm, Flins's Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night will be replaced with the special Elemental Burst Thunderous Symphony for the next 6s.
description.6: Consume less Elemental Energy to unleash a special Elemental Burst. Flins deals a single instance of <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> that is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
description.7: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional instance of Lunar-Charged AoE Electro DMG.

description.0: Flins will gain a corresponding buff effect based on the party's Moonsign.
description.2: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Charged reactions triggered by Flins will deal an additional 20% DMG.

When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Flins has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.
description.2: Additionally, when Flins is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

description.0: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.
description.1: Additionally, Flins appears to be able to decipher the whispers of the Wild Hunt...

description.0: The basic cooldown of the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm is reduced to 4s.
description.1: Additionally, when party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, Flins will recover 8 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 5.5s.

description.0: For the next 6s after using the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm, when Flins's next Normal Attack hits an opponent, it will deal an additional 50% of Flins's ATK as AoE Electro DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
description.1: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: While Flins is on the field, after his Electro attacks hit an opponent, that opponent's Electro RES will be decreased by 25% for 7s.

description.0: The DMG dealt to opponents by Flins's Lunar-Charged reactions is elevated by 35%.
description.1: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Charged DMG is elevated by 10%.

char_Freminet_gen.name: Freminet
char_Freminet_gen.title: Yearning for Unseen Depths
char_Freminet_gen.description: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

charged.1: Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
charged.2: At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Performs an upward thrust that deals <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> and causes Freminet to enter Pers Timer for 10s.
description.1: While Pers Timer is active, his Elemental Skill will turn into Shattering Pressure.
description.3: Shattering Pressure
description.4: Executes different sorts of attacks based on the Pressure Level of Pers Timer, and then cancels Pers Timer.
5: Level 0: Unleashes a vertical cut, dealing <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.
Levels 1 to 3: Unleashes a vertical cut alongside Pers, dealing <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> and Physical DMG. DMG dealt scales based on Pressure Level.
Level 4: Borrows the power of a fully-pressurized Pers to deal Physical DMG. Meanwhile, Normal Attack: Flowing Eddies will be replaced by Shattering Pressure.
description.7: Pers Timer
description.8: When Freminet uses Normal Attacks, he will also unleash waves of frost that deal <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> and increase Pers's Pressure Level.
description.9: The accompanying <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
description.11: Arkhe: Pneuma
description.12: At certain intervals, after using the upward thrust, a Spiritbreath Thorn in the form of another upward thrust will be created, dealing Pneuma-aligned <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.14: To immobilize one's opponent without taking their life can also be considered something of a "survival" strategy that one may choose.
description.15: "Pers... I leave the rest to you."

description.0: Unleashes a wave of untouchable cold, dealing <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo>, resetting the CD of the Elemental Skill "Pressurized Floe," and causing Freminet to enter the Subnautical Hunter mode for 10s.
description.2: While in Subnautical Hunter mode, Freminet's resistance to interruption will increase, and his Elemental Skill "Pressurized Floe" will obtain the following buffs:
3: CD is decreased by 70%.
Normal Attacks will increase the Pers Timer by 1 additional Pressure Level, and the frost released by his Normal Attacks deal 200% of their original DMG.
description.5: These effects will be canceled when Freminet leaves the field.
description.7: "Now... I have no need of any extraneous noise."

description.0: When Freminet unleashes Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure, if Pers Timer has yet to reach Pressure Level 4, the CD of Pressurized Floe will be decreased by 1s.
When Freminet triggers Shatter against opponents, the DMG dealt by Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will be increased by 40% for 5s.
Decreases Aquatic Stamina consumption for your own party members by 35%.
description.1: Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

description.0: The CRIT Rate of Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will be increased by 15%.

constellation2.name: Penguins and the Land of Plenty

description.0: Unleashing Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will restore 2 Energy to Freminet. If a Pressure Level 4 Shattering Pressure is unleashed, this will restore 3 Energy.

constellation3.name: Song of the Eddies and Bleached Sands

constellation4.name: Dance of the Snowy Moon and Flute

description.0: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, or Stellar-Conduct against opponents, his ATK will be increased by 9% for 6s. Max 2 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.
Increases the Level of Pressurized Floe by 3.

description.0: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, or Stellar-Conduct against opponents, his CRIT DMG will be increased by 12% for 6s. Max 3 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.

char_Furina_gen.name: Furina
char_Furina_gen.title: Endless Solo of Solitude
char_Furina_gen.description: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a solo dance, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents and changing her Arkhe alignment. If Salon Members or the Singer of Many Waters summoned by her Elemental Skill "Salon Solitaire" is present, their lineup will switch in response.

arkhe.1: At intervals, when Furina's Normal Attacks hit, a Spiritbreath Thorn or a Surging Blade will descend based on her current Arkhe alignment, dealing Pneuma- or Ousia-aligned <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro>.
arkhe.2: When Furina takes the field, her starting Arkhe alignment will be Ousia.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Invites the guests of the Salon Solitaire to come forth and aid in Furina's performance. Will summon either the Salon Members or the Singer of Many Waters based on Furina's current Arkhe alignment.
description.3: Foaming bubbles like celebrants shall dance, dealing <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> based on Furina's Max HP and summoning 3 Salon Members: the Ball Octopus-shaped Gentilhomme Usher, the Bubbly Seahorse-shaped Surintendante Chevalmarin, and the Armored Crab-shaped Mademoiselle Crabaletta.
description.4: They will attack nearby opponents at intervals, prioritizing the target of the active character, dealing <hydro>Hydro</hydro> DMG based on Max HP.
description.5: When they attack, if character(s) with more than 50% HP are nearby, the Members will increase their current attack's power based on the number of such characters, and consume said characters' HP. If 1/2/3/4 (or more) characters meet these requirements, the Members' attacks will deal 110%/120%/130%/140% of their original DMG.
description.7: Pneuma
description.8: Summons the Singer of Many Waters, who will heal nearby active character(s) based on Max HP at intervals.
description.10: The Salon Members and Singer of Many Waters share a duration, and when Furina uses her Charged Attack to change the guest type, the new guests will inherit the remaining duration.
description.11: While the Salon Members or the Singer of Many Waters is on the field, Furina can move on the water's surface.
description.13: A fixed roster of regulars frequent Furina's Salon Solitaire. At other times, Mademoiselle Crabaletta, Surintendante Chevalmarin, and Gentilhomme Usher shall visit, and on gloomy Wednesdays, it is the singer who comes by.

description.0: Rouses the impulse to revel, creating a stage of foam that will deal <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> based on Furina's Max HP and cause nearby party members to enter the Universal Revelry state: During this time, when nearby party members' HP increases or decreases, 1 Fanfare point will be granted to Furina for each percentage point of their Max HP by which their HP changes.
description.1: At the same time, Furina will increase the DMG dealt by and Incoming Healing Bonus of all nearby party members based on the amount of Fanfare she has.
description.2: When the duration ends, Furina's Fanfare points will be cleared.
description.4: "Cheer! Give praise! Be awed! Raise your glasses! Every night bereft of banqueting is a sordid squandering of sore, sober daylight... And, uh, those who are not yet of age may have grape juice instead!"

skillParams.3: Fanfare to DMG Increase Conversion Ratio

char_KamisatoAyaka_gen.description: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a flurry of sword ki.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging enemies along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.2: "Clouds shroud the moonlit night. Longing descends like a fog, filling the one detained with wanderlust."

description.7: "Feathers fleeting wet / the white heron treads water / a sight without flaw"

char_KamisatoAyato_gen.name: Kamisato Ayato
char_KamisatoAyato_gen.title: Pillar of Fortitude
char_KamisatoAyato_gen.description: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to dash forward and performs an iai.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Kamisato Ayato shifts positions and enters the Takimeguri Kanka state.
description.1: After this shift, he will leave a watery illusion at his original location. After it is formed, the watery illusion will explode if opponents are nearby or after its duration ends, dealing <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro>.
description.3: Takimeguri Kanka
description.4: In this state, Kamisato Ayato uses his Shunsuiken to engage in blindingly fast attacks, causing DMG from his Normal Attacks to be converted into <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro>. This cannot be overridden.
description.5: It also has the following properties:
6: After a Shunsuiken attack hits an opponent, it will grant Ayato the Namisen effect, increasing the DMG dealt by Shunsuiken based on Ayato's current Max HP. The initial maximum number of Namisen stacks is 4, and 1 stack can be gained through Shunsuiken every 0.1s. This effect will be dispelled when Takimeguri Kanka ends.
Kamisato Ayato's resistance to interruption is increased.
Unable to use Charged or Plunging Attacks.
description.8: Takimeguri Kanka will be cleared when Ayato leaves the field. Using Kamisato Art: Kyouka again while in the Takimeguri Kanka state will reset and replace the pre-existing state.
description.10: "When, I wonder, did you come under the illusion that you were winning?"
description.11: — Ayato is like this in both matter of martial prowess and political intrigue, but to preserve the dignity of his fellow Commissioners, he does not say such things to them. As such, only Thoma, Itto, and Ayaka have ever heard this line.

description.0: Unveils a garden of purity that silences the cacophony within.
description.1: While this space exists, Bloomwater Blades will constantly rain down and attack opponents within its AoE, dealing <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> and increasing the Normal Attack DMG of characters within.
description.3: "I can see them, you know. The ripples of your beating heart within this realm of still waters."

char_Kaveh_gen.name: Kaveh
char_Kaveh_gen.title: Empyrean Reflection
char_Kaveh_gen.description: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

normal.1: Uses Mehrak to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks.

charged.1: Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
charged.2: At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.2: Mehrak was created through the modification of ancient technology and may have some other functions apart from mapping work...

description.0: Completely unleashes Mehrak's energy and creates a cubic scanned space, dealing <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro> to all opponents within it, causing all Dendro Cores in its AoE to immediately burst, and granting Kaveh the following enhanced combat abilities for a specific duration:
1: Increases Kaveh's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack AoE, and converts his attack DMG to <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro> that cannot be overridden.
All Dendro Cores created by all your own party members through Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions will deal additional DMG when they burst.
Increases Kaveh's resistance to interruption.
description.2: These effects will be canceled once Kaveh leaves the field.
description.4: "Every building style includes the architect's unique worldview, and from this angle, one can say that the buildings themselves are coalescences of human memories."

description.0: When DMG dealt by a Dendro Core (including DMG from Burgeon and Hyperbloom) hits Kaveh, Kaveh will regain HP equal to 300% of his Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.
During Painted Dome, after Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, his Elemental Mastery will increase by 25. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 4 stacks.
description.1: This effect will be canceled when Painted Dome's effects end.

description.0: When Kaveh crafts Landscape, Building, and Courtyard-type Furnishings, he has a 100% chance to refund a portion of the materials used.
Within 3s after using Artistic Ingenuity, Kaveh's Dendro RES and Incoming Healing Bonus will be increased by 50% and 25% respectively.
Kaveh's Normal Attack SPD increases by 15% during Painted Dome.
Increases the Level of Painted Dome by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Dendro Cores created from Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions Kaveh triggers will deal 60% more DMG when they burst.
Increases the Level of Artistic Ingenuity by 3.
