This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

char_Keqing_gen.name: Keqing
char_Keqing_gen.title: Driving Thunder
char_Keqing_gen.description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Hurls a Lightning Stiletto that annihilates her opponents like the swift thunder.
description.1: When the Stiletto hits its target, it deals <electro>Electro DMG</electro> to opponents in a small AoE, and places a Stiletto Mark on the spot hit.
description.3: Hold
description.4: Hold to adjust the direction in which the Stiletto shall be thrown.
description.5: Stilettos thrown by the Hold attack mode can be suspended in mid-air, allowing Keqing to jump to them when using Stellar Restoration a second time.
description.7: Lightning Stiletto
description.8: If Keqing uses Stellar Restoration again or uses a Charged Attack while its duration lasts, it will clear the Stiletto Mark and produce different effects:
9: If she uses Stellar Restoration again, she will blink to the location of the Mark and unleash one slashing attack that deals <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>. When blinking to a Stiletto that was thrown from a Holding attack, Keqing can leap across obstructing terrain.
If Keqing uses a Charged Attack, she will ignite a series of thundering cuts at the Mark's location, dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>.
description.11: "Humans are like moths, endlessly chasing the flame we call gods and adepti. But this light that I have here is my own."

description.0: Keqing unleashes the power of lightning, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro> in an AOE.
description.1: She then blends into the shadow of her blade, striking a series of thunderclap-blows to nearby opponents simultaneously that deal multiple instances of <electro>Electro DMG</electro>. The final attack deals massive <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>.
description.3: The swiftest technique in Keqing's personal arsenal is fast enough to bring stars crashing down.

description.0: After recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present, Keqing's weapon gains an Electro Infusion for 5s.
When casting Starward Sword, Keqing's CRIT Rate is increased by 15%, and her Energy Recharge is increased by 15%. This effect lasts for 8s.
When dispatched on an expedition in Liyue, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
Recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present causes Keqing to deal 50% of her ATK as AoE Electro DMG at the start point and terminus of her Blink.
When Keqing's Normal and Charged Attacks hit opponents affected by <electro>Electro</electro>, they have a 50% chance of producing an Elemental Particle.
description.1: This effect can only occur once every 5s.

description.0: Increases the Level of Starward Sword by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: For 10s after Keqing triggers an <electro>Electro-related Elemental Reaction</electro>, her ATK is increased by 25%.
Increases the Level of Stellar Restoration by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When initiating a Normal Attack, a Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, Keqing gains a 6% <electro>Electro DMG Bonus</electro> for 8s.
description.1: Effects triggered by Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts are considered independent entities.

char_Kinich_gen.name: Kinich
char_Kinich_gen.title: Turnfire Hunt
char_Kinich_gen.description: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 rapid strikes.
normal.2: After using his Elemental Skill "Canopy Hunter: Riding High"'s mid-air swing, he can perform a Normal Attack in mid-air before landing.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to spin and throw his Claymore forward to attack opponents.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Kinich uses his big-game hunting skills to either move swiftly or attack his opponent.
description.1: When there is an opponent or object that can be attacked nearby, he will attach a grappling hook to the target and enter Nightsoul's Blessing with 0 Nightsoul points. If neither is nearby, he fires a grappling hook forward and swings in mid-air, and this Skill's CD is decreased by 60%.
description.2: This skill can be Held to release. When it is Held, Kinich can aim the grappling hook.
description.4: Nightsoul's Blessing: Kinich
description.5: Kinich's Nightsoul's Blessing lasts 10s and generates 2 Nightsoul points every second.
description.6: In this state, Kinich will hook onto a nearby opponent and perform a variable attack:
7: When using a Normal Attack, Kinich will fire Loop Shots as he loops around the grappled target based on his current movement direction, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro> and generating 3 Nightsoul points. Loop Shot DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

When Nightsoul points are at max, he can use the Elemental Skill "Scalespiker Cannon": Consume all Nightsoul points to deal Nightsoul-aligned <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro>. When "Scalespiker Cannon" is Held, Kinich can aim this shot. After firing the Cannon, Kinich will try to grapple to its target.
description.8: While in Nightsoul's Blessing, after grappling an opponent or firing "Scalespiker Cannon," a Blind Spot will be generated next to the opponent. When Kinich enters this Blind Spot, it will disappear and he will generate 4 Nightsoul points.
description.9: If the grapple connection should snap due to exceeding the maximum distance or some other reason, using a Normal Attack will establish a new connection with a nearby opponent before performing Loop Shots.
description.11: "All things come with a cost. I suggest you make a suitable offer... What? No, I don't do installments."

description.0: Unleashes the power of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw (on a limited, conditional, restricted, contractual, partial, temporary basis), dealing Nightsoul-aligned <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro>. Ajaw will unleash his Dragon Breath at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro>.
description.1: If Kinich is in Nightsoul's Blessing when this is used, this Blessing's duration is extended by 1.7s.
description.3: "Yes, yes! You stand before K'uhul Ajaw the Almighty Dragonlord! Come forward, then! Kneel, and kiss our feet!"

description.0: When Kinich is in Nightsoul's Blessing state, opponents hit by his Elemental Skill will enter the Desolation state, and when affected by Burning or Burgeon reaction DMG, they will restore 7 Nightsoul points to him. Nightsoul points can be gained this way once every 0.8s. The Desolation state will persist until this instance of Kinich's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.

After a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Kinich will gain 1 stack of Hunter's Experience that lasts 15s. Max 2 stacks. When Kinich uses Canopy Hunter: Riding High's Scalespiker Cannon, all stacks of Hunter's Experience will be consumed, with each stack consumed increasing the DMG dealt by this Cannon shot by 320% of Kinich's ATK.

passive3.name: Night Realm's Gift: Repaid in Full

description.0: When Kinich is in the air following Canopy Hunter: Riding High's mid-air swing, he can consume 10 Phlogiston points to perform another mid-air swing.
description.1: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Kinich. When the current active character is sprinting, in movement states that result from specific Talents, or in the air, when you switch to Kinich: Kinich will perform one of the following actions depending on the conditions met:
2: When facing a Coilgrass Sigil that can be interacted with: He will fire a grappling hook towards it to move;
When there are nearby opponents and you are in combat: Kinich will use Canopy Hunter: Riding High in the direction of the opponents;
description.3: Otherwise, Kinich will fire a grappling hook and swing, prioritizing valid Coilgrass Sigils as grapple targets.
description.4: Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.
description.6: When interacting with Coilgrass Sigils and other items that Yumkasaurs can interact with, "Canopy Hunter: Riding High" will be converted to "Yumkasaur Mimesis," which causes interactions with such items to follow rules applicable to Yumkasaurs, and which will not put Canopy Hunter: Riding High on CD.

description.0: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, interacting with some harvestable items will increase your own party members' Movement SPD by 15% for 10s. Additionally, the location of nearby resources unique to Natlan will appear on your mini-map.
After Kinich lands from Canopy Hunter: Riding High's mid-air swing, his Movement SPD will increase by 30% for 6s.
description.1: Additionally, Scalespiker Cannon's CRIT DMG is increased by 100%.

description.0: When Kinich's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, it will decrease their <dendro>Dendro RES</dendro> by 30% for 6s.
description.1: Additionally, the first Scalespiker Cannon Kinich fires after entering Nightsoul's Blessing has increased AoE, and its DMG increases by 100%.

description.0: Increases the Level of Canopy Hunter: Riding High by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When in Nightsoul's Blessing, Kinich will restore 5 Energy after using his Loop Shots or after unleashing the Scalespiker Cannon. Energy can be regenerated this way once every 2.8s.
description.1: Additionally, Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord deals 70% more DMG.

description.0: Increases the Level of Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: After Scalespiker Cannon hits an opponent, it will bounce between opponents once, dealing 700% of Kinich's ATK as <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro>.
description.1: If this Scalespiker Cannon triggers the buffs that Ascension Talent "Flame Spirit Pact" or the Constellation "Tiger Beetle's Palm" grant to the Cannon, the bouncing attack will also obtain the relevant buffs.

char_Kirara_gen.name: Kirara
char_Kirara_gen.title: Cat Upon the Eaves
char_Kirara_gen.description: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 3 rapid claw strikes.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Press
description.1: Leaps into the air with all the agility of a cat passing through the bushes, and thwacks her foes with a flying kick that deals <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro> while creating a Shield of Safe Transport. This will also briefly <dendro>apply Dendro</dendro> to Kirara. The shield will absorb <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro> with 250% effectiveness. The shield's DMG absorption will be based on Kirara's Max HP and will not exceed a certain percentage of that Max HP. The remaining DMG absorption on a Shield of Safe Transport will stack on a new one when it is created, and its duration will reset.
description.3: Hold
description.4: Out of her desire to "deliver within half a day," Kirara deploys a Shield of Safe Transport identical to the one that can be created by pressing the skill. She will also curl up into a special express delivery box, entering the Urgent Neko Parcel state in order to move and fight more swiftly.
description.6: Urgent Neko Parcel
7: Deals <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro> to opponents she crashes into. This effect can be triggered once on each opponent every 0.5s.
When in this state, Kirara's movement speed, climbing speed, and jumping power are all increased, and her Stamina Consumption from climbing is increased.
When the duration ends or the skill is used again, a Flipclaw Strike more powerful than the attack in the Press Mode will be unleashed, dealing <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro>.
The Urgent Neko Parcel state lasts a maximum of 10s. When the state ends, the skill will enter CD. The longer Kirara spends in this state, the longer the CD will be.
Sprinting or actively canceling climbing will end this state early.
description.9: "So you wanna know the secret to speedy deliveries? Well, it's all in the legs!"

description.0: Smash opponents with a Special Delivery Package used for punishing parcel thieves, dealing AoE Dendro DMG. After the Special Delivery Package explodes, it will split up into many Cat Grass Cardamoms that will explode either upon contact with opponents or after a period of time, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.
description.2: "Hehe, that's right, this stuff was made to deal with those parcel thieves! Remember to leave a 5-star rating once you've received yours!"

description.0: When Kirara is in the Urgent Neko Parcel state of Meow-teor Kick, each impact against an opponent will grant her a stack of Reinforced Packaging. This effect can be triggered once for each opponent hit every 0.5s. Max 3 stacks. When the Urgent Neko Parcel state ends, each stack of Reinforced Packaging will create 1 Shield of Safe Transport for Kirara. The shields that are created this way will have 20% of the DMG absorption that the Shield of Safe Transport produced by Meow-teor Kick would have. If Kirara is already protected by a Shield of Safe Transport created by Meow-teor Kick, its DMG absorption will stack with these shields and its duration will reset.
Every 1,000 Max HP Kirara possesses will increase the DMG dealt by Meow-teor Kick by 0.4%, and the DMG dealt by Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch by 0.3%.
When Kirara is in the party, animals who produce Fowl, Raw Meat, or Chilled Meat will not be startled when party members approach them.
Every 8,000 Max HP Kirara possesses will cause her to create 1 extra Cat Grass Cardamom when she uses Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch. A maximum of 4 extra can be created this way.
When Kirara is in the Urgent Neko Parcel state of Meow-teor Kick, she will grant other party members she crashes into Critical Transport Shields.
description.1: The DMG absorption of Critical Transport Shield is 40% of the maximum absorption Meow-teor Kick's normal Shields of Safe Transport are capable of, and will absorb Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness.
description.2: Critical Transport Shields last 12s and can be triggered once on each character every 10s.

description.0: Increases the Level of Meow-teor Kick by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: After active character(s) protected by Shields of Safe Transport or Critical Transport Shields hit opponents with Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, Kirara will perform a coordinated attack with them using Small Cat Grass Cardamoms, dealing 200% of her ATK as Dendro DMG. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3.8s. This CD is shared between all party members.

constellation5.name: A Thousand Miles in a Day

description.0: Increases the Level of Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: All nearby party members gain a 12% All Elemental DMG Bonus for 15s after Kirara uses her Elemental Skill or Burst.

description.0: Jumpy Dumpty is tons of boom-bang-fun!

description.6: Starts with 2 charges.
description.8: Jumpy Dumpty is Klee's good friend! She can't help but introduce him to everyone.

description.2: The knights all believe that Klee must have a lucky star watching over her to have never been hurt by any of her own bombs...

description.1: This Explosive Spark is consumed by the next Charged Attack, which costs no Stamina and deals 50% increased DMG.

upgradedDescription.1: For 12s after triggering the above effect, Klee's ATK is increased by 60%.

char_KujouSara_gen.name: Kujou Sara
char_KujouSara_gen.title: Crowfeather Kaburaya
char_KujouSara_gen.description: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

charged.1: Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
charged.2: While aiming, crackling lightning will accumulate on the arrowhead. An arrow fully charged with the storm's might will deal <electro>Electro DMG</electro>.
charged.3: When in the Crowfeather Cover state, a fully-charged arrow will leave a Crowfeather behind after it hits.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Retreats rapidly with the speed of a tengu, summoning the protection of the Crowfeather.
description.1: Gains Crowfeather Cover for 18s, and when Kujou Sara fires a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Crowfeather Cover will be consumed, and will leave a Crowfeather at the target location.
description.2: Crowfeathers will trigger Tengu Juurai: Ambush after a short time, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro> and granting the active character within its AoE an ATK Bonus based on Kujou Sara's Base ATK.
description.4: The ATK Bonuses from different Tengu Juurai will not stack, and their effects and duration will be determined by the last Tengu Juurai to take effect.
description.6: The tengu race have never lacked for exceptional talents who have received an Electro Vision. It's just that they often habitually chant praises to the Electro Archon while manipulating Electro. The chants go something like this
description.7: "Show forth your might, O praiseworthy Narukami, and grant this supplicant your thunderous might! Sowaka!"

description.0: Casts down Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker, dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>. Afterwards, Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker spreads out into 4 consecutive bouts of Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster, dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>.
description.1: Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker and Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster can provide the active character within their AoE with the same ATK Bonus as given by the Elemental Skill, Tengu Stormcall.
description.3: The ATK Bonus provided by various kinds of Tengu Juurai will not stack, and their effects and duration will be determined by the last Tengu Juurai to take effect.
description.5: Sara departed from her people, the tengu, and also temporarily lost her faith in the Tenryou Commission. But once the clouds over her heart cleared, she found her own lightning anew.

description.0: While in the Crowfeather Cover state provided by Tengu Stormcall, Aimed Shot charge times are decreased by 60%.
When Tengu Juurai: Ambush hits opponents, Kujou Sara will restore 1.2 Energy to all party members for every 100% Energy Recharge she has. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.
When dispatched on an expedition in Inazuma, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
When Tengu Juurai grants characters ATK Bonuses or hits opponents, the CD of Tengu Stormcall is decreased by 1s.
description.1: This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

description.0: Unleashing Tengu Stormcall will leave a weaker Crowfeather at Kujou Sara's original position that will deal 30% of its original DMG.
Increases the Level of Subjugation: Koukou Sendou by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: The number of Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster released by Subjugation: Koukou Sendou is increased to 6.
Increases the Level of Tengu Stormcall by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: The <electro>Electro DMG</electro> of characters who have had their ATK increased by Tengu Juurai has its CRIT DMG increased by 60%.

char_KukiShinobu_gen.name: Kuki Shinobu
char_KukiShinobu_gen.title: Mender of Tribulations
char_KukiShinobu_gen.description: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader. Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Creates a Grass Ring of Sanctification at the cost of part of her HP, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro> to nearby opponents.
description.3: Follows your current active character around. Deals <electro>Electro DMG</electro> to nearby opponents every 1.5s and restores HP for active character(s) within the ring's AoE based on Kuki Shinobu's Max HP.
description.5: The HP consumption from using this skill can only bring her to 20% HP.
description.7: "Band the Naku Weed into a loop around your waist, and it shall exorcise evil."

description.0: Stabs an evil-excoriating blade into the ground, creating a field that cleanses the area of all that is foul, dealing continuous <electro>Electro DMG</electro> to opponents within its AoE based on Shinobu's Max HP.
description.1: If Shinobu's HP is less than or equal to 50% when this skill is used, the field will last longer.
description.3: This was originally a technique used in weeding and in ritual prayers for the yearly harvest, but Shinobu has not forgotten it, though her career as a shrine maiden may have ended.

description.0: When Shinobu's HP is not higher than 50%, her Healing Bonus is increased by 15%.
Sanctifying Ring's abilities will be boosted based on Shinobu's Elemental Mastery:
1: Healing amount will be increased by 75% of Elemental Mastery.
DMG dealt is increased by 25% of Elemental Mastery.

description.0: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on an Inazuma Expedition for 20 hours.
Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite's AoE is increased by 50%.
Grass Ring of Sanctification's duration is increased by 3s.
Increases the Level of Sanctifying Ring by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When the Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks of the character affected by Shinobu's Grass Ring of Sanctification hit opponents, a Thundergrass Mark will land on the opponent's position and deal AoE Electro DMG based on 9.7% of Shinobu's Max HP.
description.1: This effect can occur once every 5s.

description.0: Increases the Level of Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When Kuki Shinobu takes lethal DMG, this instance of DMG will not take her down. This effect will automatically trigger when her HP reaches 1 and will trigger once every 60s.
description.1: When Shinobu's HP drops below 25%, she will gain 150 Elemental Mastery for 15s. This effect will trigger once every 60s.

char_LanYan_gen.name: Lan Yan
char_LanYan_gen.title: Spring Woven From Jade
char_LanYan_gen.description: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.

normal.1: Wields her Feathermoon Rings to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to throw out a Feathermoon Ring, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

plunging.1: Gathers the power of Anemo and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> upon impact with the ground.

description.0: Summoning forth the Swallow-Wisp Shield, a secret art passed down across generations, Lan Yan dashes forward and, upon making contact with her target, will leap back into the air.
description.1: The Swallow-Wisp Shield's DMG absorption scales based on her ATK, and has a 250% absorption efficiency against <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.2: While in mid-air due to the effects of her Elemental Skill: Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance, pressing her Elemental Skill again or pressing Normal Attack will cause Lan Yan to hurl her Feathermoon Rings at an opponent, and they will spin between nearby opponents twice upon hit, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.3: Holding the Skill will cause it to behave differently.
description.6: Enter Aiming Mode to adjust the dash direction.
description.8: "The clouds cut the lunar light, like shadows silver gracing one's sight."

description.0: Lan Yan creates a Feathermoon Swallow Array, pulling in nearby opponents and objects and dealing multiple instances of <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.2: Strictly speaking, with only Lan Yan herself present, it cannot properly be called an "array." However, if her Rattan Figures are brought into the picture, she can sort of fulfill the requirements... Probably.

description.0: When the dash from the Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance hits a target, if it interacts with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, the Swallow-Wisp Shield will undergo Elemental Absorption, with the converted shield absorbing DMG from the corresponding element with 250% efficiency.
description.1: Additionally, if this use of Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance causes the Swallow-Wisp Shield to undergo Elemental Absorption, the Feathermoon Rings that Lan Yan throws at her foes additionally deal Elemental DMG equal to 50% of the original in the corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

description.0: The Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance and the Elemental Burst Lustrous Moonrise deal increased DMG equal to 309% and 774% of Lan Yan's Elemental Mastery respectively.

passive3.name: Thought and Intent, Like Silken Scent

description.0: When Lan Yan is in the party, your characters will not startle Crystalflies and certain other animals when getting near them.
description.1: Check the "Other" sub-category of the "Living Beings / Wildlife" section in the Archive for creatures this skill works on.

constellation1.name: "As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds"

description.0: After triggering the Elemental Absorption from the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms," this instance of Lan Yan's Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance will produce another Feathermoon Ring when they are thrown at opponents.
description.1: You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms."

description.0: While the Swallow-Wisp Shield is active, when your active party member's Normal Attacks deal DMG, 40% of the Shield's DMG absorption will be restored, up to its original maximum absorption. This effect can occur once every 2s.

constellation3.name: "On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog"

description.0: Increases the Level of Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: After Lan Yan uses her Elemental Burst Lustrous Moonrise, the Elemental Mastery of all nearby party members increases by 60 for 12s.

constellation5.name: "Having Met You, My Heart is Gladdened"

description.0: Increases the Level of Lustrous Moonrise by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellation6.name: "Let Us Away on Sylphic Wing, the Silvered Ornaments to Ring"

description.0: Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance gains 1 additional charge.

char_Lauma_gen.name: Lauma
char_Lauma_gen.title: Evermoon's Sacrament Song
char_Lauma_gen.description: A Maiden blessed by moonlight and the grove alike, hope born to the Frostmoon Scions.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 attacks that deal <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro>.

charged.1: Lauma undergoes Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis, transforming into an envoy of the tranquil forest and consuming Stamina to charge forward for up to 10s. While in this state, Lauma's interruption resistance is increased, and she can consume additional Stamina to perform up to two consecutive jumps.
charged.2: When exiting the Spirit Envoy state, Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis will enter cooldown, during which time, Lauma's Charged Attack will be transformed into Spiritcall Prayer: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro> to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

plunging.1: Calling upon the might of Dendro, Lauma plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path and dealing <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro> upon impact with the ground.

skillParams.3: Spirit Envoy Form Movement Stamina Cost
skillParams.4: Spirit Envoy Form Jumping Stamina Cost

description.0: Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a Frostgrove Sanctuary with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.
description.3: Intone a Hymn of Hunting, dealing <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro>.
description.6: Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 Verdant Dew. Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of AoE Dendro DMG and another instance of AoE Dendro DMG that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of Moon Song. Each time you Hold to cast an Elemental Skill, a maximum of 3 Verdant Dew can be consumed in this way.
description.8: Additionally, when Lauma's Elemental Skill or attacks from Frostgrove Sanctuary hit an opponent, that opponent's <dendro>Dendro RES</dendro> and <hydro>Hydro RES</hydro> will be decreased for 10s.

skillParamsEncoding.2: {{2, percent(fixed: 1)}}% Elemental Mastery Per Verdant Dew

burst.name: Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon

description.0: Let the wishes of all beings become as moonlight that bathes the earth. Lauma incants a sacred song of the far north, gaining 18 stacks of Pale Hymn.
description.1: Additionally, if Lauma uses her Elemental Burst while she has Moon Song, or she gains Moon Song within 15s of using her Elemental Burst, she will consume all Moon Song stacks and gain 6 stacks of Pale Hymn for every Moon Song stack consumed. This effect can only be triggered once for each Elemental Burst used, including the 15 seconds following its use.
description.3: Pale Hymn
description.4: When nearby party members deal Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom DMG, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed and the DMG dealt will be increased based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery. If this DMG hits multiple opponents at once, then multiple stacks of Pale Hymn will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.
description.5: The duration for each stack of Pale Hymn is counted independently.

skillParams.0: Pale Hymn Stacks Gained From Elemental Burst
skillParams.1: Moon Song to Pale Hymn Conversion
skillParams.2: Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG Increase

description.0: For the next 20s after Lauma uses her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, corresponding differing buff effects will be granted depending on the party's Moonsign. The buffs provided by different Moonsign levels cannot stack.
description.3: Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG dealt by all nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 15%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT.
description.6: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG CRIT Rate +10%, CRIT DMG +20%.

description.0: Each point of Elemental Mastery Lauma has will give her the following bonuses:
1: DMG dealt by her Elemental Skill is increased by 0.04%. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 32%.
The cooldown of her Charged Attack Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis is reduced by 0.02%. The maximum reduction obtainable this way is 20%.

description.0: When a Bloom reaction is triggered by a party member, it will be converted into the Lunar-Bloom reaction, with every point of Elemental Mastery that Lauma has increasing Lunar-Bloom's Base DMG by 0.0175%, up to a maximum of 14%.
description.2: Additionally, when Lauma is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

description.0: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.
description.1: Additionally, Lauma appears to have a special affinity with some small animals affected by kuuvahki...

constellation1.name: "O Lips, Weave Me Songs and Psalms"

description.0: After Lauma uses her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko or her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon, she will gain Threads of Life for 20s.
description.1: During this time, when nearby party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, nearby active characters will recover HP equal to 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 1.9s.
description.2: Additionally, the Stamina cost for Lauma's Spirit Envoy Form will be reduced by 40%, and its Max Duration will be extended by 5s.

constellation2.name: "Twine Warnings and Tales From the North"

description.0: The Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon is enhanced:
1: Pale Hymn effects are increased: All nearby party members' Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG is further increased by 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery, and their Lunar-Bloom DMG is further increased by 400% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery.
description.3: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is increased by 40%.

constellation3.name: "Seek Not to Tread the Sly Fox's Path"

description.0: Increases the Level of Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellation4.name: "Nor Yearn for the Great Bear's Might"

description.0: When attacks from the Frostgrove Sanctuary summoned by her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko hit opponents, Lauma will regain 4 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

constellation5.name: "If Truth May Be Subject to Witness"

description.0: Increases the Level of Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellation6.name: "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight"

description.0: When the Frostgrove Sanctuary attacks opponents, it will deal 1 additional instance of AoE Dendro DMG equal to 185% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. This instance of DMG will not consume any Pale Hymn stacks and will provide Lauma with 2 stacks of Pale Hymn, as well as refreshing the duration of Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner.
description.1: This effect can occur up to 8 times during each Frostgrove Sanctuary. When using the Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, all Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner will be removed.
description.3: Additionally, when Lauma uses a Normal Attack while she has Pale Hymn stacks, she will consume 1 stack to convert this to deal <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro> equal to 150% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.
description.5: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is elevated by 25%.

char_Layla_gen.name: Layla
char_Layla_gen.title: Fantastical Evening Star
char_Layla_gen.description: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Puts forth a shield known as the Curtain of Slumber, dealing <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.1: The Curtain of Slumber's DMG Absorption is based on Layla's Max HP and absorbs <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> with 250% effectiveness. When the shield is deployed, Layla will have <cryo>Cryo</cryo> applied to her briefly.
description.3: Night Stars and Shooting Stars
description.4: While the Curtain of Slumber is active, it will create 1 Night Star that will be attached to it every 1.5s. When a character protected by this shield uses an Elemental Skill, 2 Night Stars will be created. Night Stars can be created once every 0.3s in this way. A maximum of 4 Night Stars can be accumulated at any one time.
description.5: Once the Curtain of Slumber has accumulated 4 Night Stars and there are opponents nearby, these Night Stars will transform into homing Shooting Stars that will be fired off in sequence, dealing <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> to any opponents hit.
description.6: If the Curtain of Slumber's duration ends or it is destroyed, the Night Stars will disappear. If they are already being fired off as Shooting Stars, these Shooting Stars will last until this wave of shots ends.
description.8: New Night Stars cannot be created until the previous wave of Shooting Stars has been fired completely.
description.10: "She and I are like two master artisans who have never met, yet who sit at the same cushioned seat, embroidering the same dream-flower."

description.0: Unleashes a Celestial Dreamsphere that constantly fires Starlight Slugs at opponents within its AoE, dealing <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.1: When a Starlight Slug hits, it will generate 1 Night Star for nearby Curtains of Slumber. Each Curtain of Slumber can gain 1 Night Star this way every 0.5s.
description.3: "Sleep now, sleep now; and may many destinies be revealed before your slumbering eyes, within your star-paved dreams."

description.0: While the Curtain of Slumber is active, the Deep Sleep effect will activate each time the Curtain gains 1 Night Star:
1: The Shield Strength of a character under the effect of the Curtain of Slumber increases by 6%.
This effect can have a maximum of 4 stacks and persists until the Curtain of Slumber disappears.

description.0: The DMG dealt by the Shooting Stars fired by Nights of Formal Focus is increased by 1.5% of Layla's Max HP.
When Layla crafts Character Talent Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.
The Shield Absorption of the Curtain of Slumber generated by Nights of Formal Focus is increased by 20%.
description.1: Additionally, when unleashing Nights of Formal Focus, she will generate a shield for any nearby party members who are not being protected by a Curtain of Slumber. This shield will have 35% of the absorption of a Curtain of Slumber, will last for 12s, and will absorb <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> with 250% effectiveness.

description.0: When Shooting Stars from Nights of Formal Focus strike opponents, they will each restore 1 Energy to Layla. Each Shooting Star can restore Energy to her in this manner once.
Increases the Level of Nights of Formal Focus by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When Nights of Formal Focus starts to fire off Shooting Stars, it will grant all nearby party members the Dawn Star effect, causing their Normal and Charged Attack DMG to increase based on 5% of Layla's Max HP.
description.1: Dawn Star can last up to 3s and will be removed 0.05s after dealing Normal or Charged Attack DMG.

description.0: Increases the Level of Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Shooting Stars from Nights of Formal Focus deal 40% increased DMG, and Starlight Slugs from Dream of the Star-Stream Shaker deal 40% increased DMG.
description.1: Additionally, the interval between the creation of Night Stars via Nights of Formal Focus is decreased by 20%.

char_Linnea_gen.name: Linnea
char_Linnea_gen.title: Augur of Wonders
char_Linnea_gen.description: Naturalist and Advisor to the Nod-Krai Branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

charged.1: Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
charged.2: While aiming, stone crystals will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged crystalline arrow will deal <geo>Geo DMG</geo>.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Adventure with Lumi! Depending on how you Tap, Lumi attacks in different forms.
description.3: Lumi strikes in a Super Power Form, attacking nearby enemies continuously, dealing AoE Geo DMG. If there are Moondrifts nearby, Lumi will also deal AoE Geo DMG to nearby enemies, which will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
description.6: Time to show what we're really capable of! After using her Elemental Skill, Linnea will feed Lumi sparkling gemstones when her Elemental Skill or Normal Attack is Tapped repeatedly. A full-bellied Lumi will strike in her Ultimate Power Form, dealing an especially powerful instance of AoE Geo DMG that is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, switching to Standard Power Form.
description.7: Additionally, tapping the Elemental Skill increases Linnea's interruption resistance.

burst.name: Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions

description.0: Even master adventurers need proper rest! Linnea summons Lumi to strike in Super Power Form, healing nearby party members. For a short duration, she will continuously heal nearby active party members based on Linnea's DEF.
description.1: If Lumi is already on the field when Linnea unleashes Elemental Burst, Lumi's active duration will be reset instead and her Strike Form will not change.
description.3: "Any professional adventurer worth their salt prizes making it out of a serious jam over making discoveries, however unprecedented!"

description.0: When Lumi is present on the field, the <geo>Geo RES</geo> of opponents near Lumi will decrease by 15%.
description.2: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Linnea's Elemental Skill Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry! and Elemental Burst Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions are enhanced. After summoning Lumi, the Geo RES of opponents near Lumi will be further decreased by 15%.

description.0: Linnea will increase the Elemental Mastery of certain characters in your party according to your current active character. Increase in Elemental Mastery is based on 5% of Linnea's DEF. If your current active character:
1: Is a Moonsign character: Increase this character's Elemental Mastery.
Is not a Moonsign character: Increase Linnea's own Elemental Mastery.

description.0: When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Linnea has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.
description.2: Additionally, when Linnea is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

description.0: When Linnea is not in combat, the charge time of her Aimed Shot is greatly decreased, and she will shoot an Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow instead. Different effects will occur depending on the targets hit:
1: Specific animals: Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow will be transformed into a special "Net" that can capture the essence and form of these animals, using them as a medium to manifest the animal's physical form again. The "Net" can only be used for a limited number of times each week.

Ore veins used in forging: Linnea will dispatch Lumi, who will quickly strike at the ore marked by the Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow, then collect the dislodged ore. If Lumi is not on the field, Linnea will summon her for a short duration to help obtain the ore.
description.3: The DMG dealt to opponents by Linnea's Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow is reduced to 20% of her original Charged Arrow. Additionally, after firing a certain number of Ultra Convenient Quick Arrows within a short period of time, Linnea needs to take a temporary break before she can continue using them.

description.0: When unleashing Elemental Skill Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea gains 6 stacks of the Field Catalog effect for 10s. Max 18 stacks. When nearby party members deal Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, consume 1 stack of Field Catalog to increase the DMG dealt. The increase in DMG is equal to 75% of Linnea's DEF.
description.1: Additionally, when Lumi uses Million Ton Crush in her Ultimate Power Form, Linnea can consume up to 5 stacks of Field Catalog. Each stack will increase the DMG dealt by 150% of Linnea's DEF.

description.0: Within 8s after triggering Moondrift Harmony, all Hydro and Geo party members have their CRIT DMG increased by 40%. Additionally, when Lumi uses Million Ton Crush in her Ultimate Power Form, the CRIT DMG of that attack increases by an additional 150%.
description.2: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When Lumi uses Heavy Overdrive Hammer in her Super Power Form, or when she uses Million Ton Crush in her Ultimate Power Form, an instance of Moondrift Harmony will be triggered. For this instance of Moondrift Harmony, all Hydro and Geo characters in the party will be considered to have applied their Elements in the reaction.

char_Lyney_gen.name: Lyney
char_Lyney_gen.title: Spectacle of Phantasmagoria
char_Lyney_gen.description: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

charged.1: Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
charged.2: While aiming, flames will run across the arrowhead before being fired. Different effects will occur based on the time spent charging.
3: Charge Level 1: Fires off a Pyro-infused arrow, dealing <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro>.
Charge Level 2: Fires off a Prop Arrow that deals <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro>, and upon hit, it will summon a Grin-Malkin Hat.
charged.4: When firing the Prop Arrow, and when Lyney has more than 60% HP, he will consume a portion of his HP to obtain 1 Prop Surplus stack. Max 5 stacks. The effect will be removed after the character spends 30s out of combat.
charged.5: The lowest Lyney can drop to through this method is 60% of his Max HP.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

1: Can taunt nearby opponents and attract their attacks. Each opponent can only be taunted by the Hat once every 5s.
The Hat will inherit a percentage of Lyney's Max HP.
If destroyed, or if its duration expires, it will fire off a Pyrotechnic Strike at 1 nearby opponent, dealing Pyro DMG.
grinMalkin.2: Only 1 Hat can exist at any given time.

arkhe.1: At certain intervals, the Prop Arrow will cause a Spiritbreath Thorn to descend upon its hit location, dealing Pneuma-aligned <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro>.

description.0: Lyney does a flourish with his hat, unleashing a firework surprise!
description.1: When used, he will clear all current Prop Surplus stacks and deal <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> to opponents in front of him. DMG will be increased according to the stacks cleared, and this will also regenerate Lyney's HP based on his Max HP.
description.3: When a Grin-Malkin Hat created by Lyney is on the field, the fireworks will cause it to explode, dealing <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> equal to that of a Pyrotechnic Strike.
description.4: The DMG dealt through the Grin-Malkin Hat in this way is considered Charged Attack DMG.
description.6: "Everyone knows that magicians will intentionally misdirect the audience... Ah, yes, while you were looking my way, the hat and assistant over there have both disappeared... Fascinating, is it not?"

description.3: Grin-Malkin Cat can be actively canceled.
description.5: "Watch closely now. This is a time for miracles, and it belongs to just the two of us!"

char_Mavuika_gen.name: Mavuika
char_Mavuika_gen.title: Night-Igniting Flame
char_Mavuika_gen.description: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive claymore strikes.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.3: All-Fire Armaments
description.4: Has different forms when Tapped or Held.
description.6: Tap

description.10: "Ancient Name Unbound": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as a Flamestrider. In this state, Mavuika can ride the Flamestrider at high speed, or activate its hidden backup propulsion module to temporarily cross various terrain types and glide in mid-air. Mavuika's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will also be converted to deal Nightsoul-aligned <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> which cannot be overridden. When sprinting, she also deals Nightsoul-aligned <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> to opponents along her path.
description.12: While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Tapping the Elemental Skill can switch the All-Fire Armaments' form. The Armaments will disappear once Mavuika's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.
description.15: Continuously consumes Nightsoul points according to the All-Fire Armaments' form. Mavuika's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends once her Nightsoul points are exhausted.
description.17: <i>If you told Mavuika that in another world vehicles like the Flamestrider required license plates for identification, that would make her happy too:
description.18: "Well, mine's the only one that exists here. Guess that means I get to pick whatever plate number I want, huh?"

Riding her Flamestrider high in the air, she uses a powerful Sunfell Slice against opponents on the ground, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> and entering the "Crucible of Death and Life" state.

description.12: Crucible of Death and Life will be canceled when Mavuika leaves the field.
description.14: "—But this time, I want to break the cycle and free us from this fate for good."

description.3: Tap

char_Mualani_gen.name: Mualani
char_Mualani_gen.title: Splish-Splash Wavechaser
char_Mualani_gen.description: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 attacks that deal <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to smack a Pufferball into the air that deals <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> upon landing.

plunging.1: Gathers the power of Hydro and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> upon impact with the ground.

description.0: Combining her mastery of speed and the waves and water, Mualani can surf anytime, anywhere.
description.1: After using this skill, Mualani will gain 60 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
description.3: Nightsoul's Blessing: Mualani
description.4: Continuously consume Nightsoul points. When they are depleted or when the skill is used again, Mualani's Nightsoul's Blessing will end. The state itself has the following traits:
5: Mualani mounts her Sharky Surfboard, increasing Mualani's Movement SPD and interruption resistance. Mualani can move on water and liquid Phlogiston while this state is active, and she will take no DMG from the latter.

Normal Attacks will be converted to Sharky's Bites, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> based on Mualani's Max HP. Sharky's Bites can be used in mid-air. DMG dealt this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
When she makes contact with opponents in this state, Mualani applies "Marked as Prey" to them and gains 1 Wave Momentum stack. Max 3 stacks. 1 stack can be gained from the same opponent every 0.7s.
description.7: Wave Momentum and Marked as Prey
description.8: When Mualani uses Sharky's Bite, her DMG dealt increases based on Wave Momentum stacks. When she has 3 stacks, Sharky's Bite will be converted to Sharky's Surging Bite, further increasing her DMG and removing all her stacks when hitting an opponent.
description.9: When Sharky's Bite hits an opponent Marked as Prey, that mark will be removed, and she will fire Shark Missiles at up to 5 nearby opponents Marked as Prey, dealing DMG to them equal to this Sharky's Bite instance and clearing their Marks. If more than 1 opponent is the target of Sharky's Bite and Shark Missiles, the DMG dealt will decrease, decreasing at most to 72% of the original DMG when 3 opponents are targeted.
description.11: First off, Sharky is a freshwater shark on top of being a surfboard. Second, it's not that it wants to eat for real, just that it definitely bites for real.

skillParams.2: Sharky's Surging Bite Additional DMG Bonus

description.0: Fires a Super Shark Missile that can track opponents, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> based on Mualani's Max HP.
description.2: Mualani picked this moniker for launching her Shark Missile because it combines the warmth of explosive passion with a more chill, laid-back vibe — most hot spring-ish.

description.0: When Sharky's Surging Bite hits an opponent, a Puffer will be generated nearby. Mualani will restore 20 Nightsoul points when she picks up a Puffer. Only 2 such Puffers can be created in this way during a single instance of being in Nightsoul's Blessing.

After a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Mualani will gain 1 stack of Wavechaser's Exploits, which lasts for 20s. Max 3 stacks. When she uses Boomsharka-laka, Mualani will clear all Wavechaser's Exploits stacks and increase the DMG of this Boomsharka-laka by 15%/30%/45% of her Max HP based on the number of stacks cleared.

passive3.name: Night Realm's Gift: Crests and Troughs

Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.
description.3: Additionally, Mualani's Nightsoul point or Phlogiston consumption while moving on water and Liquid Phlogiston during Nightsoul's Blessing is decreased by 75% while in Natlan, and her Nightsoul point consumption is decreased by 35% while doing the same outside Natlan.

passive.name: The Trick Is to Keep Smiling!

The DMG dealt by the first Sharky's Surging Bite after Mualani enters Nightsoul's Blessing and the Shark Missiles it triggers is increased by 66% of Mualani's Max HP. This instance of increased DMG is subject to the diminishing DMG rules of Surfshark Wavebreaker.
description.1: In addition, while out of combat, Mualani's Nightsoul's Blessing state consumes 30% less Phlogiston and Nightsoul points.

description.13: Lo, the god of grass and trees shines her ultimate truth into the void, illuminating the origin and destruction of the three karmas.

The CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG of Lunar-Bloom DMG received are increased by 10% and 20% respectively.

char_Nefer_gen.title: Secret Beneath the Sands

The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 1.8s.
description.6: Ororon's Nightsoul's Blessing state lasts 6s.

passive3.name: Night Realm's Gift: Flowing Fog, Spritely Shadows

description.0: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Ororon. When the active character is currently in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Ororon: Ororon will leap up high. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your party.
description.2: Holding Aiming Mode will cause Ororon to enter the "Spiritspeaker" state, which will allow him to interact with "Nightspirit Graffiti" and "Nightspirit Sigils," extracting information and power from them. The rules for interacting with these objects follow the same rules as those governing Iktomisaurus interactions.
description.4: Additionally, holding the jump button will cause Ororon to consume 75 Stamina and leap. In areas within Natlan where Phlogiston mechanics are present, Ororon will prioritize consuming 5 Phlogiston to leap to a height higher still.

Opponents affected by Nighttide take 50% increased DMG from Hypersense triggered by the Ascension Talent, "Nightshade Synesthesia." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Nightshade Synesthesia."

constellation2.name: King Bee of the Hidden Honeyed Wine

char_Prune_gen.name: Prune
char_Prune_gen.title: Childlike Dreams Cherished
char_Prune_gen.description: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!

normal.1: Performs up to 3 attacks by swinging the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and performs an upward hammer swing, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo> to opponents in front.

plunging.1: Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> upon impact with the ground.

description.0: Determined to take down the "evil" witch and save her beloved Descartes, Prune unleashes the power of the wind! She strikes at the Witchlure Bell using her Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.1: If Prune triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction in the opponent with this attack, her Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime is changed to Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes! for the next 6s.
description.3: Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!
description.4: Ensconces the Banehunter Oathhammer in the element involved in the earlier Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction. After tapping to unleash, Prune will launch a midair kick at the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing DMG to opponents in front of her of the corresponding elemental type.

burst.name: The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!

description.0: Prune gently swings the Witchlure Bell, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo> to nearby opponents. After this, the Bell will enter the Hunter-Seeker mode.
description.3: In this mode, the Witchlure Bell will follow the current active character, attacking surrounding opponents at intervals and dealing <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo>. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

description.0: During the Elemental Burst The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!, after the Witchlure Bell in Hunter-Seeker mode deals DMG to an opponent, if this DMG triggers Swirl or Stellar Swirl in an opponent, it will also summon a Banehunter Oathhammer that will deal 150% of Prune's ATK as DMG to them, with the DMG Type matching the Elemental Conversion from the Swirl or Stellar Swirl. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

After Prune hits an opponent with the Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone Elemental Conversion, other nearby party members will gain the Tolling Rally effect for 5s: When Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts deal DMG to opponents, that attack's DMG will be increased based on the portion of Prune's ATK in excess of 2,000 when they become affected by the Tolling Rally effect. Every excess ATK point increases that instance of DMG by 0.025%, up to a total of 50% max.
Has a 10% chance to get 1 regional Character Talent Material (base material excluded) when crafting. The rarity is the same as the resulting material.

After completing Witch's Homework: Of What Is Contested, Prune becomes a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.
description.3: After a Hexerei character in the party affected by the Tolling Rally effect triggers an Elemental Reaction on an opponent, Prune's ATK is increased by 60% for 5s. If the Elemental Reaction triggered is a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, the triggering character's ATK will additionally be increased by 30% for 5s.

constellation1.name: With a Vow to Rescue, the Journey Begins

description.0: After the Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, Prune will regain 2 Energy. This effect can occur once every 1.8s.

constellation2.name: Useful for Cleaning Messy Baggage, Elemental Powers Are Indeed

Prune's ATK can be increased by up to 40% in this way.
description.1: The original instance of the above effect will be removed if "The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!" is used again during this time.

constellation4.name: Looking Back Following the Wind, One's Shadow Still Halved

constellation5.name: 100 Defeats? No Problem, Tomorrow, We Go Again

description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellation6.name: And That's the Story! Share It With Your Friends!

description.1: Additionally, after party members affected by Tolling Rally trigger any Elemental Reaction, they will cause Prune and the other current active character(s) affected by Tolling Rally to gain 350 ATK for 5s.

char_Qiqi_gen.name: Qiqi
char_Qiqi_gen.title: Icy Resurrection
char_Qiqi_gen.description: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

char_RaidenShogun_gen.name: Raiden Shogun
char_RaidenShogun_gen.title: Plane of Euthymia
char_RaidenShogun_gen.description: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an upward slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: The Raiden Shogun unveils a shard of her Euthymia, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro> to nearby opponents, and granting nearby party members the Eye of Stormy Judgment.
3: When characters with this buff attack and deal DMG to opponents, the Eye will unleash a coordinated attack, dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> at the opponent's position.
Characters who gain the Eye of Stormy Judgment will have their Elemental Burst DMG increased based on the Energy Cost of the Elemental Burst during the Eye's duration.
description.5: The Eye can initiate one coordinated attack every 0.9s per party.
description.6: Coordinated attacks generated by characters not controlled by you deal 20% of the normal DMG.
description.8: Beings of great divinity might affect all that they survey, and the Electro Archon can manipulate the very inauspicious stars themselves to defend her retainers and bring a thundering sentence down on their foes.

description.0: Gathering truths unnumbered and wishes uncounted, the Raiden Shogun unleashes the Musou no Hitotachi and deals <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>, using Musou Isshin in combat for a certain duration afterward. The DMG dealt by Musou no Hitotachi and Musou Isshin's attacks will be increased based on the number of Chakra Desiderata's Resolve stacks consumed when this skill is used.
description.3: While in this state, the Raiden Shogun will wield her tachi in battle, while her Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be infused with <electro>Electro DMG</electro>, which cannot be overridden. When such attacks hit opponents, she will regenerate Energy for all nearby party members. Energy can be restored this way once every 1s, and this effect can be triggered 5 times throughout this skill's duration.
description.4: While in this state, the Raiden Shogun's resistance to interruption is increased, and she is immune to <electro>Electro-Charged</electro> reaction DMG.
description.5: While Musou Isshin is active, the Raiden Shogun's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG will be considered Elemental Burst DMG.
description.7: The effects of Musou Isshin will be cleared when the Raiden Shogun leaves the field.
description.10: When nearby party members (excluding the Raiden Shogun herself) use their Elemental Bursts, the Raiden Shogun will build up Resolve stacks based on the Energy Cost of these Elemental Bursts.
description.11: The maximum number of Resolve stacks is 60.
description.13: The Resolve gained by Chakra Desiderata will be cleared 300s after the Raiden Shogun leaves the field.
description.15: This is the Raiden Shogun's new secret technique. Abandoning the void-like "Musou," she now shoulders a new "Musou" — the dreams and ambitions of all. Just as "shinsetsu," "the truth," also means "the new," so too has Inazuma entered a new chapter.

char_Rosaria_gen.name: Rosaria
char_Rosaria_gen.title: Thorny Benevolence

normal.1: Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.
