char_Sandrone_gen.name: Sandrone
char_Sandrone_gen.title: Mirrored Analysis
char_Sandrone_gen.description: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.

normal.1: Generates threads that control her weapon using formulae, performing up to 3 consecutive strikes.

charged.1: Summons the Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache, or "Fagio," and switches it to Decoding mode: Unleashes a sweeping fire attack on enemies in front, as well as periodically fires condensed beams, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
charged.2: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The condensed beams will instead deal AoE Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
charged.3: While in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power will continuously increase. Firing condensed beams will also further increase its Decoding Power.
charged.4: When Fagio's Decoding Power reaches the maximum of 100 points, it switches to Power Overdrive mode, in which it fires at opponents with longer intervals, dealing Cryo DMG. It will be unable to switch to Decoding mode at this time.
charged.5: When not in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power gradually decreases. When Sandrone is off-field, she will focus on maintaining Fagio, causing its Decoding Power to decrease at 300% the original rate.
charged.6: Fagio exits Power Overdrive mode when its Decoding Power has decreased to under 50.

plunging.1: Plunges from midair to strike the ground below, dealing DMG to opponents along their path and causing AoE DMG on landing.

skillParams.5: Charged Attack Condensed Beam Stellar-Conduct DMG
skillParams.6: Charged Attack Condensed Beam Stellar Swirl DMG

description.0: With her impeccable, ladylike poise, Sandrone boards the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech and hovers forward for 6s. During this time, Sandrone can control the travel direction of the craft. Pressing Sprint consumes 10 Stamina and launches her into an elegant high-speed hover mode, in which she will move even faster at the cost of 15 Stamina per second.
description.2: When Sandrone starts hovering, if there are opponents nearby, she will also summon a Prismatic Resonance Cannon and fire 2 Prism Shots at any opponents who have yet to cool down, dealing <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.3: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The second Prism Shot will instead deal Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
description.5: When on the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech, Sandrone will also elegantly and quietly repair Fagio, causing Decoding Power to swiftly decrease.

description.0: In line with established ladylike behavior, Sandrone summons a large number of Prismatic Resonance Cannons for a frontal bombardment before firing on her foes with a Convective Inhibition Ray, dealing <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.1: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The Convective Inhibition Ray instead deals AoE Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

skillParams.3: Convective Inhibition Ray Stellar Swirl DMG

description.0: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: When using the Elemental Skill Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis, if Fagio's Decoding Power is greater than 50, the second Prism Shot fired by Fagio at nearby opponents will deal 400% of its original DMG as Fagio's Decoding Power is decreased.
description.1: Additionally, for every 10 points of Decoding Power Fagio loses, it gains 1 stack of Refined Tactics for 60s (max 10 stacks). When Sandrone uses the Elemental Burst Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D. while in the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer state, all stacks of Refined Tactics are cleared, causing the Convective Inhibition Ray to deal 100% + (number of stacks cleared) × 10% of its original DMG.

description.0: Increases Sandrone's Elemental Mastery based on her ATK. Every 100 ATK will increase her Elemental Mastery by 8. The maximum increase she can gain this way is 160.
Sandrone will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when she is inside a Polestar Field, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
description.1: When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of the aforementioned reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Sandrone's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.

passive.name: A Caucus Prelude and a Long Tale

description.0: When Sandrone is in the party, you will gain additional snack rewards after turning in your Daily Commissions with Katheryne.
When in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power increases at a 50% lower rate, and all party members deal 30% increased Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

constellation2.name: An Heiress Gazed Into the Looking-Glass

description.0: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: Increases CRIT DMG from Charged Attack condensed beams by 40%. Also, each time a beam is fired, CRIT DMG dealt by all condensed beams fired during this Decoding mode period will be further increased by 20%. Max 3 stacks.

constellation3.name: Refuse the Wake of Dusk, the Moonlit Yoke

description.0: Increases the Level of Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellation4.name: In Knowledge Lies the World's True Ground

description.0: When Sandrone deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, she will also summon an extra Prismatic Resonance Cannon to fire off a coordinated attack which deals <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> at 125% or 187.5% of her ATK, respectively. This DMG is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, and the effect can occur once every 4s.

constellation5.name: Of All Beside, She Takes No Part

description.0: Increases the Level of Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D. by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellation6.name: Narcissus Wakes, Her Eyes Upon the Dawn

description.0: When Fagio fires a condensed beam for the third time while in Decoding mode, the beam becomes a more powerful Condensed Cluster Beam that fires continuously. This beam will deal up to 4 additional instances of AoE Cryo DMG at 100% of Sandrone's ATK on top of any subsequent original beam fired.
description.1: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The Condensed Cluster Beam attack deals 4 additional instances of AoE Cryo DMG. The DMG dealt with this attack, which is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, is equal to:
description.3: Radiance: Stellar Swirl: 120% of Sandrone's ATK.
description.4: Additionally, all Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Sandrone is elevated by 20%.

char_SangonomiyaKokomi_gen.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
char_SangonomiyaKokomi_gen.title: Pearl of Wisdom
char_SangonomiyaKokomi_gen.description: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 consecutive attacks that take the form of swimming fish, dealing <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> after a short casting time.

plunging.1: Gathering the might of Hydro, Kokomi plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> upon impact with the ground.

description.0: Summons a "Bake-Kurage" created from water that can heal her allies.
description.1: Using this skill will apply the <hydro>Wet</hydro> status to Sangonomiya Kokomi.
description.3: Bake-Kurage
description.4: Deals <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> to surrounding opponents and heals nearby active characters at fixed intervals. This healing is based on Kokomi's Max HP.
description.6: Kokomi needs timely "refreshment" in order to maintain optimal work efficiency.

description.0: Summons the might of Watatsumi, dealing <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> to surrounding opponents, before robing Kokomi in a Ceremonial Garment made from the flowing waters of Sangonomiya.
3: Sangonomiya Kokomi's Normal Attack, Charged Attack and Bake-Kurage DMG are increased based on her Max HP.
When her Normal and Charged Attacks hit opponents, Kokomi will restore HP for all nearby party members, and the amount restored is based on her Max HP.
Increases Sangonomiya Kokomi's resistance to interruption and allows her to walk on the water's surface.
description.5: These effects will be cleared once Sangonomiya Kokomi leaves the field.
description.7: Clear light coalesces into robes around Her Excellency, Sangonomiya Kokomi, reflecting her magnificent form.

description.0: If Sangonomiya Kokomi's own Bake-Kurage is on the field when she uses Nereid's Ascension, the Bake-Kurage's duration will be refreshed.

While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, the Normal and Charged Attack DMG Bonus Sangonomiya Kokomi gains based on her Max HP will receive a further increase based on 15% of her Healing Bonus.
Decreases swimming Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
description.1: Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

description.0: Sangonomiya Kokomi has a 25% Healing Bonus, but a 100% decrease in CRIT Rate.
While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, the final Normal Attack in Sangonomiya Kokomi's combo will unleash a swimming fish to deal 30% of her Max HP as Hydro DMG.
description.1: This DMG is not considered Normal Attack DMG.

description.0: Sangonomiya Kokomi gains the following Healing Bonuses with regard to characters with 50% or less HP via the following methods:
1: Kurage's Oath Bake-Kurage: 4.5% of Kokomi's Max HP.
Nereid's Ascension Normal and Charged Attacks: 0.6% of Kokomi's Max HP.

constellation3.name: The Moon, A Ship O'er the Seas

description.0: Increases the Level of Nereid's Ascension by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, Sangonomiya Kokomi's Normal Attack SPD is increased by 10%, and Normal Attacks that hit opponents will restore 0.8 Energy for her.
description.1: This effect can occur once every 0.2s.

constellation5.name: All Streams Flow to the Sea

description.0: Increases the Level of Kurage's Oath by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: While donning the Ceremonial Garment created by Nereid's Ascension, Sangonomiya Kokomi gains a 40% Hydro DMG Bonus for 4s when her Normal and Charged Attacks heal, or would heal, any party member with 80% or more HP.

char_Sayu_gen.name: Sayu
char_Sayu_gen.title: Mujina Ninja
char_Sayu_gen.description: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems sleep-deprived.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

charged.1: Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
charged.2: At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: The special technique of the Yoohoo Ninja Arts!
description.1: Sayu curls up into a rolling Fuufuu Windwheel and smashes into opponents at high speed, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>. When the duration ends, she unleashes a Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick, dealing <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.3: Press
description.4: Enters the Fuufuu Windwheel state, rolling forward a short distance before using the Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick.
description.6: Hold
description.7: Rolls about continuously in the Fuufuu Windwheel state, increasing Sayu's resistance to interruption while within that state.
description.8: During this time, Sayu can control the direction of her roll, and can use the skill again to end her Windwheel state early and unleash a stronger version of the Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick.
description.9: The Hold version of this skill can trigger Elemental Absorption.
description.11: This skill has a maximum duration of 10s and enters CD once its effects end. The longer Sayu remains in her Windwheel state, the longer the CD.
description.14: If Sayu comes into contact with <hydro>Hydro</hydro>/<pyro>Pyro</pyro>/<cryo>Cryo</cryo>/<electro>Electro</electro> while in her Windwheel state, she will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
description.15: Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use of this skill.
description.17: Sayu can pull this skill off with her eyes closed. This technique was originally created for escaping, but now that she's got a Vision, might as well make her foes eat dirt while she's at it.

description.0: The other super special technique of the Yoohoo Ninja Arts! It summons a pair of helping hands for Sayu.
description.1: Deals <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo> to nearby opponents and heals all nearby party members. The amount of HP restored is based on Sayu's ATK. This skill then summons a Muji-Muji Daruma.
description.3: Muji-Muji Daruma
description.4: At specific intervals, the Daruma will take one of several actions based on the situation around it:
5: If the HP of nearby characters is above 70%, it will attack a nearby opponent, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

If there are active characters with 70% or less HP nearby, it will heal the active character with the lowest percentage HP left. If there are no opponents nearby, it will heal active characters nearby even if they have 70% HP or more.
description.7: People who don't know the first thing about ninjutsu love to watch Sayu show off this skill, and some have tried to learn it from her. But Sayu just wants to sleep and not be disturbed.

description.0: When Sayu triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while active, she heals all your characters and nearby allies for 300 HP. She will also heal an additional 1.2 HP for every point of Elemental Mastery she has.
description.1: This effect can be triggered once every 2s.

description.0: The Muji-Muji Daruma created by Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry gains the following effects:
1: When healing a character, it will also heal characters near that healed character for 20% the amount of HP.
Increases the AoE of its attack against opponents.

description.0: When Sayu is in the party, your characters will not startle Crystalflies and certain other animals when getting near them.
description.1: Check the "Other" sub-category of the "Living Beings / Wildlife" section in the Archive for creatures this skill works on.

description.0: The Muji-Muji Daruma created by Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry will ignore HP limits and can simultaneously attack nearby opponents and heal characters.
Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash gains the following effects:
1: DMG of Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick in Press Mode increased by 3.3%.
Every 0.5s in the Fuufuu Windwheel state will increase the DMG of this Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick by 3.3%. The maximum DMG increase possible through this method is 66%.

constellation3.name: Eh, the Bunshin Can Handle It

description.0: Increases the Level of Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Sayu recovers 1.2 Energy when she triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while on-field.
description.1: This effect occurs once every 2s.

description.0: Increases the Level of Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: The Muji-Muji Daruma created by Sayu's Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry will now also benefit from her Elemental Mastery. Each point of Sayu's Elemental Mastery will produce the following effects:
1: Increases the damage dealt by the Muji-Muji Daruma's attacks by 0.2% ATK. A maximum DMG increase of 400% ATK can be gained via this method.
Increases the HP restored by the Muji-Muji Daruma by 3. A maximum of 6,000 additional HP can be restored in this manner.

char_Sethos_gen.name: Sethos
char_Sethos_gen.title: Wisdom's Measure
char_Sethos_gen.description: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

charged.1: Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
charged.2: While aiming, the power of Electro will accumulate on the arrowhead before the arrow is fired. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
3: Charge Level 1: Fires off an arrow carrying the power of lightning that deals <electro>Electro DMG</electro>.
Charge Level 2: Fires off a Shadowpiercing Shot which can pierce enemies, dealing Electro DMG to enemies along its path. After the Shadowpiercing Shot is fully charged, Sethos cannot move around.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Gathers the might of thunder, dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> and quickly retreating. If this attack triggers Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, or Electro Swirl reactions, Sethos recovers a certain amount of Elemental Energy.
description.2: "The God indwelt Priest, the Magi who turned pits to springs, the singers of the sea of sand still spread their stories... But I know those are not legends, for they are our ancestors."

description.0: Perform a secret rite, entering the "Twilight Meditation" state, during which Sethos's Normal Attacks will be converted into enemy-piercing Dusk Bolts: Deal Electro DMG to opponents in its path, with DMG increased based on Sethos's Elemental Mastery.
description.1: Sethos cannot perform Aimed Shots while in this state.
description.2: DMG dealt by Dusk Bolts is considered Charged Attack DMG.
description.3: This effect will be canceled when Sethos leaves the field.
description.5: The archives of the Temple of Silence preserve many tomes left behind by Akhtamun, from the era of King Deshret. Many secret rituals of great power are recorded within, but even among the Temple of Silence, very few could master them.

description.0: When Aiming, the charging time is decreased by 0.285s based on each point of Sethos's current Elemental Energy. Charging time can be reduced to a minimum of 0.3s through this method and a maximum of 20 Energy can be tallied. If a Shadowpiercing Shot is fired, consume the tallied amount of Elemental Energy; if it is a Charge Level 1 shot, then consume 50% of the tallied amount of Elemental Energy.
Sethos gains the "Scorching Sandshade" effect, increasing the DMG dealt by Shadowpiercing Shots by 700% of Sethos's Elemental Mastery.
description.1: The Scorching Sandshade effect will be canceled when any of the following conditions are met:
2: 5s after a Shadowpiercing Shot first hits an opponent.
After 4 Shadowpiercing Shots strike opponents.
description.4: When a Shadowpiercing Shot affected by Scorching Sandshade first hits an opponent, Sethos will regain Scorching Sandshade after 15s.

description.0: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Sumeru on the mini-map.
The CRIT Rate of Shadowpiercing Shot is increased by 15%.
When any of the following conditions are met, Sethos gains a 15% <electro>Electro DMG Bonus</electro> for 10s that may stack twice, with each stack duration counted independently:
1: Consuming Elemental Energy through Aimed Shots. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma" to trigger this condition.
Regaining Elemental Energy by triggering Elemental Reactions using Ancient Rite: The Thundering Sands.
Using Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer.

description.0: Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Royal Reed Archery by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When a Shadowpiercing Shot or Dusk Bolt strikes 2 or more opponents, all nearby party members gain 80 Elemental Mastery for 10s.

constellation5.name: Record of the Desolate God's Burning Sands

description.0: Increases the Level of Secret Rite: Twilight Shadowpiercer by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellation6.name: Pylon of the Sojourning Sun Temple

description.0: After Shadowpiercing Shot strikes an opponent, the Elemental Energy consumed by the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma" will be returned. This effect can be triggered up to once every 15s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Black Kite's Enigma."

char_Shenhe_gen.name: Shenhe
char_Shenhe_gen.title: Lonesome Transcendence
char_Shenhe_gen.description: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: The frosted dew, silvery and dense, shall exorcise all demons.
description.1: Grants all nearby party members the Icy Quill effect and deals <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> in different ways based on whether it is pressed or held.
description.3: Press
description.4: Rushes forward together with a Talisman Spirit, dealing <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> to opponents along the path.
description.6: Hold
description.7: Commands the Talisman Spirit to deal <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.10: When Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts deal <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> to opponents, the DMG dealt is increased based on Shenhe's current ATK.
description.12: The Icy Quill's effects will be cleared once its duration ends or after being triggered a certain number of times. When held rather than pressed, the Icy Quill's effect lasts longer and can be triggered more times.
description.13: When one <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> instance strikes multiple opponents, the effect is triggered multiple times based on the number of opponents hit. The number of times the effect is triggered is calculated independently for each party member with the Icy Quill.
description.15: The power of the spirits is no falsehood. Burdened with her orders, the divine maiden hurries on!

description.0: Unleashes the power of the Talisman Spirit, allowing it to roam free in this plane, dealing <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.1: The Talisman Spirit then creates a field that decreases the <cryo>Cryo RES</cryo> and Physical RES of opponents within it. It also deals periodic <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> to opponents within the field.
description.3: The way of the adepti is not defined only by the mysterious and fantastical. Only by observing the changes in the heavens and the earth, and understanding the laws of cause and effect in this realm, may its essence be understood.

description.0: An active character within the field created by Divine Maiden's Deliverance gains 15% Cryo DMG Bonus.
After Shenhe uses Spring Spirit Summoning, she will grant all nearby party members the following effects:
1: Press: Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG increased by 15% for 10s.
Hold: Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack DMG increased by 15% for 15s.

description.0: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Liyue Expedition for 20 hours.
Spring Spirit Summoning can be used 1 more time.
Divine Maiden's Deliverance lasts for 6 seconds longer. Active characters within the skill's field deal 15% increased Cryo CRIT DMG.
Increases the Level of Spring Spirit Summoning by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When characters under the effect of Icy Quill applied by Shenhe trigger its DMG Bonus effects, Shenhe will gain a Skyfrost Mantra stack:
1: When Shenhe uses Spring Spirit Summoning, she will consume all stacks of Skyfrost Mantra, increasing the DMG of that Spring Spirit Summoning by 5% for each stack consumed.
Max 50 stacks. Stacks last for 60s.

description.0: Increases the Level of Divine Maiden's Deliverance by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When characters trigger Icy Quill's effects using Normal and Charged Attack DMG, it does not count toward the Trigger Quota.

char_ShikanoinHeizou_gen.name: Shikanoin Heizou
char_ShikanoinHeizou_gen.title: Analytical Harmony
char_ShikanoinHeizou_gen.description: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 fisticuffs empowered by a mighty wind, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and performs a sweeping kick that deals <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

plunging.1: Calling upon the surging wind, Heizou plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> upon impact with the ground.

description.0: Tap
description.1: Wields the swift winds to launch a Heartstopper Strike that deals <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.3: Hold
description.4: Charges energy to unleash an even stronger blow. He will obtain the Declension effect while charging, which will increase the power of the Heartstopper Strike. When the skill button is released or the skill finishes charging, he will strike forward, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.6: Declension
description.7: Increases the power of the next Heartstopper Strike. Max 4 stacks.
description.8: When you possess 4 Declension stacks, the Conviction effect will be produced, which will cause the next Heartstopper Strike to be even stronger and have a larger AoE.
description.10: This seemingly ordinary strike contains Heizou's desire for criminals to honestly confess and repent.

description.0: Leaps into the air and uses the Fudou Style Vacuum Slugger and kicks his opponent. The Vacuum Slugger will explode upon hit and create an Arresting Windtunnel that pulls in nearby objects and opponents, dealing <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.1: When Vacuum Slugger hits opponents affected by <hydro>Hydro</hydro>/<pyro>Pyro</pyro>/<cryo>Cryo</cryo>/<electro>Electro</electro>, these opponents will be afflicted with Windmuster Iris. This Windmuster Iris will explode after a moment and dissipate, dealing AoE DMG of the corresponding aforementioned elemental type.
description.2: Vacuum Slugger can afflict a maximum of 4 opponents with the Windmuster Iris. A single opponent cannot be under the effect of Windmuster Irises of different elements at the same time.
description.4: A unique technique that gathers Anemo in one place before unleashing it all in one kick. Is always there in a pinch to land on some criminal's fleeing back.

description.0: When Shikanoin Heizou activates a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while on the field, he will gain 1 Declension stack for Heartstopper Strike. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s.
After Shikanoin Heizou's Heartstopper Strike hits an opponent, increases all party members' (excluding Shikanoin Heizou) Elemental Mastery by 80 for 10s.
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
description.1: Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

description.0: For 5s after Shikanoin Heizou takes the field, his Normal Attack SPD is increased by 15%. He also gains 1 Declension stack for Heartstopper Strike. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.
The pull effect of the Arresting Windtunnel created by Windmuster Kick is enhanced, and its duration is increased to 1s.
Increases the Level of Heartstopper Strike by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: The first Windmuster Iris explosion in each Windmuster Kick will regenerate 9 Elemental Energy for Shikanoin Heizou. Every subsequent explosion in that Windmuster Kick will each regenerate an additional 1.5 Energy for Heizou.
description.1: One Windmuster Kick can regenerate a total of 13.5 Energy for Heizou in this manner.

description.0: Increases the Level of Windmuster Kick by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Each Declension stack will increase the CRIT Rate of the Heartstopper Strike unleashed by 4%. When Heizou possesses Conviction, this Heartstopper Strike's CRIT DMG is increased by 32%.

char_Sigewinne_gen.name: Sigewinne
char_Sigewinne_gen.title: Wondrous Dragonheir
char_Sigewinne_gen.description: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 consecutive attacks.

charged.1: Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
charged.2: While aiming, the power of Hydro will continually accumulate on the arrow. After fully charging, Sigewinne will periodically fire slow-moving Mini-Stration Bubbles toward the target, dealing <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro>. When released, an arrow imbued with torrential energy will deal <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> to the opponent hit.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Blows a Bolstering Bubblebalm that can stimulate blood flow and help patients drift off to sleep using a bubblegun specially made in the Fortress of Meropide.
description.1: Bolstering Bubblebalms will bounce between nearby opponents, dealing <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> based on Sigewinne's max HP to opponents it hits. When it bounces, it will restore HP to all nearby party members except Sigewinne herself. The amount healed is based on Sigewinne's max HP.
description.2: After bouncing 5 times, the Bolstering Bubblebalm will disappear and restore HP to Sigewinne based on her max HP value.
description.3: When no opponents are present, the Bolstering Bubblebalm will bounce nearby. Only one Bolstering Bubblebalm created by a Sigewinne may exist at once.
description.4: When Held, the Bolstering Bubblebalm can be boosted to an even bigger size.
description.6: Hold
description.7: Enter Aiming Mode to begin blowing an even bigger, even more breathtaking Bolstering Bubblebalm!
description.8: The Bolstering Bubblebalm will grow bigger the longer the skill is Held, until it grows up to two tiers in size. Each tier it grows increases its DMG by 5% and healing by 5%. When a Bolstering Bubblebalm bounces, it will drop down a tier in size, until it returns to being a normal Bolstering Bubblebalm.
description.9: After weaker opponents are hit by big Bolstering Bubblebalms, they will be imprisoned and will be unable to move.
description.11: In addition, 2 Sourcewater Droplets will be created near Sigewinne when she uses this Skill. Each Sourcewater Droplet Sigewinne collects will grant her a Bond of Life worth 10% of her Max HP.
description.12: When Sigewinne's Bond of Life is cleared, she regains 1 Elemental Energy for every 2,000 HP worth of the Bond of Life that was cleared. Sigewinne can regain up to 5 Elemental Energy in this way.
description.15: Bolstering Bubblebalms periodically call down a Surging Blade on the position they hit, dealing Ousia-aligned <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> based on Sigewinne's max HP.
description.17: "What do you think? Not only can this kind of hydrotherapy stimulate the circulatory system, but it can also cheer patients up, ooh, and that's not all, it can even help patients who ought to get some rest have a nice nap..."

description.0: Takes out a special Fortress of Meropide-made syringe and assault the area in front with waves of kindness and medicine, dealing <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> based on Sigewinne's max HP.
description.1: In addition, Sigewinne absorbs up to 2 nearby Sourcewater Droplets within a certain range when she uses this skill.
description.3: "Hey, overdosing on medicine is no different from poison, you know, it's real dangerous! But patients need care and concern, and nobody can overdose on that!"

description.0: Sigewinne grants herself the "Semi-Strict Bedrest" effect for 18s after using Rebound Hydrotherapy: Sigewinne gains an 8% Hydro DMG Bonus and 10 stacks of Convalescence. When the Elemental Skills of your nearby off-field party members other than Sigewinne deal DMG, consume 1 stack of Convalescence, and increase the DMG dealt by this instance of Elemental Skill DMG. Every 1,000 Max HP Sigewinne has above 30,000 increases the DMG by 80. The maximum DMG increase for Elemental Skills that can be gained in this way is 2,800.

When Sigewinne performs healing, the amount healed for this instance is increased based on the total current value of the Bonds of Life on all party members: For each 1,000 HP worth of Bonds of Life, the outgoing healing is increased by 3%. The amount of healing provided can be increased by up to 30% in this way.

While underwater, heals your active character over 2.5s when their HP falls under 50%. The amount healed is equal to 50% of their Max HP, and their All Elemental and Physical RES will be decreased by 10% for 10s. This effect can be triggered up to once every 20s.

constellation1.name: "Can the Happiest of Spirits Understand Anxiety?"

description.0: Rebound Hydrotherapy's Bolstering Bubblebalm can bounce 3 extra times, and the first 3 bounces will not cause big Bubblebalms to become smaller.

The maximum DMG increase for Elemental Skills that can be gained in this way is 3,500. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Requires Appropriate Rest."

constellation2.name: "Can the Most Merciful of Spirits Defeat Its Foes?"

description.1: Additionally, after Rebound Hydrotherapy's Bolstering Bubblebalm or Super Saturated Syringing hits an opponent, that opponent's <hydro>Hydro RES</hydro> will be decreased by 35% for 8s.

constellation3.name: "Can the Healthiest of Spirits Cure Fevers?"

char_Skirk_gen.name: Skirk
char_Skirk_gen.title: Void Star
char_Skirk_gen.description: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 consecutive attacks.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a spinning crystal spear, dealing DMG to opponents ahead.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Imitates the combat style of "The Foul." Produces different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.
description.3: Skirk gains 45 Serpent's Subtlety and switches to Seven-Phase Flash mode.
description.6: Skirk gains 45 Serpent's Subtlety and will continuously move at high speed. Her interruption resistance is increased in this state.
description.7: During this time, Skirk can control her movement direction and move atop water. She can also use this Skill again to end rapid movement prematurely.

description.0: Skirk's Elemental Burst is not reliant on Elemental Energy but instead on Serpent's Subtlety.
description.1: When Skirk has at least 50 Serpent's Subtlety, she can expend all her Serpent's Subtlety to unleash her Elemental Burst, ripping the space before her apart and using rapid consecutive slashes that deal <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo>. At the same time, the DMG dealt by an instance of this Elemental Burst will be increased by every point of Serpent's Subtlety over 50 when it is unleashed. Up to 12 points can be counted for this purpose.
description.3: When Skirk is in Seven-Phase Flash mode, Havoc: Ruin will be replaced by Havoc: Extinction.
description.6: A special Elemental Burst that can be used even without consuming Serpent's Subtlety.
description.7: After using it, Skirk will gain the "All Shall Wither" effect, which will last until Seven-Phase Flash ends. After unlocking the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason, she can also absorb nearby Void Rifts.
description.8: While "All Shall Wither" is active, every 0.1s, after Skirk's Normal Attack hits an opponent, that Normal Attack will deal increased DMG. If she absorbed any Void Rifts while using Havoc: Extinction, this Normal Attack's DMG will be further increased based on the number of Rifts absorbed.
description.9: This effect will be canceled when it has triggered 10 times.

description.0: When nearby party members trigger Frozen, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Cryo Swirl, Stellar Swirl, or Cryo Crystallize reactions against opponents, a Void Rift will be created near this opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 2.5s. 3 Void Rifts created by Skirk herself can exist on the field at once.
description.2: Skirk can use the following methods to absorb nearby Void Rifts:
3: When she hits an opponent with a Charged Attack in her Seven-Phase Flash mode.
When she uses the special Elemental Burst Havoc: Extinction while in Seven-Phase Flash mode.
When she Holds her Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp to engage in rapid movement.
description.5: Each Rift absorbed will grant her 8 Serpent's Subtlety points.

description.0: When nearby <hydro>Hydro</hydro> party members' <hydro>Hydro</hydro> attacks hit opponents, or when nearby <cryo>Cryo</cryo> party members apart from Skirk hit opponents with <cryo>Cryo</cryo> attacks, Skirk will gain the "Death's Crossing" effect for 20s. Max 3 stacks, each stack's duration is counted independently.
description.1: Each character can grant Skirk at most 1 "Death's Crossing" stack by this means.
description.2: Each "Death's Crossing" stack increases the Normal Attack DMG dealt by Skirk in Seven-Phase Flash mode to 110%/120%/170% of its original DMG and the DMG dealt when using her Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin to 105%/115%/160% of its original DMG.

description.0: When all party members are either Hydro or Cryo, and if there is at least 1 Hydro and 1 Cryo character, your own party members' Elemental Skill Level is increased by 1.

Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason: Every Void Rift absorbed will summon a crystal blade to attack nearby opponents, dealing 500% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
description.1: You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason.

description.0: After unleashing her Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp, Skirk will gain 10 additional Serpent's Subtlety points.
description.1: When using her Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin, the DMG of this Elemental Burst instance will be increased by taking up to 10 more Serpent's Subtlety points into account.
description.2: Additionally, within 12.5s after Skirk unleashes the special Elemental Burst Havoc: Extinction while in her Seven-Phase Flash mode, her ATK is increased by 70%. This effect will be canceled when she leaves the Seven-Phase Flash mode.

description.0: Increases the Level of Havoc: Ruin by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent Return to Oblivion: Each Death's Crossing stack also increases Skirk's ATK by 10%/20%/40%.
description.1: You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Return to Oblivion.

description.0: Increases the Level of Havoc: Warp by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Each Void Rift Skirk absorbs via the effects of the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason will grant her 1 Havoc: Sever stack. She can consume such stacks to initiate coordinated attacks and decrease the DMG she takes while in Seven-Phase Flash mode. These stacks last for 15s, and each stack's duration is counted independently (max 3 stacks).
description.1: You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Reason Beyond Reason."
description.3: Havoc: Sever
4: When Skirk uses the Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin, she will consume all Havoc: Sever stacks to initiate a coordinated attack in which each Havoc: Sever stack will deal 750% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

When she uses Normal Attacks while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 Havoc: Sever stack will be consumed when her third or fifth sequenced attacks hit an opponent to launch 3 coordinated attacks. Each coordinated attack deals 180% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This damage is considered Normal Attack DMG.

When Skirk takes DMG while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 Havoc: Sever stack will be consumed to decrease this DMG instance by 80% and attack nearby opponents 3 times, with each attack dealing 180% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.

char_Sucrose_gen.name: Sucrose
char_Sucrose_gen.title: Harmless Sweetie
char_Sucrose_gen.description: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 attacks using Wind Spirits, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> after a short casting time.

plunging.1: Calling upon the power of her Wind Spirits, Sucrose plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> upon impact with the ground.

description.0: Creates a small Wind Spirit that pulls opponents and objects towards its location, launches opponents within its AoE, and deals <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.2: This is a little embarrassing, but though the elemental lifeforms birthed through this procedure dissipate very rapidly, they are incredibly useful when adventuring. Even failed experiments can have practical applications.

description.0: Sucrose hurls an unstable concoction that creates a Large Wind Spirit.
description.1: While it persists, the Large Wind Spirit will continuously pull in surrounding opponents and objects, launch nearby opponents, and deal <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.3: Elemental Absorption

description.5: Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.
description.7: Sucrose used to give names to her volatile Anemo Hypostases, but their line of heirs quickly grew to surpass Baron Bunny the 893rd.

When Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 or Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II hits an opponent, increases all party members' (excluding Sucrose) Elemental Mastery by an amount equal to 20% of Sucrose's Elemental Mastery for 8s.
When Sucrose crafts Character and Weapon Enhancement Materials, she has a 10% chance to obtain double the product.

After completing Witch's Homework: Of Wonderland Flowers, Sucrose will become a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.
3: After Sucrose creates a Small Wind Spirit, nearby party members' Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 5.71428% for 15s.
After Sucrose creates a Large Wind Spirit, nearby Hexerei party members' Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 7.14285% for 20s.

description.0: Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 gains 1 additional charge.
The duration of Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II is increased by 2s.
Increases the Level of Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

char_Tartaglia_gen.name: Tartaglia
char_Tartaglia_gen.title: Childe
char_Tartaglia_gen.description: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

normal.1: Performs up to 6 consecutive shots with a bow.

charged.1: Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
charged.2: While aiming, the power of Hydro will accumulate on the arrowhead. An arrow fully charged with the torrent will deal <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> and apply the Riptide status.

riptide.1: Opponents affected by Riptide will suffer from <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> effects when attacked by Tartaglia in various ways. DMG dealt in this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
2: Riptide Flash: A fully-charged Aimed Shot that hits an opponent affected by Riptide deals consecutive bouts of AoE DMG. Can occur once every 0.7s.
Riptide Burst: Defeating an opponent affected by Riptide creates a Hydro burst that inflicts the Riptide status on nearby opponents hit.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
plunging.2: When Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, he cannot perform a plunging attack.

description.0: Unleashes a set of weaponry made of pure water, dealing <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> to surrounding opponents and entering Melee Stance.
description.1: In this Stance, Tartaglia's Normal and Charged Attacks are converted to <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion and change as follows:
description.3: Normal Attack
description.4: Performs up to 6 consecutive <hydro>Hydro</hydro> strikes.
description.6: Charged Attack
description.7: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a cross slash, dealing <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro>.
description.10: Hitting an opponent affected by Riptide with a melee attack unleashes a Riptide Slash that deals <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro>. DMG dealt in this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG, and can only occur once every 1.5s.
description.12: After 30s, or when the ability is unleashed again, this skill will end. Tartaglia will return to his Ranged Stance and this ability will enter CD. The longer Tartaglia stays in his Melee Stance, the longer the CD.
description.13: If the return to a ranged stance occurs automatically after 30s, the CD is even longer.
description.15: He chose the bow as his weapon precisely to overcome his weakness with it. But a serious fight demands that he gets serious...

description.0: Performs different attacks based on what stance Tartaglia is in when casting.
description.3: Swiftly fires a Hydro-imbued magic arrow, dealing <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> and applying the Riptide status.
description.4: Returns a portion of its Energy Cost after use.
description.6: Melee Stance: Light of Obliteration
description.7: Performs a slash with a large AoE, dealing massive <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> to all surrounding opponents, which triggers Riptide Blast.
description.10: When the obliterating waters hit an opponent affected by Riptide, it clears their Riptide status and triggers a Hydro Explosion that deals <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro>.
description.11: DMG dealt in this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
description.13: Rushing waters are rarely seen in his snowy homeland. Perhaps his ability to command water is due to his understanding of just how precious it is.

description.0: Extends Riptide duration by 8s.
When Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, on dealing a CRIT hit, Normal and Charged Attacks apply the Riptide status effect to opponents.
Increases your own party members' Normal Attack Level by 1.
Decreases the CD of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide by 20%.
When opponents affected by Riptide are defeated, Tartaglia regenerates 4 Elemental Energy.
Increases the Level of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: If Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, triggers Riptide Slash against opponents on the field affected by Riptide every 4s, otherwise, triggers Riptide Flash.
description.1: Riptide Slashes and Riptide Flashes triggered by this Constellation effect are not subject to the time intervals that would typically apply to these two Riptide effects, nor do they have any effect on those time intervals.

description.0: Increases the Level of Havoc: Obliteration by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When Havoc: Obliteration is cast in Melee Stance, the CD of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide is reset.
description.1: This effect will only take place once Tartaglia returns to his Ranged Stance.

char_Thoma_gen.name: Thoma
char_Thoma_gen.title: Protector From Afar
char_Thoma_gen.description: The Kamisato Clan's housekeeper. A well-known "fixer" in Inazuma.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Thoma vaults forward with his polearm and delivers a flame-filled flying kick that deals <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro>, while also summoning a defensive Blazing Barrier. At the moment of casting, Thoma's Elemental Skill applies <pyro>Pyro</pyro> to himself.
description.1: The DMG Absorption of the Blazing Barrier scales off Thoma's Max HP.
description.2: The Blazing Barrier has the following traits:
3: Absorbs <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> 250% more effectively.
When a new Blazing Barrier is obtained, the remaining DMG Absorption of an existing Blazing Barrier will stack and its duration will be refreshed.
description.5: The maximum DMG Absorption of the Blazing Barrier will not exceed a certain percentage of Thoma's Max HP.
description.7: As a guest from afar, only the most burning passion would allow one to master the pure and precise spear arts of Inazuma. Thoma's mastery, indeed, is not limited to being the "swiftest-studying student" or "a master of the spear," but he has imbued his will to protect others and fend off foes into his art as well.

description.0: Thoma spins his polearm, slicing at his foes with roaring flames that deal <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> and weave themselves into a Scorching Ooyoroi.
description.3: While Scorching Ooyoroi is in effect, the active character's Normal Attacks will trigger Fiery Collapse, dealing <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> and summoning a Blazing Barrier.
description.4: Fiery Collapse can be triggered once every 1s.
description.6: Except for the amount of DMG they can absorb, the Blazing Barriers created in this way are identical to those created by Thoma's Elemental Skill, Blazing Blessing:
7: Absorbs <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> 250% more effectively.
When a new Blazing Barrier is obtained, the remaining DMG Absorption of an existing Blazing Barrier will stack and its duration will be refreshed.
description.9: The maximum DMG Absorption of the Blazing Barrier will not exceed a certain percentage of Thoma's Max HP.
description.11: If Thoma falls, the effects of Scorching Ooyoroi will be cleared.
description.13: "I will not forget my initial promise. Let this burning flame protect those I cherish, and may it never be extinguished."

description.1: This effect can be triggered once every 0.3s seconds. Max 5 stacks.

char_Tighnari_gen.title: Verdant Strider
char_Tighnari_gen.description: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

charged.1: Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
charged.2: While aiming, the power of Dendro will accumulate on the arrowhead before the arrow is fired. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged:
3: Charge Level 1: Fires off an arrow carrying the power of flora that deals <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro>.

Charge Level 2: Fires off a Wreath Arrow that deals <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro>. Upon hit, the Wreath Arrow will create 4 Clusterbloom Arrows that will track nearby opponents automatically and deal <dendro>Dendro DMG</dendro>.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.3: "If seeds wither apart from the soil, they will remain a single seed. But if returned to the soil, they shall multiply ten-million fold."

description.3: "Do not seek to escape so easily. The vines grow and regrow ever on. Things might get dicey if you don't clear every last one of them out."

char_TravelerM_gen.name: Aether
char_TravelerM_gen.description: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Wields a searing flame that can incinerate the very earth. Has different effects when Tapped or Held.
description.3: Call forth flames in a raging blaze. When used, the Traveler gains 42 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state, summoning a Blazing Threshold that follows the current active character.
description.4: When the Blazing Threshold gets close to opponents, it will deal Nightsoul-aligned <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> to nearby opponents at intervals.
description.6: Hold
description.7: Unleash fire in a composed manner, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> to nearby opponents. When used, the Traveler gains 42 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state, summoning a Scorching Threshold that follows the current active character.
description.8: When the current active character within a Scorching Threshold deals DMG to opponents, the Threshold will launch a Coordinated Attack that deals Nightsoul-aligned <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> based on the Traveler's ATK. This effect can occur once every 3s.
description.10: Nightsoul's Blessing: Traveler
description.11: Continuously consumes Nightsoul points. The Traveler's Nightsoul's Blessing state lasts 12s at maximum, and when their Nightsoul points are exhausted, this state will end. If this Elemental Skill is used again while active, the Traveler's Nightsoul points will be reset to 42 points.
description.12: Blazing and Scorching Thresholds will disappear once the Traveler's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends, and only 1 Blazing or Scorching Threshold summoned by the Traveler themselves can exist at any one time.
description.14: Together, you and Paimon watched the shifting colors of the flowing flames.

description.0: Condense the flames into a mark, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> to opponents up ahead. The Traveler restores 7 Nightsoul points per second for the next 4s.
description.2: Together, you and Paimon studied the principles behind an undying flame.

description.0: When the Traveler has over 20 Nightsoul points, the attack AoE of the Blazing and Scorching Thresholds from the Elemental Skill Flowfire Blade after they hit opponents is increased.

After the current active character inside a Blazing Threshold or Scorching Threshold triggers a Pyro-related reaction, the Traveler will regain 5 Energy. This can occur once every 12s. Additionally, when a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, the Traveler will regain 4 Energy.
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional buffs.
description.2: Additionally, when nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Burst, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of the Sacred Flame, max 2 stacks. description.4: Charged Attack: Inferno
5: Each Charged Attack hit deals increased, Nightsoul-aligned <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro>. Increase in DMG is equal to 200% of Traveler's ATK.
Charged Attack: Inferno can be triggered up to once every 15s.

description.0: While Blazing Threshold or Scorching Threshold are active, the current active character deals 6% increased DMG. If said character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, they will deal an additional 9% DMG.

Within 12s of using the Elemental Skill Flowfire Blade, after nearby party members trigger a Pyro-related reaction on an opponent, the Traveler will regain 14 Nightsoul points. Each use of Flowfire Blade will restore at most 28 Nightsoul points in this way.
Increases the Level of Flowfire Blade by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

char_Varesa_gen.name: Varesa
char_Varesa_gen.title: Strength in Serenity
char_Varesa_gen.description: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

normal.1: Gotta try... to do battle like the greatest champion luchadors do! Varesa launches up to 3 strikes, dealing <electro>Electro DMG</electro>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to headbutt opponents in front, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <electro>Electro DMG</electro> and using the momentum to leap into the air.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing Nightsoul-aligned <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> upon impact. If Varesa is in a combat state upon landing, or if the shockwave from her plunging attack hits an opponent, she will gain 25 Nightsoul points. She enters the Fiery Passion state upon reaching maximum Nightsoul points through this method.

fieryPassion.1: In this state, Varesa's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will gain corresponding buffs:

fpNormal.1: Fight like a superstar champion luchador! Launches up to 3 fierce strikes, dealing greater <electro>Electro DMG</electro>.

fpCharged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to slam into her opponents, dealing greater amounts of Nightsoul-aligned <electro>Electro DMG</electro> and using the momentum to leap into the air.

fpPlunging.1: Consumes all her Nightsoul points and slams down on the ground from mid-air, dealing DMG to opponents in her path and dealing greater amounts of Nightsoul-aligned <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> upon hitting the ground.

skillParams.11: Fiery Passion Charged Attack Stamina Cost

description.0: With footwork swift as lightning and fierce as thunder, Varesa displays the true spirit of lucha libre, rushing forward a certain distance and dealing Nightsoul-aligned <electro>Electro DMG</electro> to opponents in her path.
description.1: After using this Skill, Varesa gains 20 Nightsoul points and gains the "Follow-Up Strike" effect: Varesa has increased interruption resistance during this time, and upon pressing her Normal Attack, she will quickly unleash a Charged Attack that does not consume Stamina. "Follow-Up Strike" will be canceled after Varesa uses a Charged Attack.
description.2: She will use different techniques based on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.
description.4: Tap
description.5: Quickly rush a certain distance forward.
description.7: Hold
description.8: Varesa enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and switches to Sudden Onrush mode.
description.10: Sudden Onrush
description.11: Continuously consumes Nightsoul points. In this state, Varesa's Movement SPD and interruption resistance are increased. She can use terrain to execute flying leaps or consume additional Nightsoul points to traverse atop water or liquid Phlogiston while remaining immune to DMG from the latter.
description.14: When she runs out of Nightsoul points, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will be canceled. When Varesa is in the Sudden Onrush state or Fiery Passion state, she will always be counted as being in the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
description.16: Has 2 charges. When Varesa enters the Fiery Passion state, she will obtain an additional Tap charge of her Elemental Skill and its DMG will be increased.
19: While not in the Fiery Passion state, Varesa can use Plunging Attacks to gain Nightsoul points. She will enter Fiery Passion when she reaches maximum Nightsoul points via this method, or when she uses her Elemental Burst Guardian Vent!
While in the Fiery Passion state, her Normal Attacks, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst will gain unique buffs. She can also use a special Elemental Burst shortly after using a Plunging Attack.
The Fiery Passion state lasts for up to 15s and will end when she runs out of Nightsoul points or after she leaves combat for a period of time.

description.0: Leaps into the air before using the momentum of the drop to unleash a powerful flying kick, dealing Nightsoul-aligned <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> to opponents — just like those heroes of justice in woven scrolls for kids!
description.1: After using this Skill, Varesa's Nightsoul points will be restored to maximum and she will enter the Fiery Passion state.
description.3: In the Fiery Passion state, Varesa's Elemental Burst will deal a greater amount of Nightsoul-aligned <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>.
description.5: Additionally, she will briefly activate Apex Drive after using a Plunging Attack while in her Fiery Passion state.
description.7: Apex Drive
description.8: Increases Varesa's interruption resistance. While affected by Apex Drive, Varesa can ignore her Elemental Burst CD and consume less Energy to use her special Elemental Burst, "Guardian Vent: Volcano Kablam": This causes her to use the especially powerful Plunging Attack, the "Thunderous Tornado Eruption," which deals Nightsoul-aligned <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> upon landing before causing her to exit Apex Drive. This DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG.
description.9: Varesa will exit Apex Drive after using her Elemental Skill.
description.11: In truth, the original name Varesa gave this move was the "Invincible Dynamic Heroic Justice Super Mega Ultimate Thundercrash Sky-Splitting Supersonic Boom Kick." Alas, this name proved too long, and she was too embarrassed to shout it in front of everyone, even with her mask on. As such, she changed it to its present title instead.

description.0: After using the Elemental Skill Riding the Night-Rainbow, Varesa gains "Rainbow Crash" for 5s.
description.1: During this time, when Varesa uses a Plunging Attack, the shockwave DMG dealt when she hits the ground is increased by 50% of her ATK. If Varesa is in the Fiery Passion state, this ground impact DMG is increased by 180% of her ATK instead.
description.3: The Rainbow Crash effect will be canceled once a ground impact hits an opponent, or when its duration expires.

description.0: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Varesa's ATK increases by 35% for 12s. Max 2 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.

passive3.name: Night Realm's Gift: A Torch That Incinerates Evil

description.0: After Nightsoul points have been fully depleted, Varesa will switch to using Phlogiston to maintain the Sudden Onrush mode from her Nightsoul's Blessing.
description.1: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Nightsoul Transmission: Varesa can be used. When the current active character is sprinting or in movement modes caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, switching to Varesa will trigger the following: Varesa enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state, switches to Sudden Onrush mode, and obtains 20 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.

char_Xianyun_gen.description: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."

normal.1: Summons swirling winds to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and launches a Breeze Bolt in a straight line that deals <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo> to opponents along its path.

plunging.1: Gathers the power of Anemo and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> upon impact with the ground.

description.1: In this state, her Plunging Attack will be converted into Driftcloud Wave instead, which deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> and ends the Cloud Transmogrification state. This DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG.
description.2: Each use of Skyladder while in this state increases the DMG and AoE of the next Driftcloud Wave used.
description.4: Skyladder
description.5: Can be used while in mid-air. Xianyun leaps forward, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo> to targets along her path.
description.6: During each Cloud Transmogrification state Xianyun enters, Skyladder may be used up to 3 times and only 1 instance of Skyladder DMG can be dealt to any one opponent.
description.7: If Skyladder is not used again in a short period, the Cloud Transmogrification state will be canceled.
description.9: If Xianyun does not use Driftcloud Wave while in this state, the next CD of White Clouds at Dawn will be decreased by 3s.
description.11: Do not shake Cloud Retainer's hand too tightly; cranes are quite adept at gripping.

description.0: Brings forth a sacred breeze that deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> and heals all nearby characters based on Xianyun's ATK. It will also summon the "Starwicker" mechanism.
3: Continuously follows the active character and periodically heals all nearby party members based on Xianyun's ATK.
Starts with 8 stacks of Adeptal Assistance. While Adeptal Assistance is active, nearby active characters in the party will have their jump height increased.
When the active character completes a Plunging Attack, Starwicker will consume 1 stack of Adeptal Assistance and deal <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.4: Only 1 Starwicker can exist simultaneously.
description.6: <i>This is the newest invention in the "Lunastar Artifices" series, of which previous creations include the Supreme Cuisine Machine, the Snowdrift Mechanism, the Supreme Housekeeping Machine, the Floating Toting Device, and the Bloom Pruner. This series was intended for young humans Cloud Retainer held in great esteem, and so was not designed with a certain half-adeptus in mind. However, when offered Starwicker, a certain female disciple of hers had these emotionless words to say: "No thank you."
description.7: Cloud Retainer thus had no choice but to keep it herself.

char_Xiao_gen.title: Vigilant Yaksha
char_Xiao_gen.description: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

char_Xilonen_gen.name: Xilonen
char_Xilonen_gen.title: Ardent Flames Forge the Soul
char_Xilonen_gen.description: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina and performs a forward kick.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact, both based on Xilonen's DEF.

description.3: Source Samples
description.4: Xilonen has 3 Samplers with her that can generate different Soundscapes based on her other party members' Elemental Types, decreasing nearby opponents' corresponding Elemental RES while active.
description.5: The initial recorded Source Sample within each Sampler will be <geo>Geo</geo>, and for each party member who is <pyro>Pyro</pyro>/<hydro>Hydro</hydro>/<cryo>Cryo</cryo>/<electro>Electro</electro>, 1 <geo>Geo</geo> Sample will change to that corresponding Element.
description.6: While Xilonen is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the <geo>Geo</geo> Source Sample she carries will always be active. After unlocking her Ascension Talent, "Netotiliztli's Echoes," Xilonen can trigger said Ascension Talent's effects to regenerate Nightsoul points for herself. When her Nightsoul points hit the maximum, she will consume all her Nightsoul points and activate the 3 Source Samples she has on hand for 15s.
description.7: When the Source Samples are active, nearby opponents' corresponding Elemental RES will decrease. Source Sample effects of the same Elemental Type cannot stack. Xilonen can trigger these effects even when off-field.

description.13: After Xilonen's Nightsoul points have expired while she is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will no longer be able to generate Nightsoul points via the Ascension Talent "Netotiliztli's Echoes."
description.15: <i>In some ways, gem-craft and music-mixing share similar principles: Filtering out impurities and retaining only the most radiant things.
description.16: Xilonen isn't picky about the two, however. She enjoys both immensely, after all!

3: If she has at least 2 Source Samples that have had their Elemental Types changed, Xilonen will play an Ebullient rhythm, healing nearby active characters at intervals based on her DEF.

description.6: "It's cool, I recorded those beats just now. Let's see what we get when we mix our rhythms!"

description.0: While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state:
