Charge Level 2: Generates a maximum of 3 Kindling Arrows based on time spent charging, releasing them as part of this Aimed Shot. Kindling Arrows will home in on nearby opponents, dealing <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> on hit.

plunging.1: Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Yoimiya waves a sparkler and causes a ring of saltpeter to surround her.
description.3: During this time, arrows fired by Yoimiya's Normal Attack will be Blazing Arrows, and their DMG will be increased and converted to <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro>. During this time, Normal Attack: Firework Flare-Up will not generate Kindling Arrows at Charge Level 2.
description.5: This effect will deactivate when Yoimiya leaves the field.
description.7: "Niwabi" is a form of incense firework created by Yoimiya herself. Its ability to be lit without any prior training or preparation has made it a real hit. After many fire-related incidents, the Tenryou Commission ordered the use of "Niwabi" banned, but small, bright sparks can often still be seen springing up at night. If seen from above, they look almost like little twinkling stars.

description.0: Yoimiya leaps into the air along with her original creation, the "Ryuukin Saxifrage," and fires forth blazing rockets bursting with surprises that deal <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro> and mark one of the hit opponents with Aurous Blaze.
description.3: All Normal/Charged/Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts by any party member other than Yoimiya that hit an opponent marked by Aurous Blaze will trigger an explosion, dealing <pyro>AoE Pyro DMG</pyro>.
description.4: When an opponent affected by Aurous Blaze is defeated before its duration expires, the effect will pass on to another nearby opponent, who will inherit the remaining duration.
description.6: One Aurous Blaze explosion can be triggered every 2s. When Yoimiya is down, Aurous Blaze effects created through her skills will be deactivated.
description.8: Fireworks are man-made starlight, comets fired into the sky. Though they last for but an instant, the memory of their brilliance shall surely live on.

description.0: During Niwabi Fire-Dance, shots from Yoimiya's Normal Attack will increase her Pyro DMG Bonus by 2% on hit. This effect lasts for 3s and can have a maximum of 10 stacks.

Using Ryuukin Saxifrage causes nearby party members (not including Yoimiya) to gain a 10% ATK increase for 15s. Additionally, a further ATK Bonus will be added on based on the number of Ascension Talent "Tricks of the Trouble-Maker" stacks Yoimiya possesses when using Ryuukin Saxifrage. Each stack increases this ATK Bonus by 1%.
When Yoimiya crafts Decoration, Ornament, and Landscape-type Furnishings, she has a 100% chance to refund a portion of the materials used.
The Aurous Blaze created by Ryuukin Saxifrage lasts for an extra 4s.
description.1: Additionally, when an opponent affected by Aurous Blaze is defeated within its duration, Yoimiya's ATK is increased by 20% for 20s.

description.0: When Yoimiya's <pyro>Pyro DMG</pyro> scores a CRIT Hit, Yoimiya will gain a 25% <pyro>Pyro DMG Bonus</pyro> for 6s.
description.1: This effect can be triggered even when Yoimiya is not the active character.

description.0: Increases the Level of Niwabi Fire-Dance by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When Yoimiya's own Aurous Blaze triggers an explosion, Niwabi Fire-Dance's CD is decreased by 1.2s.
Increases the Level of Ryuukin Saxifrage by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: During Niwabi Fire-Dance, Yoimiya's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance of firing an extra Blazing Arrow that deals 60% of its original DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.

char_YumemizukiMizuki_gen.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
char_YumemizukiMizuki_gen.title: Embrace of Enchanting Dreams
char_YumemizukiMizuki_gen.description: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.

normal.1: Performs up to 3 attacks, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> after a short casting time.

plunging.1: Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> upon impact with the ground.

description.0: Weaves memories of lovely dreams, entering a Dreamdrifter state where Yumemizuki Mizuki floats above the ground, and dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.
3: While in the Dreamdrifter state, Yumemizuki Mizuki will continuously drift forward, dealing <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> to nearby opponents at regular intervals.

During this time, Yumemizuki Mizuki can control her direction of drift, and the pick-up distance of Yumemi Style Special Snacks from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will be increased.
Increases the Swirl DMG and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG that nearby party members deal based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery.
Dreamdrifter will end when Mizuki leaves the field or uses her Elemental Skill again.
description.5: "Our dreams touch at midnight, their song ringing on in our hearts."

skillParams.4: Elemental Mastery-Based Stellar Swirl DMG Increase

description.0: Summons forth countless lovely dreams and nightmares that pull in nearby objects and opponents, dealing <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> and summoning a Mini Baku.
description.3: Follows the current active character. At regular intervals, the Mini Baku will create 1 Yumemi Style Special Snack nearby. After one of your own party members picks up a Special Snack, if their HP is higher than 70%, the Snack will explode and unleash a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> to nearby opponents. Otherwise, it will heal the character who picked it up based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery. When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers healing by picking up a Yumemi Style Special Snack, the amount of healing is increased by 100%. If a Snack is not picked up after a period of time, it will explode and release a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> to surrounding opponents.
description.5: "If you bury dark emotions for too long, they will become nightmares. With that in mind, why don't we turn them into 'delicious snacks' while we've got the time?"

description.0: When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while in her Dreamdrifter state, Dreamdrifter's duration increases by 2.5s. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s for a maximum of 2 times per Dreamdrifter state.

passive2.name: Thoughts by Day Bring Dreams by Night

description.0: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, when other nearby party members hit opponents with <pyro>Pyro</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro</hydro>, <cryo>Cryo</cryo>, or <electro>Electro</electro> attacks, her Elemental Mastery will increase by 100 for 4s.

When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the party, party members have a chance to recover 30% additional HP when using healing foods that do not have reviving properties. The trigger chance for this effect increases with the corresponding character's Friendship Level. (This effect will always trigger if the Traveler is the character consuming healing food.)

When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while in the Dreamdrifter state, the next instance of periodic <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> she deals to nearby enemies during that same state will be increased by 1,000% of her Elemental Mastery. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 2.5s.
description.1: Radiance: Stellar Swirl: When Yumemizuki Mizuki deals to an opponent the above enhanced AoE Anemo DMG, she will also deal an additional instance of Anemo DMG at 1,000% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG.
description.3: Additionally, while Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, the Elemental Mastery of nearby party characters is also increased by 10% of her Elemental Mastery.
description.4: Yumemizuki Mizuki will also enter the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s when a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.

description.0: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, she will continuously apply the "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" effect to nearby opponents for 3s every 3.5s. When an opponent has a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction triggered against them by Anemo DMG while the aforementioned effect is active, the effect will be canceled, and this Swirl or Stellar Swirl instance deals DMG against this opponent increased by 1,100% and 550% of Mizuki's Elemental Mastery, respectively.

upgradedDescription.0: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, she will continuously apply the "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" effect to nearby opponents for 3s every 3.5s. When an opponent has a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction triggered against them by Anemo DMG while the aforementioned effect is active, the effect will be canceled, and this Swirl or Stellar Swirl instance has its DMG against this opponent increased by 1,100% and 550% of Mizuki's Elemental Mastery respectively. She also launches an additional attack on the same opponent, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo> at 1,000% of Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery.
upgradedDescription.1: Radiance: Stellar Swirl: The aforementioned additional DMG is changed to Anemo DMG at 400% of Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG.

constellation2.name: Your Echo I Meet in Dreams

description.0: When Yumemizuki Mizuki enters the Dreamdrifter state, every Elemental Mastery point she has will increase all nearby party members' <pyro>Pyro</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro</hydro>, <cryo>Cryo</cryo>, and <electro>Electro</electro> DMG Bonuses by 0.04% until the Dreamdrifter state ends.

upgradedDescription.0: When Yumemizuki Mizuki enters the Dreamdrifter state, every Elemental Mastery point she has will increase all nearby party members' <pyro>Pyro</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro</hydro>, <cryo>Cryo</cryo>, and <electro>Electro</electro> DMG Bonuses by 0.04% until the Dreamdrifter state ends.
upgradedDescription.1: Additionally, while Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, the <pyro>Pyro RES</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro RES</hydro>, <cryo>Cryo RES</cryo>, <electro>Electro RES</electro>, and <anemo>Anemo RES</anemo> of nearby opponents are lowered by 20%.

description.0: Increases the Level of Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Picking up a Yumemi Style Special Snack from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will both deal DMG and heal, and will restore 5 Energy to Yumemizuki Mizuki. Energy can be restored this way 4 times per Anraku Secret Spring Therapy duration.

upgradedDescription.0: Picking up a Yumemi Style Special Snack from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will both deal DMG and heal. It will also heal a nearby party member with lower HP for 266% of Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery, as well as regenerate 5 Energy for Yumemizuki Mizuki. Energy can be restored this way 4 times per Anraku Secret Spring Therapy duration.

constellation5.name: As Setting Moon Brings Year's End

description.0: Increases the Level of Anraku Secret Spring Therapy by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 30%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. Any Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by these characters will also have its CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG increased by 10% and 20%, respectively.

upgradedDescription.0: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, Swirl DMG dealt by nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 30%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. The CRIT Rate of any Stellar Swirl DMG dealt by these party members is also increased by 10%, while CRIT DMG is increased by 20%.
upgradedDescription.1: Every point of Elemental Mastery Yumemizuki Mizuki has in excess of 500 increases her CRIT Rate by 0.04% and her CRIT DMG by 0.16%. Yumemizuki Mizuki's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG can be increased by up to 20% and 80% in this way, respectively.

char_YunJin_gen.name: Yun Jin
char_YunJin_gen.title: Stage Lucida
char_YunJin_gen.description: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

normal.1: Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Ms. Yun may just be acting out fights on stage, but her skills with the spear are real enough to defend against her foes.
description.3: Flourishes her polearm in a cloud-grasping stance, dealing <geo>Geo DMG</geo>.
description.6: Takes up the Opening Flourish stance and charges up, forming a shield. DMG Absorption is based on Yun Jin's Max HP and has 150% effectiveness against all Elemental DMG and Physical DMG. The shield lasts until she finishes unleashing her Elemental Skill.
description.7: When the skill is released, when its duration ends, or when the shield breaks, Yun Jin will unleash the charged energy as an attack, dealing <geo>Geo DMG</geo>.
description.8: Based on the time spent charging, it will either unleash an attack at Charge Level 1 or Level 2.
description.10: One glorious moment on-stage, a decade of preparation behind it.

description.0: Deals <geo>AoE Geo DMG</geo> and grants all nearby party members a Flying Cloud Flag Formation.
description.3: When Normal Attack DMG is dealt to opponents, Bonus DMG will be dealt based on Yun Jin's current DEF.
description.5: The effects of this skill will be cleared after a set duration or after being triggered a specific number of times.
description.6: When one Normal Attack hits multiple opponents, the effect is triggered multiple times according to the number of opponents hit. The number of times that the effect is triggered is counted independently for each member of the party with Flying Cloud Flag Formation.
description.8: As the drums resound, as swords and halberds weave and clash, the doyenne is transformed into a mighty general.
description.9: As the instruments on stage strum in unison, lo, see how she vanquishes these demons!

description.0: Using Opening Flourish at the precise moment when Yun Jin is attacked will unleash its Level 2 Charged (Hold) form.

The Normal Attack DMG Bonus granted by Flying Cloud Flag Formation is further increased by 2.5%/5%/7.5%/11.5% of Yun Jin's DEF when the party contains characters of 1/2/3/4 Elemental Types, respectively.
When Perfect Cooking is achieved on Food with Adventure-related effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.
Opening Flourish's CD is decreased by 18%.
After Cliffbreaker's Banner is unleashed, all nearby party members' Normal Attack DMG is increased by 15% for 12s.
Increases the Level of Cliffbreaker's Banner by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When Yun Jin triggers Crystallize or Lunar-Crystallize reactions, her DEF is increased by 20% for 12s.
Increases the Level of Opening Flourish by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Characters under the effects of the Flying Cloud Flag Formation have their Normal ATK SPD increased by 12%.

char_Zhongli_gen.name: Zhongli
char_Zhongli_gen.title: Vago Mundo
char_Zhongli_gen.description: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.

normal.1: Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, causing stone spears to fall along his path.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Every mountain, rock and inch of land is filled with the power of Geo, but those who can wield such powers freely are few and far between.
description.3: Commands the power of earth to create a Stone Stele.
description.6: Causes nearby Geo energy to explode, causing the following effects:
7: If their maximum number hasn't been reached, creates a Stone Stele.
Creates a shield of jade. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Zhongli's Max HP.
Deals <geo>AoE Geo DMG</geo>.
If there are nearby targets with the <geo>Geo element</geo>, it will drain a large amount of <geo>Geo element</geo> from a maximum of 2 such targets. This effect does not cause DMG.
description.10: When created, deals <geo>AoE Geo DMG</geo>.
description.11: Additionally, it will intermittently resonate with other nearby <geo>Geo constructs</geo>, dealing <geo>Geo DMG</geo> to nearby opponents.
description.12: The Stone Stele is considered a <geo>Geo construct</geo> that can both be climbed and used to block attacks.
description.13: Only one Stele created by Zhongli himself may initially exist at any one time.
description.16: Possesses 150% DMG Absorption against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
description.17: Characters protected by the Jade Shield will decrease the Elemental RES and Physical RES of opponents in a small AoE by 20%. This effect cannot be stacked.
description.19: A true master of stone may carve jade and shape gold.

description.0: Brings a falling meteor down to earth, dealing massive <geo>Geo DMG</geo> to opponents caught in its AoE and applying the <geo>Petrification</geo> status to them.
description.3: Opponents affected by the <geo>Petrification</geo> status cannot move.

description.0: When the Jade Shield takes DMG, it will Fortify:
1: Fortified characters have 5% increased Shield Strength.
description.2: Can stack up to 5 times, and lasts until the Jade Shield disappears.

description.0: Zhongli deals bonus DMG based on his Max HP:
1: Normal Attack, Charged Attack, and Plunging Attack DMG is increased by 1.39% of Max HP.
Dominus Lapidis' Stone Stele, resonance, and hold DMG is increased by 1.9% of Max HP.
Planet Befall's DMG is increased by 33% of Max HP.

description.0: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Polearm-type weapons.
Increases the maximum number of Stone Steles created by Dominus Lapidis that may exist simultaneously to 2.
Planet Befall grants nearby characters on the field a Jade Shield when it descends.
Increases the Level of Dominus Lapidis by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: Increases Planet Befall's AoE by 20% and increases the duration of Planet Befall's Petrification effect by 2s.
Increases the Level of Planet Befall by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

description.0: When the Jade Shield takes DMG, 40% of that incoming DMG is converted to HP for the current character.
description.1: A single instance of regeneration cannot exceed 8% of that character's Max HP.

char_Zibai_gen.name: Zibai
char_Zibai_gen.title: White Horse's Fleeting Spring
char_Zibai_gen.description: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.

normal.1: Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Summoning a shadow of her former powers, she switches to the Lunar Phase Shift mode.
description.1: In this mode, Zibai's Normal Attacks and Charged Attacks will deal Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by other infusions, and she can accrue special Phase Shift Radiance through different methods. Zibai can consume Phase Shift Radiance to unleash the special Elemental Skill Spirit Steed's Stride.
description.3: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
description.4: While in the Lunar Phase Shift mode, when Zibai performs Normal Attacks, the fourth attack will deal an additional instance of Geo DMG, which is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

skillParams.4: Lunar Phase Shift Charged Attack DMG

description.0: Zibai operates the Jadelight Canopy, dealing two instances of <geo>Geo DMG</geo>, with the second damage instance being considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
description.1: When cast, if Zibai is in the Lunar Phase Shift, the duration of the current Lunar Phase Shift will extend by an additional 1.7s.

description.0: When casting the Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest, or when nearby party members trigger Moondrift Harmony, Zibai gains the Selenic Descent effect for 4s: The DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of Spirit Steed's Stride is increased by 60% of Zibai's DEF.
Other <geo>Geo</geo> party members increase Zibai's DEF by 15% each. <hydro>Hydro</hydro> party members increase her Elemental Mastery by 60 each.

passive3.name: Moonsign Benediction: The Coursing Sun and Moon

description.0: When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Zibai has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.
description.2: Additionally, when Zibai is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

description.0: At night (18:00 – 06:00), when not in combat, restore 1 Elemental Energy to Zibai every 2 seconds.
description.1: This effect does not work in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

constellation1.name: Burst Forth With Vigor, But Enter in Silence

description.0: After using the Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest, Zibai will immediately gain 100 Phase Shift Radiance, and the max number of Spirit Steed's Stride usages per Lunar Phase Shift mode is increased to 5 times.
description.1: Additionally, each time you switch to the Lunar Phase Shift mode, the first Spirit Steed's Stride's 2nd-hit Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 220%.

constellation2.name: At Birth Are Souls Born, and in Death Leave But Husks

description.0: When in the Lunar Phase Shift mode, all nearby party members' Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 30%.
description.2: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Ascension Talent The Selenic Adeptus Descends is enhanced: the DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of Spirit Steed's Stride is further increased by 550% of Zibai's DEF. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Selenic Adeptus Descends."

constellation3.name: Free From Constraints and Worldly Ties

description.0: Increases the Level of Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellation4.name: The Spirit Passes, Then Form Follows

description.0: While in the Lunar Phase Shift mode, Zibai's Normal Attack sequence will not reset, and when Spirit Steed's Stride hits opponents, Zibai will gain the "Scattermoon Splendor" effect: The next time she uses Normal Attacks, the additional attack from her 4th hit will deal 250% of the original damage as Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

constellation5.name: Perceive the Worthless and Debate It Not

description.0: Increases the Level of Tri-Sphere Eminence by 3.
description.1: Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellation6.name: The World, A Journey in Passing

description.0: While Zibai is in the Lunar Phase Shift mode, her Phase Shift Radiance gain rate is increased by 50%.
description.1: Additionally, Spirit Steed's Stride will change such that it will consume all Phase Shift Radiance. This will elevate the DMG dealt by this instance of Spirit Steed's Stride and the Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by Zibai within the next 3s by 1.6% for every point consumed above 70. This effect cannot stack.

desc.0: When Cryo meets Electro, Superconduct occurs. Superconduct will deal AoE Cryo DMG, and will decrease the Physical RES of any beings affected by Superconduct for a time.

When Cryo comes in contact with Electro, a special Stellar-Conduct reaction will be triggered if certain conditions are also met. When this happens, a Starlight Prism is generated, and the surrounding area turns into a wondrous Polestar Field for a short period of time.
desc.1: All characters inside the Polestar Field receive a Cryo and Electro DMG Bonus, and when opponents within the field are hit by Cryo or Electro attacks, the field will store the dissipating elemental energies and then completely release them every 4s. This further increases the aforementioned DMG Bonus and also increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG coefficient for 4s.
desc.2: Additionally, opponents within the Polestar Field will also have their Physical RES lowered.

fieldDesc.0: When Cryo comes in contact with Electro, a special Stellar-Conduct reaction will be triggered if certain conditions are also met.
fieldDesc.1: This reaction creates a special Polestar Field. The more times opponents are hit by Cryo or Electro DMG within the Polestar Field, the higher the Cryo DMG, Electro DMG, and Stellar-Conduct DMG they take.

sheet_gen.unlockLockedPassive: Unlocks after completing the prerequisite quests

description.0: The Traveler gains an attribute bonus for every element they have resonated with:
description.1: <anemo>Anemo</anemo>: CRIT Rate is increased by 10%,
description.3: <electro>Electro</electro>: Energy Recharge is increased by 20%,
description.4: <dendro>Dendro</dendro>: Elemental Mastery is increased by 60,
description.6: <pyro>Pyro</pyro>: ATK is increased by 20%,
description.7: <cryo>Cryo</cryo>: CRIT DMG is increased by 20%.

description.0: The following special effect is granted when an ice crystal from a Frostpierce Star generated by the Traveler hits an opponent, or when the Traveler unleashes a Charged Attack: Freezing Ice after unlocking the Talent Foreign Permafrost. Max 8 stacks.
description.1: Unleashing the Elemental Burst Frostbound Javelin consumes all of the Traveler's Frostglow stacks to increase the DMG dealt by the current Elemental Burst. If 8 stacks are consumed, the number of strikes in the Elemental Burst is also increased.

description.0: Tap
description.1: Activates her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek in its Cold Storage mode and deals <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo> to nearby opponents.
description.3: Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode
description.4: Follows the current active character and fires Frosty Parfaits at nearby opponents at intervals, dealing <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.

description.0: Cooking Mek: Off-the-Cuff Cookery Mode
1: Places the Cooking Mek on the field. The Cooking Mek can absorb elemental attacks. When the absorbed elemental energy hits a certain limit, Escoffier can convert the ingredients placed within it into wonderful food.
Escoffier needs time to purchase new ingredients, so she can only make a certain number of dishes like this each week. The number of dishes Escoffier can make resets every Monday at 4:00 AM.

description.0: In the Nightsoul's Blessing State, Ifa's Normal Attacks will turn into Supporting Fire.
description.1: Tap
description.3: Hold
description.4: Continuously fires Tonicshots.
description.6: Deals Nightsoul-aligned <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>, and will heal all nearby party members based on Ifa's Elemental Mastery upon hitting an opponent.

description.0: Max 150 points. Each Rescue Essentials point Ifa has will increase the Swirl and Electro-Charged DMG dealt by nearby party members by 1.5%, and Lunar-Charged DMG dealt by 0.2%, and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by 0.24%. These points will be cleared when his Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.
Continuously consumes Nightsoul points. This state will end when Ifa runs out of Nightsoul points or if he uses this skill again. His Nightsoul's Blessing state has the following properties:
1: Hovers with Cacucu's help, increasing Ifa's Movement SPD and interruption resistance. In this state, Ifa will continuously consume Nightsoul points to maintain this hovering state. If he sprints or accelerates, he will consume additional points.
When he uses Normal Attacks, he will use different kinds of Supporting Fire depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

description.0: This effect will explode after a short delay and disappear, dealing AoE DMG aligned with the corresponding element. The Therapeutic Sedative can apply Sedation Marks to a maximum of 4 hit opponents. A single opponent cannot receive Marks of different elements simultaneously.
Skirk can consume Serpent's Subtlety to maintain her Seven-Phase Flash mode or to use her Elemental Burst, Havoc: Ruin.
description.2: Skirk can gain Serpent's Subtlety points in the following ways:
3: After using her Elemental Skill, Havoc: Warp.
After triggering the effect of her Ascension Talent, Reason Beyond Reason, and absorbing Void Rifts.
description.5: When Skirk leaves the field while in Seven-Phase Flash mode or when Seven-Phase Flash ends, her Serpent's Subtlety points will be removed.

description.0: Skirk will switch to this mode for a fixed time when using the Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp. This mode has the following properties:
1: Continuously consumes Serpent's Subtlety.
Increases Normal and Charged Attack AoE and Skirk's interruption resistance.
Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks are converted to <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> that cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions.
Her Elemental Burst, Havoc: Ruin is converted to the special Elemental Burst Havoc: Extinction.
Skirk can move on water when she Sprints.
Skirk will exit this mode when Serpent's Subtlety is fully depleted or its duration ends. Then, the Elemental Skill will go on cooldown.

description.0: When nearby party members trigger Frozen, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Cryo Swirl, Stellar Swirl, or Cryo Crystallize reactions against opponents, a Void Rift will be created near this opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 2.5s. A maximum of 3 Void Rifts created by Skirk herself can exist on the field at once.
description.2: Skirk can use the following methods to absorb nearby Void Rifts:
3: When she hits an opponent with a Charged Attack in her Seven-Phase Flash mode.
When she uses the special Elemental Burst Havoc: Extinction while in Seven-Phase Flash mode.
When she Holds her Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp to engage in rapid movement.
description.5: Each Rift absorbed will grant her 8 Serpent's Subtlety points.

description.0: When nearby <hydro>Hydro</hydro> party members' <hydro>Hydro</hydro> attacks hit opponents, or when nearby <cryo>Cryo</cryo> party members apart from Skirk hit opponents with <cryo>Cryo</cryo> attacks, Skirk will gain the "Death's Crossing" effect for 20s. Max 3 stacks, each stack's duration is counted independently.
description.1: Each character can grant Skirk at most 1 "Death's Crossing" stack by this means.
description.2: Each "Death's Crossing" stack increases the Normal Attack DMG dealt by Skirk in Seven-Phase Flash mode to 110%/120%/170% of its original DMG and the DMG dealt when using her Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin to 105%/115%/160% of its original DMG.

description.0: When opponents or nearby party members touch the Sacramental Shower, different effects will occur depending on the one who touches it:
description.1: If an opponent touches the Shower, it will explode and deal <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> to nearby opponents.
description.2: If a nearby party member touches it, it will bounce the one who touches it high in the air.
description.4: Only 1 Sacramental Shower summoned by Dahlia himself can be on the field at once.

description.0: Dahlia will apply this effect to his own party members when unleashing his Elemental Burst Radiant Psalter.
description.1: While this effect is active, 1 Benison stack may be consumed to summon a new Shield of Sacred Favor when the existing Shield expires or is broken via DMG.

description.0: Dahlia can obtain Benison via the following methods:
1: He will gain X Benison stacks when his own active party member hits opponents 4 times with Normal Attacks while affected by Favonian Favor.
After triggering the effect of his Ascension Talent, "The Wind's Gentle Grace."
description.3: Dahlia can gain a maximum of X Benison stacks per Favonian Favor duration.

description.0: Ineffa's assistant and companion in battle, she can be summoned to the battlefield via Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst.
description.1: If there are opponents nearby, Birgitta will quickly move close to an opponent and unleash Discharge attacks every 2s, dealing <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>.
description.2: Only one Birgitta that has been summoned by Ineffa herself can exist at any one time.
description.4: Additionally, in Nod-Krai, it seems you'll be able to change Birgitta's appearance through certain means...

description.0: A magical array that protects the Moonchanters and can be summoned by using the Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko.
description.1: The Frostgrove Sanctuary will follow the active character, dealing a single instance of <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro> to opponents within the array every 2s. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

description.0: A melody used to weave together hymns. When an Elemental Burst is used, or for a period of time after an Elemental Burst has been used, it can be converted into Pale Hymn stacks that increase the DMG from Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions.
description.1: When Lauma consumes Verdant Dew to perform the Hold version of her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, each Verdant Dew consumed will provide Lauma with 1 stack of Moon Song.

description.0: A hymn passed down by generations of Moonchanters that increases the DMG dealt by Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, and Lunar-Bloom reactions.
description.2: Lauma can gain Pale Hymn stacks in the following ways:
3: When using her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon.
When consuming Moon Song stacks due to using her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon.
When the Frostgrove Sanctuary triggers the effect of her Constellation "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight".
description.5: When party members deal Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom DMG, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed and the DMG dealt will be increased based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery. If this DMG hits multiple opponents at once, then multiple stacks of Pale Hymn will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.
description.6: The duration for each stack of Pale Hymn is counted independently.

description.0: Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG dealt by party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 15%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT.
Party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG CRIT Rate +10%, CRIT DMG +20%
Special DMG Boost effect. It is calculated independently of other DMG Boost effects.
When party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party will receive such a resource.
description.1: Your party will receive 1 Verdant Dew every 2.5s for 2.5s after triggering a Lunar-Bloom reaction. Your party can have up to 3 Verdant Dew. If you trigger another Lunar-Bloom reaction during this time, the duration of this effect will be reset.

description.0: Consume less Elemental Energy to unleash a special Elemental Burst. Flins deals a single instance of <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro>. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
description.1: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal 1 additional instance of AoE Electro DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.

description.0: After using the Elemental Skill Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights, Nefer will enter this state.
description.1: While in the Shadow Dance state, if you have at least 1 Verdant Dew, Nefer's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Phantasm Performance.
description.2: Nefer will exit the Shadow Dance state when she unleashes 3 Phantasm Performance(s) or the state's duration ends.

description.0: When in the Shadow Dance state caused by her Elemental Skill Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights, if you have at least 1 Verdant Dew, Nefer's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Phantasm Performance, which will not consume Stamina.
description.1: Nefer summons shades of herself to perform Coordinated Attacks against enemies. Nefer and the shades will deal 2 and 3 stages of <dendro>AoE Dendro DMG</dendro> respectively. DMG dealt by the shades is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. 1 Verdant Dew will be consumed the first time shades are summoned after every Phantasm Performance.

description.0: After absorbing Seeds of Deceit via the Ascension Talent A Wager of Moonlight, Nefer gains this effect, thereby increasing the DMG dealt by her Phantasm Performance.
description.1: Each stack of Veil of Falsehood increases the DMG dealt by Nefer's Phantasm Performance by 8%. The initial maximum number of stacks is 3, with each stack lasting for 9s (each stack's duration is counted independently).

description.0: After unleashing the Elemental Skill Binary Form: Convergence and Division, Durin gains this effect for 6s.
description.1: While the effect is active, press the Elemental Skill button to enter the Confirmation of Purity state, or press the Normal Attack button to enter the Denial of Darkness state.
description.2: Durin will gain different buffs and can unleash different Elemental Bursts while in these states.

description.0: A small elemental vessel that Jahoda retrieves after casting her Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils.
description.1: While Jahoda is in the Shadow Pursuit state, if nearby opponents are affected by <pyro>Pyro</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro</hydro>, <electro>Electro</electro>, or <cryo>Cryo</cryo>, the Purr-loined Treasure Flask will convert to that element and begin filling up. The order of priority that determines which element will be converted to is: <pyro>Pyro</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro</hydro>, <electro>Electro</electro>, then <cryo>Cryo</cryo>. After each use of her Elemental Skill, the Purr-loined Treasure Flask can undergo one such conversion.
description.2: When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask is full, Jahoda immediately drains it, exiting the Shadow Pursuit state and dealing a single instance of <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo> to nearby opponents.
description.3: Each time the Elemental Skill is cast, Jahoda takes out a brand-new Purr-loined Treasure Flask.
description.5: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When the Purr-loined Treasure Flask becomes full, Jahoda will not immediately discharge it. Instead, for a short duration, she steadily consumes the stored element inside and periodically fires Fluffy Meowballs at nearby opponents, dealing DMG of the corresponding element stored in the Purr-loined Treasure Flask.

description.0: One of the gadgets that Jahoda — a former treasure hunter — carries around with her. It is deployed upon using her Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter.
description.1: Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots continuously restore HP to your active character. If the healed character's HP is above 70%, they also restore HP to the nearby party member with the lowest HP.
description.3: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: If nearby opponents are affected by Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo, Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots will convert to that element. The order of priority that determines which element will be converted to is: Pyro, Hydro, Electro, then Cryo. After each deployment, a Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot can undergo one such conversion. After converting, the Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot will periodically attack up to 3 nearby opponents, dealing damage of the corresponding element.

description.0: After unleashing Elemental Skill Eternal Tides, Columbina will summon Gravity Ripple.
description.1: Gravity Ripple will follow the current active character on the field, while continuously dealing <hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</hydro> to surrounding opponents.
description.3: Additionally, while Gravity Ripple is on the field, and nearby party members trigger Lunar reactions or inflict Lunar Reaction DMG, Columbina will gain the New Moon's Omen effect for 2s, continuously accumulating Gravity. 20 Gravity can be accumulated every 2s.
description.4: You can have up to 60 Gravity, and it will be removed when the duration of Gravity Ripple ends.
description.5: Once Gravity is accumulated to its limit, a special Gravity Interference will be triggered. Different effects will be triggered depending on the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina. If the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is:
6: Lunar-Charged: Gravity Interference will deal a single instance of Electro AoE DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Lunar-Bloom: Gravity Interference will fire 5 Moondew Sigils at surrounding opponents, dealing Dendro DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.
Lunar-Crystallize: Gravity Interference will deal a single instance of Geo AoE DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Crystallize DMG.

description.0: The domain that Columbina summons after unleashing the Elemental Burst Moonlit Melancholy.
description.1: When current active characters are within the Lunar Domain, Lunar Reaction DMG inflicted by all party members will increase.

description.0: A special Verdant Dew resource provided by Columbina's Passive Talent, Law of the New Moon. Its maximum capacity and duration are calculated separately from Verdant Dew.
description.1: When the party's Verdant Dew is expended, Moonridge Dew will be consumed instead.
description.2: Your party can have up to 3 Moonridge Dew.

description.0: After using the Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest, Zibai will change to this mode. This mode lasts at most 15s and has the following properties:
1: Normal and Charged Attacks are converted into <geo>Geo DMG</geo> that cannot be overridden by other infusions.

The Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest will also be converted to the Elemental Skill Spirit Steed's Stride: When Zibai has at least 70 Phase Shift Radiance, she can consume 70 Phase Shift Radiance to unleash Spirit Steed's Stride and cause two instances of Geo DMG. The second instance will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
description.3: A maximum of 100 Phase Shift Radiance points can be accrued, and Zibai can accumulate them in the following ways:
4: She gains 10 points every second she is in the Lunar Phase Shift mode.
She gains 5 points when hitting an opponent with her Normal Attacks. She can gain Phase Shift Radiance points in this way once every 0.5s.
description.6: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
description.7: When nearby party members trigger Lunar-Crystallize, they will also accrue 35 Phase Shift Radiance points for Zibai. Points can be gained this way once every 4s. Unleashing the special elemental skill Spirit Steed's Stride will reset the CD for Phase Shift Radiance gained this way.
description.9: Zibai will leave this mode after unleashing Spirit Steed's Stride 4 times, or when the skill's duration ends.

description.0: The effect gained after Illuga unleashes his Elemental Burst Shadowless Reflection. It can increase the Geo DMG inflicted by current active characters.
Tap to unleash Elemental Skill Windbound Execution for Varka to switch to this mode.
description.1: While in this mode, Varka's Normal Attacks and Charged Attacks deal increased DMG, and he cannot perform Plunging Attacks. When Varka executes Normal or Charged Attacks, his dual-wielded claymores will deal corresponding Elemental DMG based on the Elemental Types of the characters in the party respectively:
2: DMG dealt by the claymore wielded in his left hand will be converted to <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo> that cannot be overridden by other infusions.

When there are <pyro>Pyro</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro</hydro>, <electro>Electro</electro> or <cryo>Cryo</cryo> characters in the party, the claymore wielded in his right hand deals corresponding Elemental DMG that cannot be overridden by infusions, following the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types.
description.4: Additionally, while in this mode, if there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, Varka's Elemental Skill Windbound Execution will be converted to the special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension.

description.0: Varka's special Elemental Skill. Deals AoE Elemental DMG that cannot be overridden by infusions corresponding to the element of the claymore wielded in Varka's right hand, and <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> to opponents.
description.1: Starts on cooldown and has 2 maximum uses.
description.2: When Varka is in Sturm und Drang mode and his Normal Attack hits an opponent, the CD of Four Winds' Ascension will be reduced by 0.5s. Every time Varka switches to the Sturm und Drang mode, this effect can be triggered up to 15 times.
description.3: Additionally, Varka can expend uses of Four Winds' Ascension to perform a special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, that consumes no Stamina, dealing 2 instances of Elemental DMG corresponding to the element of the claymore wielded in his right hand, which cannot be overridden by infusions, and 2 instances of Anemo DMG.

description.0: Lohen switches to this mode after he unleashes the Elemental Skill Unforeseen Strike. Masterstroke mode has the following characteristics:
1: DMG dealt by Lohen's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> that cannot be overridden by other infusions.

When Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal Attack or Charged Attack, he accumulates Joy that can be used to unleash the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul. Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul up to 3 times while in Masterstroke mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate Joy.
When nearby party members deal DMG, they also accumulate Will to Win for Lohen that can be used to increase the DMG dealt by Etched Into Bone and Soul.
Masterstroke mode ends when Lohen leaves the field. When Masterstroke mode ends, Joy and Will to Win will be reset to zero.

description.0: A special Elemental Skill that Lohen can use after his Joy reaches the max limit.
description.1: After hitting an opponent, consumes all Joy and Will to Win to deal Cryo DMG. This DMG increases based on the amount of Will to Win consumed.

description.0: When Lohen hits opponents with a Normal Attack or Charged Attack while in Masterstroke mode, he will accumulate 0.381298 Joy. Up to 100 Joy may be accumulated at any one time.
description.1: Joy can be accumulated once every 0.1s. Once Joy reaches its max limit, Lohen's Elemental Skill Unforeseen Strike will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul.

description.0: A special resource accumulated when other nearby party members deal DMG while Lohen is in Masterstroke mode. Up to 100 Will to Win may be accumulated at any one time.
description.1: While Masterstroke mode is active, when other nearby party members deal DMG, if that DMG is not less than 55.2868% of Lohen's Base ATK, he accumulates 0.829302 Will to Win. Otherwise, he accumulates 1 Will to Win.
description.2: Each character can accumulate Will to Win for Lohen once every 0.1s.

description.0: Lumi has three different Strike Forms.
description.3: Lumi will use Pound-Pound Pummeler to attack nearby opponents continuously. Every attack will deal 2 instances of AoE Geo DMG.
description.4: If there are Moondrifts nearby, Lumi will alternate between Pound-Pound Pummeler and Heavy Overdrive Hammer to continuously attack nearby opponents . Heavy Overdrive Hammer will deal AoE Geo DMG which will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
description.6: Ultimate Power Form
description.7: Lumi will use the ultimate Million Ton Crush, dealing an especially powerful instance of AoE Geo DMG that is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, switching to Standard Power Form.
description.10: It might not be as flashy as the other forms, but it still packs a serious punch.
description.11: Lumi will use Pound-Pound Pummeler at longer intervals to attack nearby opponents continuously. Every attack will deal 2 instances of AoE Geo DMG.

description.0: After unleashing the Elemental Skill Revelation: Uncreated Light, Nicole bestows the following effect on all nearby party members: ATK is increased based on Nicole's ATK.
description.1: After certain conditions are met, the Grace of Kenosis effect will be upgraded to Guidance of Theosis, further increasing ATK.

description.0: Upgrading the Grace of Kenosis effect increases ATK by an additional 300.
description.1: After unlocking the Ascension Talent "Methexis" and meeting any of the following observation conditions, Grace of Kenosis will be upgraded to Guidance of Theosis for the remainder of its duration:
2: Another character under observation remains on the field for longer than 3s; or
Another character under observation is a Hexerei character.
description.4: Additionally, after unlocking the Ascension Talent "Philokalia," when a nearby active party member's Elemental DMG hits an opponent, Nicole's own Grace of Kenosis will be upgraded to Guidance of Theosis for 8s.
description.6: When characters other than Nicole who have Guidance of Theosis leave the field, their effect will revert to Grace of Kenosis.

description.0: A witchhunter's trusty companion! Under the right conditions, the Banehunter Oathhammer undergoes Elemental Conversion, turning all its DMG into DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type.
description.1: Prune can summon the Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone Elemental Conversion in the following ways:
2: For a certain time after triggering a Swirl or Stellar Swirl Reaction on an opponent with the Elemental Skill Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime, Prune can unleash the special Elemental Skill Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!. When using this special Elemental Skill, the Banehunter Oathhammer will be converted to the other Elemental Type involved in the aforementioned Swirl or Stellar Swirl Reaction.

After the Ascension Talent "Verdict and Punishment" is unlocked, when the Witchlure Bell in Hunter-Seeker mode triggers Swirl or Stellar Swirl on an opponent, it will summon a Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone the corresponding Elemental Conversion to attack the opponent.

description.0: During the Elemental Burst The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!, after the Witchlure Bell in Hunter-Seeker mode deals DMG to an opponent, if this DMG triggers Swirl on an opponent, it will also summon a Banehunter Oathhammer that deals DMG of the type matching the Elemental Conversion from the Swirl. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

After Prune hits an opponent with the Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone Elemental Conversion, other nearby party members will gain the Tolling Rally effect: Attack DMG will be increased based on Prune's ATK.
Fagio will switch to this mode when using a Charged Attack.
description.1: When in this mode, Fagio will engage any opponents ahead with a sweeping fire attack, as well as fire condensed beams at intervals, dealing <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.2: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The condensed beams will instead deal AoE Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer DMG.

description.0: When in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power will continuously increase. When its Decoding Power reaches the maximum, Fagio will be unable to maintain or re-enter Decoding mode.

When Stellar-Conduct is triggered, the surrounding area will transform into a Polestar Field for a short period of time, and when inside a Polestar Field, certain characters will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state, which grants various skill buffs.

When the party's currently active character deals <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> or <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, 1 stack of "Lead Vocal" is consumed. This in turn increases the DMG dealt. However, if a Wandering Vortex is present on the field or during the 5s following a Wandering Vortex explosion, this effect will only trigger when the character deals Stellar Swirl reaction DMG.
description.1: Every 1000 Max HP Vodyanitsa has in excess of 40000 will increase the Stellar Swirl reaction DMG from the above effect by 260, as well as <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> and <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> dealt by 140. Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt can be increased by a maximum of 6500 while <hydro>Hydro DMG</hydro> and <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo> can be increased by a maximum of 3500 in this way.

description.0: Triggered by off-field party members or other nearby party members (and not your currently active party member). Effects are the same as those of "Lead Vocal."
Vesna switches to this mode after using the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory. In this mode, which lasts up to 15s:
1: Vesna's resistance to interruption is increased.

DMG dealt by Vesna with her Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks becomes Anemo DMG that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion instead. She will also summon a wind pinion that attacks the opponent at the same time, dealing additional Anemo DMG. Each time the wind pinion is summoned, Vesna will regenerate a certain amount of Sword Essence.
Vesna can consume Sword Essence to unleash the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword, which deals Anemo DMG to her opponents.
Vesna will exit the mode when its duration ends or after she has used Windborne Sword at the highest level 3 times. Exiting will clear all remaining Sword Essence she has accrued.

description.0: The energy required to use the special Elemental Skill Windborne Swordwhile in the Armed for Action mode.
description.1: Vesna can accumulate Sword Essence in the following ways:
2: By performing a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, or Plunging attack while in the Armed for Action mode, or by unleashing Windborne Sword: Transpose from the Constellation Unwavering Ardor;
By using the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory; or
By using the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa!

description.0: When in the Armed for Action mode, Vesna can consume Sword Essence to use her special Elemental Skill to deal Anemo DMG.
description.1: Each use of the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword in the same instance of Armed for Action will increase the level of Windborne Sword, beginning from Lv. 1, up to Lv. 3 max.
description.2: Using Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3 will also summon a Spirit Blade which deals Anemo DMG.

description.0: A weapon with special power that Vesna can summon. Attacks the opponent alongside Vesna to deal <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.
description.1: Vesna can summon Spirit Blades through the following ways:
2: By unleashing the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3;
By using the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa!; or
By using Windborne Sword·: Transpose in the Constellation Unwavering Ardor.
description.4: Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG dealt by the Spirit Blades become Anemo DMG that is considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG instead.

description.0: A special effect Alyosha can apply on the opponent.
description.1: When this effect is applied to an opponent who is already under the Hunter's Mark effect, it will activate Hunter's Mark instead, which removes said mark and grants all nearby party members the Hunter's Precision effect, which increases their ATK when they are on the field.

description.0: Alyosha's trusted hunting hound and companion, which can be summoned to the field using the Elemental Burst Hunter's Advance.
description.1: Periodically moves close to an opponent to maul them, and activate any existing Hunter's Marks.

description.0: A psychic double of Odette's that dances a duet with her. May be summoned to the field through her Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst.
description.1: Alternates between the Plume and Wing dance moves to periodically attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
description.2: A maximum of one Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette is allowed on the field at any one time.
description.4: Additionally, when there is a Dance Double summoned by Odette nearby, her Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers is changed to the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling.

description.0: Odette's special Elemental Skill, which deals to nearby opponents <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo> over time. Then, when the dance duet ends, she deals another instance of <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo> that is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG. During the dance duet, Odette can control the direction of the dance steps.
description.1: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The DMG dealt when the dance duet ends is changed to AoE Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar reaction type.
description.3: Additionally, after Odette unleashes the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling, should she be in the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer state while her Dance Double is still on the field, the Dance Double's two dance moves types will also deal additional AoE Cryo DMG of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type.

description.0: After unlocking the Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One," Odette will obtain a special effect when she summons her Solo Dance Double.
description.1: Every stack of Marvelous Splendor active increases the character's Stellar Glimmer DMG by 15%. This lasts until her Dance Double exits the field or when she summons her Solo Dance Double again.
description.2: When Odette is off-field, she loses 1 stack of Marvelous Splendor every 1 second, while other nearby party members gain the corresponding number of Marvelous Splendor stacks at the same time.

description.0: Radiance: Stellar-Conduct and Radiance: Stellar Swirl are both considered Radiance: Stellar Glimmer states.
description.1: Characters can only be affected by one Radiance state at any one time, and where more than one state can be triggered, Radiance: Stellar-Conduct shall apply first.
